reviews.text: The host was very responsive and made sure everything went smoothly. The place was very clean and well-maintained, which I really appreciated. However, the bathroom could use a bit of attention — there were issues with the hot and cold water, and the jet was leaking during my stay. That said, just few tweaks needed in the bathroom else the overall service was truly commendable. This place is worth the price and highly recommended.

The flat is clean and spacious, with one bedroom and all the essential amenities you need for a comfortable stay. Chris is a very welcoming host, and he communicates effectively, which enhances the overall experience. The neighborhood is quiet and peaceful, providing a nice atmosphere for relaxation.
However, one aspect to consider is the location. Although it's conveniently close to bus and tram stops, the steep hill could pose challenges for those traveling with young children or carrying a lot of luggage. It might be helpful to plan accordingly or consider alternative transportation options to make your stay more convenient.

We had a nice and comfortable short stay at Chris's place. He was very responsive and helpful throughout. The house was very clean and the bedroom heaters provided the much needed warmth. He helped with clear instructions for flexible check-in and late check-out as well. Getting bigger suitcases up to the room (which was on the 2nd floor I think) with only staircase option can be a bit tiring.

1. It’s definitely spacious and the WiFi is really really good. That’s definitely something that stood out.
2. Chris is so good with his communication, keeps us posted with relevant links and is super helpful.
3. The metro/ tram is a 7-8 mins walk away, so you’re good to travel around at your convenience
4. The place was super clean and matched its description end to end
5. It’s closer to the airport as well, we had booked it to travel back, so the airport being 35 mins away was helpful.

Chris’s place was very comfortable and clean. It was very easy to find thanks to the detailed instructions sent by Chris and he was a great host , replying promptly whenever I needed help. It’s a beautiful place and he’s an amazing host! Best of all its located in the perfect area close to many local attractions:) will definitely book here again in my future trips to Istanbul
Thankyou again Chris!

description: We are Tsn for Property Mngmt company with over 45 apts in our portfolio. Our 4 Br apt is located in Jurnal street, Beyoğlu. Located in third floor, 250 meters away from Galata Tower w/ easy access to all attractions and hip restaurants & cafes in its neighbourhood. The apt is 170 sqm and well designed for our guests needs: 4 bedroom, 3 bathroom, a kitchen with all appliances and utilities, a large living room, ULTRA FAST wifi. We look forward to hosting you here

reviews.text: The apartment was fantastic. I read other reviews that said no elevator, too many stairs, on 3rd floor. Also read that it's in a noisy neighborhood and gets too loud. Yes, there are stairs, if out of shape or handicap, could be issue. Yes, it's in a part of town that is very lively with some noise. But if you are looking to be centrally located, in the middle of town, 10-25 minute walk to everything you could possibly want to do, this is the place. It was very clean, host met me at check-in, did walk through. Very responsive throughout entire process from booking to checkout. If you are looking for a clean, responsive host, perfectly centered in the middle of town, for a great price, stop looking at other ads and book this Airbnb. Highly recommend

We had a fantastic stay at this Airbnb in Istanbul! We were a group of six, four adults and two kids and the apartment was absolutely perfect for our needs.
First of all, the space was exactly as described, spacious, beautifully decorated, and very clean. There was more than enough room for all of us to feel comfortable, and the beds were especially cozy after long days exploring the city.
The location was excellent, with easy access to public transport, restaurants, cafes, and local attractions. It made getting around the city incredibly convenient and allowed us to experience both the lively atmosphere and the authentic charm of the neighborhood.
Our host was exceptional: friendly, responsive, and always willing to help with recommendations and any questions we had. The check in and check out process was smooth and stress free.
Overall, this was one of the best accommodation experiences we’ve had. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to families or groups

My family and I had a fantastic stay here while in Istanbul. This apartment is in a great location close to bars, restaurants, and shopping. Metro and public transportation are easily accessible by walking. Our particular favorite mode of transportation was the Tunel (second oldest subway in the world) which takes you up and down the big hill this apartment is located on top of. The hosts were very responsive and made sure all our needs were met, including flexibility in check in and check out. This place was well worth it! Be aware it is a 4 floor walk up! The area gets very busy at night but you cannot hear the noise from inside the apartment.

Overall a good stay. The apartment as some reviewers indicate, appears exactly like the photos and here we have to disagree. A nice apartment, but certainly not as large or as pristine as the images reflect. We had an AC issue, but this was attended to quickly over a holiday weekend. The apartment is also not in a quiet neighborhood, again as some reviewers have indicated. There is a bar and night club just beneath the main bedroom, even three stories up, Friday and Saturday nights were insane with noise and loud banging. Again overall, for a 5 night stay a nice option very centrally located. We walked to all activities and great restaurants. Thanks to the hosts.

This place and the hosts are gems. We were traveling as a group of 6 women friends and had the best ever time.
The place: Spotless clean, beautifully furnished, looked like the pictures (not misleading), with all amenities you need in great condition, and most importantly absolutely amazing location. So much to do within 10m walk eg Istiklal street, Galata, Beyoğlu areas, Taksim. Only call out is that this is on the third floor without lift, so may not be appropriate for older guests or those with health issues.
The hosts: Sebo, Can and Sena - hosts of this Airbnb were super responsive. Almost all comms were responded to within a matter of minutes or at most an hour. When we needed an extra duvet, they got it for us in a matter of hours. Sebo was even kind enough to pick something we needed from a store 20min away to save us time before we left for airport. Most importantly he was supportive and helpful when we had an unfortunate theft at some ATM during our trip. Absolute angel!

description:
Available for over 100-day stays.

Comfortable apartment in Beşiktaş, within walking distance to Dolmabahçe Palace, Çırağan Palace, and Maçka Park. The home features a private garden patio, two separate living areas, and one dedicated workspace. One living room includes a private shower area. Air conditioning is available in the main living room and master bedroom, while the second bedroom has a ceiling fan. Ideal for longer stays and guests seeking a calm yet central location.

reviews.text:
I struggled with writing this review, I’ve never given a bad review so let’s just stick to the facts. The location is perfect. Super close to all the shops and restaurants. Just a few blocks off the water as well.
The major downside is that because the apartment has a lot of water damage there peeling wallpaper and mold and a musty smell that just doesn’t leave. Also the tables are pretty wobbly so we don’t use them for eating. The patio furniture looks different from the photos.
The team was very helpful and communicated great. I think with some maintenance this could be a 5 star place but as is I would give a soft 2.

The communication with the host was the best I had so far. The apartment was comfortable and clean. Its location was great, but, during the weekend, there was noise during the evening from nearby parties. The noise did not stop us from sleeping and did not last all night, so it did not compromise our stay. Yet, if you are planning on sleeping early or if you are a light sleeper, you should take this into account. Nonetheless, I've been multilple times to Istanbul and this was my best experience with airbnbs so far in the city. Great cost-benefit relation. I recommend it.

This apartment does not match the pictures, especially the bathroom and kitchen... The furniture is old in both places and there are stains in the kitchen... The refrigerator in the kitchen that you see in the photo does not work... The veranda was so untidy that we could not go outside even once... The location is good... We were close to everything... There are plenty of food outlets...

The stay was not too bad overall, but unfortunately, the apartment did not match the photos entirely, and there were noticeable issues with cleanliness, particularly in the kitchen. There was also a persistent unpleasant smell throughout the stay.
If you're traveling with children, I would not be able to recommend this place. While communication with the host was great, I feel the space did not meet our expectations. The area around was great, with lots of things to do and see and plenty of restaurants. If you're traveling as adults only and don’t mind adjusting a bit for a couple of days, it may be okay.

Host was super responsive and welcoming from booking to checkout. The place was sparkling clean, exactly as described, and had everything we needed. Thoughtful extras and great location made our stay fantastic

description:

Gym, Turkish bath, sauna, indoor and outdoor pool

description: You will not be far from the comfort of your home during your stay in this apartment consisting of Four bedrooms, a living room, a full kitchen, a bathroom, and two wc , which is located on the main street in the center of the famous Sisli area. In this apartment connected to our hotel, we have a reception service 7/24. The entire hotel is monitored by a camera security system that operates 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. We also have an elevator in the building that can take 5 people.

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at Sisli Form!
The accommodations were clean, cozy, and exactly as described. The staff were incredibly attentive, friendly and made sure we had everything we needed. The location was perfect, with easy access to nearby attractions. The only downside was the occasional poor internet connection, but it didn't detract much from my overall
experience. I would definitely recommend this Airbnb to others.

Pros:
- Very friendly, and helpful staff
- Great home with enough room for 8 guests
- Close to public transport and restaurants
- Clean sheets
- Dishwasher and washer dryer
- The host was very responsive and addressed the issues quickly, providing the missing items promptly
- The host helped us getting a car to the airport for much cheaper price than the online taxi apps
Cons:
- The kitchen was not well equipped. Several essential cooking tools, including knives and a strainer, were missing.
- The plates and bowls provided were outdated, and many were chipped.

I had an excellent stay at Şişli Form Apartments. The location is perfect—close to everything you need, with easy access to transportation, shops, and restaurants. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped, making me feel right at home.
The staff were very helpful, friendly, and professional throughout my stay. Check-in and check-out were smooth and hassle-free.
I highly recommend Şişli Form for anyone visiting Istanbul. I would definitely stay here again!

Very clean and staff were very responsive, attentive, and helpful. We were very happy with communication and staff. We stayed for two weeks for a family reunion. The only thing I would change is that equipment and dishes in the kitchen were old and cooking wasn’t always easy. But overall we were happy with our stay. Plus, lots of shopping options nearby.

We had a fantastic stay here from Feb 14–17! From the moment we arrived, the hospitality was top-notch. The room was spotless, comfortable, and exactly as described, if not better. It was the perfect home base for our trip, and we really appreciated the attention to detail provided by the team. The location was convenient, and the amenities made our stay incredibly relaxing. I wouldn't hesitate to recommend this place to anyone visiting İstanbul. We are already looking forward to coming back!

description:
Let this sparkling and elegant apartment take you on an adventure!

The apt. overlooking the Golden Horn as well as a great city view from both bedrooms.

This place gives you a taste of the timeless existence of our bustling city.

The apartment has all the amenities you may need and it's 2 minutes walk away from the famous Galata Tower. The metro station is even closer; it takes 30 seconds only to reach. Bus stations are also reachable within a minute while the tram station is 5 mins away.

reviews.text:
The hosts were very responsive and helpful. Checkin was easy. The location of the flat is excellent with a nice view. The WiFi worked well and the flat was as seen on photos, spacious room and comfortable beds. The area felt safe and close to the Galata Tower. There was a minor issue with the shower as the water was either too hot or too cold. But there was no problem in using the bathtub in the flat. I could recommend the place on this basis. Very warm flat also.
Unfortunately we had a day of water cut during our stay, which became a significant inconvenience. It was a planned water cut by the city for the neighbourhood so it’s not the fault of the host, however a pre warning when the problem became known would have been appreciated, since the host wqw in contact with the doorman in the same building. Instead we found out only when we came back late to the flat. Despite this issue, I would still recommend the flat.

Oktay and Derya apartment is safe, comfortable, peaceful, and welcoming. We had two apartment options when choosing where to stay, and my two teenagers picked this apartment. Believe me, we have absolutely no regrets!
From check-in to check-out, the entire process was easy and seamless. Derya made us feel like family from the very beginning. She even arranged airport pickup for us, which made our arrival stress-free.
The apartment views are absolutely stunning, just like the pictures. Waking up every morning to the beautiful Bosphorus view was unforgettable. The location was perfect — close to many attractions. We were able to walk to Istiklal Street and Galata Tower with ease, it’s also close to metro station, eateries and many more!
The kitchen and bathroom fully stocked with everything you could possibly need for your stay. Both bedrooms and the living room had excellent working air conditioning. We will definitely stay here again whenever we visit Istanbul.

We stayed in Daria’s place from 14-21st July and loved the place! Location was perfect, bedrooms very spacious and living and kitchen very cozy. We were given baby cot as requested. We had necessities available in the appartment: toilet paper, shower gel, washing up liquid, some tea, sugar, coffee, even new toothbrushes and toothpaste paste, towels. Few minor disadvantages that were noticeable is that toilet bidet was weak, water in the shower was changing hot/cold as you shower and curtains are not exactly black out(for us it mattered as our 2 yrs old is used to sleeping in a very dark room). Music school next door could get annoying if you are a light & early sleeper. Air conditioning in one of the bedrooms is quite loud. However, all those seemed minor to us and we wouldn’t hesitate to stay there again & recommend it to others! It is overall a very nice appartment, clean, seems like newly recommended and has a great energy!

Daria was a lovely host. Responsive to our concerns and supportive with check in and out. Thank you again for helping with our stay.
Air bnb is clean. Be aware it is located at the top floor above a lighting shop facing a main road with a functioning but small elevator. The rooms were clean, hot tub was a nice touch. Both bedroom have a beautiful view of the golden horn. Be aware there is noise pollution as it is a busy area but also you are near main attractions like Galata tower, pera museum and nice restaurants and dessert areas. Lights cut out once but this often happens in Istanbul and is temporarily.
Towels and slippers were kindly provided by host. Well orchestrated stay.

We had a wonderful stay in Istanbul! The apartment was exactly as described, clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. The location was excellent, making it easy to explore the city’s main attractions, restaurants, and public transportation. The host was friendly, responsive, and provided clear check-in instructions.
One point to keep in mind is that the street has only one narrow lane, so it may be a little challenging when dropping off or picking up many pieces of luggage. It is better to plan the arrival and departure carefully.
Overall, we truly enjoyed our stay and would definitely recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul. We would be happy to stay here again.

description:
You can easily access everything from this centrally located place. You can walk to Istiklal Avenue in 5 minutes and to Taksim Square in 15 minutes
It is possible to reach touristic places such as Karaköy, Eminönü, Hagia Sophia and Sultanahmet in a very short time. You do not need to take any vehicle to eat dinner with a view of the Galata Tower, you can easily reach it by walking.

reviews.text: The apartment matches the photos and is good value for the price. The host is friendly and pleasant to communicate with. There is a road nearby, so it can be a bit noisy at night. The neighborhood is old and not always very clean, but this is quite typical for this part of the city. Overall, I had a positive stay.

The apartment has a good location: 40 meters from the bus stop. There are two small supermarkets about a hundred meters away. Nearby there are inexpensive cafes/canteens, a bread shop. Istiklal is a 5-minute walk away. The apartment has a set of everything you need: a comfortable bed, towels are available, hairdryer, hot water, air conditioning, gas stove, dishes, TV and wi-fi. The hostess is very pleasant and friendly. She is always in touch and ready to help. Thank you for a comfortable stay in your apartment!

I absolutely loved staying at this apartment. The location was perfect, and the apartment itself had everything I needed—there was a hair dryer, a kitchen, and even cozy house slippers. The only thing missing was a washing machine, but honestly, it didn’t bother me much.
What truly made the experience special was the host, Neema. She was incredibly responsive—she replied to all my messages in less than 5 minutes, often within just a minute. It made me feel really cared for. Neema is such a kind and thoughtful host.
There was a small issue with the bathroom sink one day, and Neema had it fixed right away. Her quick response really impressed me.
The apartment was spotlessly clean, very comfortable, and located on the first floor in an ideal spot for exploring Istanbul’s main attractions.
I genuinely recommend this apartment to anyone visiting Istanbul. It made my trip even more memorable!

the apartment match the photos, very responsive and nice host she let us check in 2 hours before check in time, the location of the apartment is very good in terms of the transportation and the proximity to istiklal street,
very good price performance
recommend.

It is a marvellous find !! We spent 5 days at one of Karabey's places and it was excellent. It has everything we need (towels, hot water, wifi, tv, air conditionner, hair dryer, cooking tools, a kettle,...). It was super clean and up to my cleaning standards seeing that i emphasize on such concept whenever i look for a rent (bed sheets were clean, no spots anywhere, kitchen and kitchen tools and bathroom were clean and tidy too). Everything was working properly and we had no issues with anything in the room. The wifi is working well too. The location is very good as well, it is close to Taksim, galata, many monuments, restaurants and places to go and visit. It is 2 minutes away from a bus station where busses come around every minutes or so. We didn't find any troubles moving around and discovering the city. The neighbhood was calm too and there were 2 supermarkets 1 minutes away from the house.
I really enjoyed my stay alot even though i am a super picky person. Thanks again !!

description: 200m to metro station ,Galata tower and docks . Central and peacefull

reviews.text: I was satisfied spending 12 days in Navans hotel. They were polite and welcoming although they do not speak english. They used a translator . The room was very very clean and rather quiet . Of course ,it is always wise to carry earplugs when you visit a hotel but i didn't need them. The negative things about are not many. First, a weak internet modem which had some breakdowns ,but it was rather enough for my usage. But if you need a stable strong internet, this could be an issue. The second issue that will bother, for sure if you are 2 persons, is the absolute absence of a small closet, somewhere to put your clothes and suitcase. In the room was only a chair and a really big and very comfortable bed although there was some space for a small closet. It won't need something bigger than 150cm x 60cm x 30cm. Also there should be a mirror on the wall. ! However, because the hotel is new i am sure Navan will manage everything right. I would visit them again for sure.
This hotel was cheap, but dirty. The bed was clean but the bathroom and the bedroom was full of hair. The douche was not working properly.

Gece 9 da rezervasyon isteği atmama rağmen hemen dönüş sağladı ve yardımcı oldu. Otel Haliç Metro durağından inince 2 -3 dk yürüme mesafesinde. Odada çift kişilik yatak, bir ısıtıcı ve televizyon bulunuyordu. Yatak temizdi, ısıtıcı ise içeriyi yeterince ısıttı. Tuvalet kısmı biraz ufak fakat iş görüyor. Tavsiye ederim.
The hotel is in a good location, central to the city! They were extremely friendly and kind, thank you!

We stayed for three nights, it is only good for sleeping, it does not have a cooling system which we requested and they gave us a fan, and also in the facilities it is mentioned that there is an electric kettle in the units but it was not in our unit which we requested. But they did not give it to us. It was very annoying and we didn't have hot water to drink tea in the morning, so on the last day, another official gave us an electric kettle.

description:
The apartment is located in the center of Beyoğlu, within walking distance to Karaköy coast, Taksim Square and Galataport, in one of the most tourist-attracting districts in the world.

It is in an area where 24/7 transportation is easily available, you can reach all personal needs within walking distance, and you can access all social areas according to your preferences.

I offer you a space where you can stay and feel like you are at home

reviews.text:
Very dirty: bed linen with hair plus very old and cheap, hair on the toilet seat, extremely dirty carpets on the floor, lots of heavy dust and trash (packaging from strepsils, used tissues) - as if no one ever bothered to clean for ages. We texted the host straightaway upon arrival and were told that the place is regularly cleaned and the hair we see is not hair, he agreed to send the cleaner to change the sheets though.
The place looked smaller than the photos, probably ultrawide pictures , and this must be somehow addresses by the platform as it creates false expectations.
Overall it seems the place is not well taken care off.
Pros: location is convenient, bedroom is quiet and warm, the living room was a bit chilly in February.
After checkout the host texted a long message asking not to leave a review less than 5 stars as it is the main source of income. If it was, there would be different approach to maintaining the property. Not an honest thing to do anyway. Hope they improve

Perfect location, quite and central. Spotlessly clean and organized apartment. Communication was fast and easy. Comfortable mattress and immaculate bed linen and sheets. Fully equipped kitchen. Totally reliable. I would stay here again. Ferah was kind and welcoming.

A truly wonderful stay, accurately described, extremely clean and comfortable. The actual neighborhood is residential, but the surrounding area is full of many many choices for food, coffee, entertainment and sights. Well worth it!!

Great location, spacious and comfortable apartment. That said, a few issues kept this from being a perfect stay: the AC remote wasn't working properly, the heating didn't seem to function on our last night, and the mattress needs an upgrade — you can feel the springs through it.
Hopefully the host addresses these things, because with some fixes this could be a five-star stay.

Ev sahibi tüm mesajlara hemen cevap veriyor iletişim yardım konusunda hiç bir sıkıntı olmuyor evde çok temizdir tarihi yerlere çok yakın bir konumdaydı galataportunda dibinde zaten bir park yerinde problem olabilir onun içinde çevrede paralı otopark yerleri var ama yine de çok memnun kaldık

description:
The home is located in the heart of Istanbul, just a few steps from the famous Istiklal Street and you can see the Galata Tower from window

Thanks to location, you can walk to many of Istanbul’s most iconic places, including Karaköy, Eminönü, Golden Horn, Blue Mosque and many other historical sights. You won’t need a taxi to explore the main attractions of Istanbul many of them are within walking distance from the house. You can see the Galata Tower from the window in the living room.

reviews.text:
The apartment is very light and cozy, the kitchen is clean and has all necessary appliances. The apartment has a relaxing vibe, which is helpful after long walks. There is no noise at nights.
The location of the apartment is quiet convenient, metro and bus stop is nearby, so it is easy to get to any location within Istanbul by public transport up to late night. Even though Galata is 5 minutes away, the apartment is in less noisy neighborhood. Also, the Golden Horn is a 10-minute walk away.
For the proposed price you will receive relevant quality.
The owner of apartment is very helpful.
This is my first trip and my English is not very good, and Cihan helped me a lot in a big city with a lot of tourists.
Cihan is not only the owner of the apartment, but also a really supportive person and friend. Such people are rare these days. Thank you, my Dear friend, I wish you all the best!.
I recommend this apartment. On my next trip, I will definitely stay in this apartment.

We had a fantastic stay! The apartment is in a great location, just steps away from Galata Tower and within walking distance of many of Istanbul’s main attractions. There are plenty of good food spots and activities nearby, making it easy to enjoy the city without needing much transport. The neighborhood is lively but not too noisy with the right balance.
The apartment itself is exactly as shown in the photos: clean, comfortable, and well-maintained. It’s a great choice for couples looking to explore the city. Cihan was a wonderful host: very responsive, helpful, and quick to assist with anything we needed.
Highly recommended for anyone visiting Istanbul, we would definitely stay again!

We loved our stay here! The apartment is in an incredible location; right in the historic heart of Istanbul and within easy walking distance to many major attractions, shops, and restaurants. The host, Cihan, was fantastic; very responsive, helpful, and reliable. There were a few small hiccups during our stay, but he handled everything quickly and made sure we were comfortable. He even kindly accommodated us with a late checkout, which we really appreciated.
Just a heads-up for future guests: the building is historic, so there’s no elevator and the stairs are quite narrow. Just to be aware in case you have large and heavy luggage. The bathroom is also on the smaller side, which might be something to note if you’re a larger person. Overall, it’s a very charming place with an outstanding host!

I had such a wonderful stay and truly couldn’t have asked for a better host. From the moment I booked the reservation, Cihan was communicating with me immediately and offering advice about transportation, currency etc. . Upon arrival, he went above and beyond by personally greeting me, helping me settle in, and providing helpful guidance throughout my stay.
The apartment was perfect, exactly as described, also had great AC and laundry setup, and everything I needed to feel comfortable. The location was also unbeatable and made exploring the the main tourist attractions so easy.
Cihan’s kindness and hospitality truly made the experience special. I’m very grateful for everything and would happily stay here again..

If you want to be near Galata, this is a great apartment! We were surprised how busy this area was, but it is a good central home base to explore the rest of Istanbul. Cihan is very nice and helpful with local recommendations. The place was clean and it was really nice to have the kitchen since restaurants around here are expensive.

description: This spacious studio offers one double bed and a spacious living area. The living area has one large sofa which can be used as a bed for the additional guest. The studio offers a private kitchenette and a private bathroom with mid size Jacuzzi (140cm*80 cm). There is 24 hours door man and once every 2 days room service. The Turkish bath need to be booked upon arrival for free entrance.

reviews.text:
Location is great and there are many restaurants and cafes in close proximity. The size of the room is really good and accurate per the photos. Bathroom is a little outdated though. Bed is comfortable and kitchenette is sufficient for basic meal prep. The sauna downstairs is also nice and is private use only which is great. Room was cleaned well and done every 2nd day. Hotel staff are very friendly and helpful, and Yusuf and Errol are also very friendly and responsive to questions.
All channels on the tv are in Turkish. Wifi is slow and wasn't always working at night, but is ok for basic use. The fridge in the room was a little loud. You will likely hear noise from neighbouring apartment above, and will definitely hear noise from the corridor, so definitely bring earplugs!
If I could suggest some improvements, would be to improve the wifi and tv service, and get a quieter fridge in the room. Overall very happy with my stay and will be back again.

It’s such a joy staying at Yusuf’s place. Yusuf, his brother Yunus and their colleagues, Erol and Amir are gracious hosts. They are warm and friendly, and speak English fluently, so communication is not an issue. Yusuf is very prompt when replying to messages and he will answer any questions to the best of his ability. Yusuf has a newly opened restaurant, which is just a stone’s throw away. My partner and I had a hearty breakfast and Yusuf gave us a discounted price for being his guests. Thank you Yusuf for your kind gesture.
The apartment is cozy and clean, and tastefully furnished. It comes equipped with a kitchen, which has all the basic cooking utensils and crockery if you want to do simple cooking.
There is a 24-hr reception, managed by Yunus, Erol and Amir for the different parts of the day. They never failed to offer us tea/coffee and cookies every time we returned from our sightseeing trips. We want to specially thank Erol too for helping us to collect our Champions League tickets. He is indeed very knowledgeable and recommended us relevant tours as part of our day trip. Thanks Erol!
The apartment is strategically located - there are so many shops nearby, like sundry shops, cafes and restaurants, and department stores, among others. Istanbul is naturally hilly, so a little hiking and climbing up the hill is needed. Just make sure your wear comfortable shoes.
The apartment is also accessible to major places of interest like the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar and Topkapi Palace Museum (about 5-10 mins walk). You need to alight at the Beyazit tram station to get to the apartment, which is about 5 mins walk.
Overall, my partner and I certainly enjoyed our 5-day stay and we will definitely come back here for our future Istanbul trips.

We had the most memorable stay in Sultanahmet thanks to Erol and Farhad. The hotel is in the most perfect, central location to all the important sites. Cleanliness is a top priority, we found our room to be spotless upon arrival and the rooms were cleaned every 2 days.
We traveled with our 10 month old baby and were provided with a playpen/crib along with bedding for him. It was great to find a place with a kitchenette (within a reasonable price frame) as that helped with washing bottles and preparing baby meals. When it came to throwing out diapers, the staff was very helpful in directing us to a dumpster right outside the hotel that we could dispose our garbage of daily.
We used a carrier for our entire stay. There's no way you can use a stroller up the steep cobble steps or through the busy markets. We also highly recommend dining at Mivan Restaurant - they have the most fantastic Iskender Kabab! Istanbul was a beautiful experience thanks to our hosts. We will be back!!!

My wife and I stayed at this location in room 201 for 5 nights.
Besides the friendly staff and fast check-in, there’s nothing else to go for and I’ll break the list down:
- Location is somehow okay-ish, hidden between other buildings and easy to miss sometimes.
- The studio was horrible!!! Natural light was close to none!!! The only window of the studio faces the backyard which is a 20 sqm of space shared with other buildings. Additionally, that window is blocked by an emergency ladder. The bedroom is located behind the livingroom that contains the only window.
- Cleanliness: there is mold everwhere! The smell of infiltration and moldy humidity is unbearable. The pillows are extremely stained and dirty. The bathtub (nowhere close to jacuzzi) is out of a horror movie, stained, poorly repaired and falling off.
- Comfort: there’s wires or the TV hanging from the wall in the bedroom. The mattress is absolutely painful by all means: hard as a rock. The pillows are just a chunky piece of plastic shreddings and dust, I still have neck pain and back pain from them, couldn’t sleep for 2 straight hours without waking up.
- Climate: the controller for the AC was missing and eitherway it was very cold at night. We wanted to turn on the heat but there is no climate control. We’ve even tried to open the radiators but they are locked in wooden cases. We had to sleep with socks and two pairs of long sleeved shirts not to catch a cold.
So to sum it up, if there’s a better option available nearby, just go for the alternative.
This location should be avoided.
Bonus: on Google there were guests previously complaining about people drilling and banging in the walls and that was months ago. Apparently it’s still going on.

An apartment unlike any other, with a real concept of urban and grovy art, this family business will get your imagination going straight from the get go.
An always warm and welcoming atmosphere with Turkish tea or coffee on the house to quench any thirst you may have.
Great service all round
Comfortable beds, clean bathroom and a cleverly designed kitchen
You can't go wrong with its location, in the heart of the European tourist side, close to every ammintie possible
All in all
Image 9/10
Price 10/10
Location 9/10
Customer service 10/10

description: We would like to welcome you as best we can to our villa, which is within walking distance of the blue flag beach of Ağlayankalar, which the masses visit for the view and its special story, to give you unforgettable memories.

reviews.text: Mustafa's place was fantastic! It's in a great location, just a short walk to the sea, making it perfect for a relaxing getaway. The apartment was clean and comfortable, exactly as described. Mustafa is an amazing host—he replies quickly and is always willing to help with any issue. Highly recommend staying here!
Great location 5 min walk to a nice beach. The house is a little dated but comfortable enough, plenty of room. The host was very responsive and helpful. We had a lovely holiday there.

Üç kişi ve iki köpeğimizle konakladık; köpeklerimizden biri oldukça büyük ve ev 1+1 olmasına rağmen kullanışlı yapısıyla hepimiz için gayet rahattı. Bahçe, hayvanlarıyla seyahat edenler için gerçekten güzel ve yeterliydi. Üst katta aynı aileye ait başka bir konaklama alanı bulunduğu için zaman zaman bahçeden geçiş olabiliyor; büyük köpekle geleceklerin buna dikkat etmesi iyi olabilir. Ev sahipleri çok ilgili, cana yakın ve yardımseverdi; rahat etmemiz için ellerinden geleni yaptılar. Bahçelerinden topladıkları meyve ve sebzelerden bize de ikram etmeleri ayrıca çok hoştu. Konum olarak denize yakın olması da avantajdı. Yatak odasında hafif bir nem hissettik; biraz daha iyi havalandırılabilirse çok daha güzel olabilir. Genel olarak konaklamamızdan oldukça memnun kaldık.

Mustafa is such a helpful and gracious host. He answered my questions fast and gave me a lot of recommendations for local amenities. Without his help our stay would be more challenging.
His villa is great, clean, plenty of supplies. Kitchen is well stocked with necessary cooking stuff.
There were three of us and we enjoyed our stay tremendously. Thank you!

çok nazik bir aile. girişte bizi karşılamalarından çıkışa kadar her türlü yardımcı oldular. konaklama yeri temiz sessiz sakin bir yerdi. plaja 5 dk yürüme mesafesinde bir cafe vardı yakında oranın hemen dibinde merdivenler var tek bir merdivenle direk sahildesiniz. belki tek negatif durum olarak çarşıya uzaklığı söylenebilir ama zaten konaklama yerinin konumu gayet net diye düşünüyorum. beklentilerimi fazlasıyla karşıladı. hersey için teşekkür ederiz :))

description:
The apartment is located in Bomonti, right in the center of Şişli, one of the most stylish and oldest bohemian districts of Istanbul. It is surrounded by many cool restaurants, cafes, bars, art galleries, parks, grocery stores, etc.
Enjoy a stylish experience at Bomonti. A cozy cute 1 +1 with ample space to enjoy! offer prime city-center living with spacious, modern designs, and amenities such as 24/7 security, fitness centers, pools, and smart home features.

reviews.text:
The apartment was great! It had a lot of amenities and was comfortable for a family of four. The apartment was very clean and well maintained.
It had a 24h reception/security by the entrance, a public space with a gym, sauna and a swimmingpool.
The host was very attentfull to provide us with waterbottles and a welcoming present. She was highly responsive to our questions.
Our first impression was that the apartment was located in a remote neighbourhood and far from mayor tourist attraction. But in fact the neighbourhood is well served by public transport, even an subwaystation in walking distances. It cost only 30 minutes to travel from
the apartment to Taksim, Grand Bazar and even less to Galata district. The lively neighbours also offer a lot of shopping and dinning opportunities. This makes the apartment the ideal choice for someone who want to visit the busy tourist hotspots and wants the option to retreat to a more quiet surroundings.
I highly recommend the apartment!

Nilüfer is a great host and very accomodating, communicated well since reservation until check out time.
We love the apartment building and the facilities it offers, secure building and area, convenience stores nearby.
The unit itself is impeccably clean, good sized apartment to accomodate for two, I would say.
Plenty of storage, comfortable bed and furnishings. Well equipped kitchen and bathroom.
It is a bit of a walk to the metro station or bus station if you want to go to other neighborhoods in Istanbul, but we feel really safe in this area compared to other more touristy neighborhoods I have stayed in.
Highly recommend this place! Thank you Nilüfer for being an amazing host.

Nilufer's place is charming, comfortable and clean.
Very central location with lots of restaurants, shops and easy access to pubic transport to explore the various attractions in the city.
The apartment is quite, with a functional kitchen, wifi and air conditioning.
The font door is managed by security and felt very safe at all times.
Nilufer is a great host and will reply to any messages promptly.
Would happily stay again.

The property fully matched its description in the listing. Its location is excellent, conveniently situated near a taxi hub, with numerous restaurants and shopping options within close proximity. The metro is also easily accessible. I appreciated that the kitchen was fully equipped, with ample cookware and a variety of seasonings available. It provided everything needed for meal preparation and contributed to a comfortable, home-like atmosphere would certainly consider staying here again. Harika bir deneyim için teşekkür ederim.

This is a wonderful apartment in a great neighbourhood. The building has security and all other amenities, such as a gym and a pool. The apartment is perfectly appointed, clean and quiet. Photos accurately represent the flat. Nilüfer is a very responsive host. It could not be better.

description:
We are Mayer Property Mngmt company with over 90 apts in our portfolio. Our 2Br apt in the city center is located in a newly built Skycon residence Fulya/Besiktas and has easy access to all attractions, hip restaurants & cafes in its neighborhood. The apt is 90 sqm and well designed for our guest's needs: 2 bedrooms, kitchen with all appliances and utilities, a large living room w/ Balcony, and a bathroom with a hairdryer and washing machine.
We look forward to hosting you here.

reviews.text: Great apartment! Pretty spacious which is what I was looking for. Looked like the pictures. Quiet part of town. Hosts were also so quick to respond if I ever needed something or had any questions! It does get a little warm in the bedroom at night because the AC is in living room and I love sleeping in a cold room. Overall, would recommend this apartment to others!

Just got back from Istanbul and stayed at Mayer’s place. The flat is amazing. It’s very spacious and very clean. It’s exactly as shown on the pictures.
Communication with the host was very easy, they are very responsive and helpful!
A Very Big Thank you to their helper- Mr Hassan! He is amazing and helped us a lot!
Overall 5* experience. Thank you so much! See you next time! ☺️
Clean, comfortable and smelled great. Gladly again!
Unfortunately, the elevator hasn’t been working for the all nights of stays which is 10 days! If will not be working the hostess should inform me however, I told the hostess from the first night.
Harika mükemmel temiz merkezi konum yeni apartman

description:
Experience a unique stay at the heart of Istanbul!

This booking offers a stylish apartment on the top floor with a clear city skyline view from private terrace.

Located in Pera, you will enjoy easy access to the famous Istiklal Street, prestigious Pera Museum, historic Galata Tower, vibrant nightlife, and convenient public transit options, all just minutes away.

Featuring a useful private kitchen, high-end essentials, daily cleaning, and concierge services, we ensure a memorable vacation!

reviews.text: Check-in was straight forward. The building is well located 3 blocks away from Istiklal st. However there is a major heavily trafficked avenue to cross before getting to Istiklal st. A lot of shopping, restaurants, taxis and everything else is there. The apartment is quiet, nicely furnished, the mattress is comfortable, the wifi is strong and reliable, there are 2 TV's but cable/satelite wasn't readily availble. The Tv upstairs is mounted on a fixed Tv bracket which doesn't allow to be seen from the bed. There is no elevator, no microwave, no washing machine, no broom...the apartment is on the 4th floor, challenging with suitcases. Daily cleaning is provided but we like our privacy and I wish it was at least a broom to do my own quick cleaning. Overall, I am a bit disappointed with this apartment because they could easily fix the flaws that I mentionned and the description doesn't say anything about the stairs. I went there with my mom, she 75 y/o. Not recommended for extended stays.

At first we struggle a bit to find the apartment,since it’s slightly hidden in the inner yard.Other than that the check in went very smoothly.The apartment is nice,spacious and clean, although you can see,that it hasn’t been freshly refurbished.The terrace view is very beautiful.There are 6 chairs and a big table,and unfortunately only one sun-bed for the terrace.There are also no hangers for the towels in the bathroom,which was uncomfortable for us.
The only,and unfortunately huge downside was the internet.For three days we didn’t have it at all,and we had to buy our own,otherwise we wouldn’t be able to do nor search anything.The host was very responsive and tried her best to resolve the situation.
The apartment is situated in a very good and safe neighbourhood,which I can definitely recommend.Generally is calm,but a step away from all its attractions.
A complimentary (and delicious) coffee, tea, sugar and 4 small bottled water awaited upon our arrival which was very nice :)

This is a great place in a very ideal location. As other guests have mentioned there are a few stairs to climb and the entry app isn’t easy to setup the first time.
The apartment has a brilliant view over the city with comfortable beds.
There is limited utensils and cleaning equipment, so don’t expect to cook or clean unless you buy the equipment yourself. The apartment is also pretty noisy and you can hear everything in the corridor.
Otherwise this is a good location to get you to the nice area of Pera and tourist attractions.

We spent five nights in this lovely apartment, beautifully clean, with a large terrace for sunsets over the city. Lots of stairs but no worries if you are fit. Well worth the effort, for the peace and privacy. Cooking facilities are basic and could be easily updated, (as we enjoy trying local produce). Ideal walking location at the heart of Beyoglu and its magical cultural variety, backstreets, restaurants, Golden Horn ferries etc. Definitely a place to return to!
Thank you
Arthur

Highly recommend this bnb! Very clean, interior design was good, no noise from the street. If you have heavy luggage, just be mindful you have to take several flights of stairs, as the room is at the top of the building. Irem was also extra helpful. My check-in baggage got delayed at my layover airport, so some coordination was needed with the Istanbul airport. Irem was a huge help communicating with them.

description:
Immerse in beauty of Grace Galata; frescoes and high ceilings, that make you feel in palace, while comfortable and cosy ambiance w/ wood decoration will warm your heart.
Located in beautiful Serdari Ekrem street next to Galata Tower, you would enjoy being in historical/cultural center, and treat yourselves in lively neighborhood of cafes/restaurants. Here in this graceful heritage flat, you will find a spacious living room, 2 bedrooms, full kitchen, full bathroom and amenities for your comfort.

reviews.text:
A big thank you to Zeyno for being a fantastic host. Not only was the apartment as described, he was very proactive, responsive and accommodating of our requests.
The apartment itself is furnished to a high standard, very clean, cosy and comfortable with top quality amenities.
The location is great with easy access to supermarkets, public transport, restaurants and right next to the Galata Tower.
Accessibility- The apartment is located on the first floor that requires use of stairs. The walk to the tram / metro stations while a short distance is not on a flat surface. Could be a concern for someone with mobility challenges. Having said that it’s easy to get an uber/ taxi pre booked to meet you at the door step.
We enjoyed our stay. The place is safe. No problem getting an Uber for a late night departure to the airport.

We had a great stay and would recommend it! The host was very helpful and responsive whenever we had questions. If you are a parent this place made our stay much easier than a hotel.
My review will try to be helpful for parents. Stayed here with my 3 year old and 10 month old.
They had a crib and the extra space was helpful for downtime.
Modern conveniences: Air conditioning, dishwasher, washer and dryer all made it a comfortable stay.
The kitchen made it very convenient to quickly prep snacks for my 3 year old.
There’s a small grocery store next door and makes it easy to grab anything you might need: bread, milk, eggs, diapers, wipes etc.
The apartment is up 1 flight of stairs with no elevator. This seems to be the case anywhere you stay.
Many of the streets nearby are cobblestone so take a stroller with larger wheels. Our bugaboo butterfly travel stroller really struggled.
Overall very positive stay!

It’s a great location especially for young groups. There’s a grocery store right next to the place which was a lifesaver!
The appliances are brand new and work great. This place has air conditioning which worked great. Shower and water pressure was great.
Our apartment was on the first floor ( one flight of stairs) which I didn’t realize when I booked the place but luckily my mom was able to go up and down the stairs.
In our experience, it was a bit tight for 4 people but comfortable enough for 3.

This area of Istanbul is very crowded during all hours of day and night so if you mind the noise and cigarettes smell coming through the window at night you might look elsewhere. Luckily we were so tired of activities during the days that we slept through the night mostly.
Taxis are able to come to the door which was a lifesaver because for my mom, we had to use uber a lot.
Zeyno was very responsive whenever I had a question both via text or call which was really helpful! Thank you!😊

We had a great time - the location is ideal for tourists such as ourselves. Easy to locate (just look for Galata tower!). Having a grocery store downstairs is very convenient. The apartment was very clean, and having amenities such as a washer/dryer were super helpful for packing light. And the AC was always cold after a long day in the sun :)

This was a great place for our family!
The bedrooms and sofa bed gave us plenty of space, the bathroom was lovely, and the kitchen well equipped for the little that we needed.
The location was great - steps from Galata tower, public transport easily accessible. But we actually walked almost everywhere - it was a very convenient area for lots of the main sites!
Zeyno was super helpful and lovely. Really clear instructions and helpful tips when the weather changed. And she was super helpful in arranging an airport transfer for us when we landed.
We'd definitely recommend this place!

description: Experience the convenience in our cozy one-bedroom apartment located in the heart of Nisantasi, Istanbul’s most sought-after district. Enjoy being just steps away from high-end shopping and gourmet dining right across the street. You can easily reach the apartment on foot. Osmanbey underground station is just a 2-min. walk away, offering direct access to city’s main attractions — Taksim Square is one stop away, and the Old City is five stops away.

reviews.text: Uygar was a great host! I would stay there again the next time I come to Istanbul. As others have said, there is some foot traffic noise from upstairs, but it was easily remedied by wearing earplugs when I slept. Uygar was super responsive to all my messages. Due to no fault of Uygar's, there was a problem with the gas line in the neighborhood. That left me without hot water one day. But he communicated what was happening, what caused it, when it would be fixed, and he conveyed his apologies and made up for it in other ways. The location is great - convenience stores and coffeeshops are nearby, and the Metro station is less than five minutes away.

'Cozy' is the best way to describe this apartment. Even though the size is small, the layout and arrangement of the furniture makes it feel larger - and very comfortable and pleasant. Situated in a picturesque residential street, it is perfectly reachable via public transport (if you take the Lotus mall back entrance, the subway is almost at your doorstep - not that you'd see it). The only minor downside... the ceiling feels paper thin, which accounts for a certain sound level from upstairs, if people are walking there. that being said, I had no problem with it and slept perfectly well. - Will be happy to return.
The place looked just like the photos. The location was great, and the house was clean. I definitely recommend Uygar’s house.

Uygar was such a great host, very welcoming and helpful. The apartment was clean, cozy, and perfectly located in the heart of the neighborhood. Everything went smoothly, and I’d definitely come back again!

I would just like to say if you are looking for the most ideal central place in Nişantaşı to stay, this really is it. You do not get any more central than this location. You can access every part of Nişantaşı within five minutes walk. You also have Lotus Walk on your doorstep.
The AirBnb was very cosy for one person and would certainly be suitable for two. I was also able to create a very nice desk space with the extendable table in the window bay (great for working solo) over looking the street. Halaskargazi is a very pleasant neighbourhood too.
Just be conscious taxi/uber can sometimes not access the street as it is mostly pedestrianised - which is also a blessing as it keeps the noise and typical road chaos to ZERO. Just make sure you have a good/VIP driver to help you with your cases if you have many.
I would absolutely stay here again and Uygar was great to be hosted by.
Teşekkürler Ugyar!

description: This special place is close to everything, making it easy to plan your visit.

reviews.text:
This is a nice place and we enjoyed our stay overall, but it did not match the listing photos, which was very unusual for an Airbnb. There are many units in the building.
Several items shown in the photos (table, plants, shower gel, etc.) were missing. The kitchen was also improperly stocked: very few utensils, no spatula or wooden spoon. There were also no dishwashing supplies at first, though they were provided after we asked.
The living room chair was broken upon arrival, and the couch was stained (we requested a sheet to cover it). The hosts were responsive, but ideally guests shouldn’t have to take inventory and request multiple basics on day one. I would recommend the hosts focus more on the details and how the space is used from a guest perspective.
That said, we appreciated the building amenities (gym, sauna, pool), secure entrance, high ceilings, and Burak’s hospitality. Just expect to make several requests on the first day.

Good apartment in a modern building. The agency manages more apartments so your apartment might look different than the photos.
The apartment are good even though they have clear signs of wear and tear that haven't been addressed.
The internet is good for remote working, the host is available and responsive.
The building has a small internal market that is very handy.
It is not right in the center and the walk toward the center is about 7/8 minutes uphill but doable.
Overall it's a good stay.
The place looks exactly like the photos, very clean and comfortable. Had a great stay

The apartment is so clean, modern, and amazing. It is so comfortable and not even a single issue inside of it. The building is so clean and the gym and pool are amazing as well.
Regarding the host Mr. Burak, He is such an amazing friendly person who helped me with everything he responds fast always thank you Mr Burak

The apartment is spacious and clean. Burak is an extremely hospitable and friendly host. For the commute, it's best to learn the bus lines to iplikçi station, that is 2 minutes walk from the apartment. Recommended.

description:
Our flat is in the middle of culture, entertainment and shopping centers. We are just a few steps away from public transportation points such as metro, metrobus, ferry and historical tram.

Our flat consists of 1 bedroom, 1 living room + full kitchen, bathroom + WC and a small balcony.
There is a strong internet network specific to the flat. There is a smart TV, ceiling fan in the living room and AC in the bedroom.

You will feel at home in this stylish apartment in the center of Kadıköy.

reviews.text:
The apartment is just great, everything is as in the photos. We checked in easily, host gave us clear instructions so we had no problems to find a building and our apartment. Our place was very clean and well prepared for us, kitchen is fully equipped, bed is very comfortable, there's always hot water and good water pressure that was very important
for us. The price is affordable and just great for this location. One detail I need to mention — it might be noisy at the nighttime because of the restaurants around, it wasn't problem for us at all but it can be important to know for someone who needs a quite place to fall asleep. I would definitely recommend this apartment! Thank you so much for everything!

The apartment is in a great location, right in the center of Kadikoy. Many great spots are just a few minutes away, and it’s a short walk to the ferry or metro. The apartment was exactly as described — everything we needed was there. The shower was great, with no leaks and good water pressure, which is not so common in Istanbul. :-) The place is bright, spacious enough for two people, and quiet at night even though it’s close to a few bars. Everything was very clean, and the kitchen had all the amenities we needed. Communication was excellent. We were very pleased and hope to come again.

We really enjoyed our stay here! The apartment is modern, clean and has everything you need. The Wi-Fi is fast and worked perfectly. We especially loved having our own kitchen — it was really nice to cook our breakfasts, just like at home :)
The location is amazing, right in the heart of Kadıköy. We really liked that the apartment is not above loud bars, but above local places where people play Okey. Even on weekends the noise was totally manageable, and with the windows closed it didn’t bother us at all (unless you need complete silence to sleep!).
Bülent was a great host and always replied quickly whenever we had a question.
We had a great time and would definitely recommend Bülent’s place! Ferries and public transport are just a 10-minute walk away, so exploring Istanbul is super easy.

Location: great, convenient, minutes from the Pier to commute to the other sides of İstanbul. Lots of bars, pubs, shops, everything. Note: its busy, bright and noisy. So know what you're getting into.
The place: Feels cozy, comfortable. Soft lights. AC in the bedroom is a great plus.
Host: There were some problems that came up and the host was very fast at responding and making sure I feel comfortable. Big props to the host!
Bed: I'm a sensitive sleeper so IMO wasn't the best, he mattress feels old and the pillows feel odd - too soft and old I feel like.
Great kitchen.

Wonderful apartment in Kadikoy. The street is quiet since there’s no car traffic. The apartment is on the third floor, and it’s easy to walk up. The renovation is modern, and the bed is comfortable. The host was always available and responsive. The kitchen had everything needed for cooking.
The only downside was the lack of a wardrobe in the bedroom, which made storing clothes a bit inconvenient.
Overall, definitely a 5-star stay.

description: The property combines a spacious 3-room suite with an additional ensuite on the same floor, offering both comfort and privacy for larger groups. 🏡 Recently renovated with care, this prestigious apartment is designed to feel like home while letting you experience the magic of Istanbul. 🌆 Nestled in lively Karaköy, Beyoğlu, it welcomes you with a wide, sun-filled living room, colorful and stylish décor, and windows that open to breathtaking Bosphorus views 🌊, and the historic city skyline 🕌.

reviews.text: This flat is extremely central and well located, albeit off a very busy commuter street. It's generously proportioned and feels larger than it looks in the pictures. Each of the rooms was clean, and spacious and the beds were all comfortable. Access into to the flat was straightforward and easy. One of the rooms and toilets is outside the main flat and had to be accessed via the corridor with a separate key, which we still found useful as a second toilet. Ibraham our host was very responsive and helpful, he fixed the elevator when it stopped working, showed us how to use the laundry machine, and ordered us a taxi for an early morning transfer. We had a great stay.

We enjoyed our stay in this apartment. Location is fantastic. It is a short walk to the Galata Tower (up a very steep hill!) and an even shorter walk to the Karaköy tram station and ferry port. It is also only around a 30min walk to Sultanahmet. The apartment itself was spacious and clean. We enjoyed that there were toiletries and cleaning items in the kitchen. The layout of the apartment with one bedroom and one bathroom being outside of the main apartment is less ideal for big groups however, as it means three bedrooms effectively share one bathroom. The bedrooms would also benefit from blackout blinds and/or heavy curtains as the apartment is located on a busy road with some bright signage outside and this would help to block the noise and light. Communication with the hosts was great - they sent clear instructions for finding and entering the property and we're quick to respond to a small maintenance issue during our stay.

The place was composed of two different apartments - one larger with 3 bedrooms, living room, kitchen and a bathroom, and the other a single bedroom with a bathroom. Very spatious, nice and simple decor, had all the necassary furniture. We were a large family and we had a great time there, everyone liked the apartment overall, it was nice to use the living room and the dining table.
Neighborhoud: entrance is from a busy main road, but the location is great because its a few minutes walk from the two bridges, the karakoy ferry and galata tower.
Positives: stunning view, and a very nice and clear layout, clearly sepretared bedrooms, convenient location
To improve: the small apartment’s bathroom wall did not go all the way to the ceiling - the bedroom and toilet had no acoustic seperation - so we had to leave the bedroom window open for ventilation after using the bathroom. Was not a big issue for us, but something to consider.

very easy to find and check in was very simple due to step by step instructions with photos. Apartment is like the photos and having a bed with ensuite seperate to the main apartment is great for the early sleepers. Only downside is the street is very vehicle heavy and you can hear the traffic other than that you can walk to everything which is great. Istanbul has lots of hills so be prepared!
My family had a great stay. The place was clean, comfortable, and just as described. The host communicated clearly and promptly, which made everything easy. We’d definitely recommend staying here!

description:
A few minutes walk from the Hagia Sophia mosque, Sultanahmet Mosque and Topkapi Palace. 15min walk to the Grand Bazaar. It's on a quiet touristy street.

Both rooms have their own toilets and bathrooms.

The beds are optionally 4 single beds,
It can be arranged with 2 double beds or 1 double bed and 2 single beds.

Our apartment building was taken into maintenance and restored in July 2026, and its deficiencies were corrected.

reviews.text: The place is just like in the pictures and really perfectly located, in a nice area and very close to most places of interest. In general, the room was clean and comfortable. A couple of things that are worth noting are that the beds are quite short and the kitchen (outside the room) is not private but also used by other guests. We had some difficulties with communication before check out (we couldn't reach the host via messages for several hours) but could finally solve them. All in all, it's a good option to stay in Istanbul especially considering the good price and the great location.

Place:
Awesome stay! Room was spotless clean and was exactly what we were looking for our 1 week stay in Istanbul. Kitchen was fully equipped with all the essentials.
Location:
The place was in a great quiet location and it felt pretty safe, even at 1AM that we were returning every night. Multiple hotels and small groceries stores around open until late night, so you always see people around.
Host:
Kemal was really friendly and waited for our arrival even though it was a bit late at night. He quickly explained us the areas around, how to move, where to shop and what we can do while we are there, which was so kind of him! He also had some souvenirs and raki for us! A great, happy and really responsive host!
I would totally recommend Kemal’s place!

great place to stay only five minutes walk from the blue mosque and hippodrome. the room is clean and quiet , and the small kitchen was clean with clean fridge.
Kemal was helpful and responsive and arranged a taxi transfer for us from the airport . he also allowed us a late check out which was super helpful.
r

We stayed at Kemal's apartment in Fatih for 5 nights. It was comfortable and clean. It is a few minutes walk to the hippodrome and the major attractions like blue mosque, Hagia Sophia, Basilica cisterns, topkapi palace. There were many eating places close to the apartment. We enjoyed our stay, Kemal was an excellent host, and we recommend staying in his apartment.

Nice apartments with an excellent price-to-value ratio.
The bedroom and bathroom look exactly like in the photos. My stay was too short to make use of the kitchen and laundry facilities (shared with another suite). Sound insulation is good, and the blackout curtains work perfectly. The Wi-Fi is excellent. There is also a work desk in the bedroom, which is convenient if you need to use a laptop.

description: This brand-new ground-floor apartment is in a hotel in central Şişli, Istanbul. It includes a double bed, pull-out sofa, fully equipped kitchen, private bathroom, and dining table with three chairs. The hotel has 24-hour reception and complimentary cleaning every two days. Opened on October 28, 2024, the apartment provides a comfortable stay in the city center. You can reach everywhere at around what you need during your stay.

reviews.text: The apartment was very clean and well prepared. The staff were super kind and helpful, which made the stay even better. The location is excellent, very central and convenient for getting around. We felt comfortable and safe during our stay. Highly recommended! 🌟

3 gün konakladım. Giriş kolaydı, konumdan memnun kaldım ve zemin kat olması benim için sorun olmadı. Ev sahibi geç girişime rağmen çok yardımcıydı. Ancak klimada ısıtma konusunda bir sorun vardı ve temizlikte bazı küçük eksikler (saç gibi) göze çarpıyordu, biraz daha özenli olabilirdi.
Spacious and clean. Owner is understanding and helpful. Location is central and next to amazing places. Excellent stay!
nice location, great service. apartments were clean. we enjoyed staying there. thank you
Tertemizdi ve tüm ev aletleri çalışır durumdaydı. İçimiz rahat konakladık. Her şey düşünülmüş ve temin edilmişti.

description: You'll have a lovely time at this cheerful getaway.

reviews.text: 4 gece kaldık. Eğer bütçeniz uygun değilse kesinlikle tavsiye ederim. Bu fiyatlara sokakta kalamazsınız. Ama 1 tane türk personel vardı gerisi yabancıydı ve o türk yokken iletişim kurmak zordu, ama yardımcı olmaya çalışıyorlar. Otele girdiğimizde resimlerden farklı bir oda verilmişti, çalışan arkadaş yardımcı oldu gördüğümüz odaya geçtik. Otelin bir güvenliği yok resepsiyonist girişte uyuyor geceleri. Gecenin ikisinde bizim sipariş vermediğimiz bir firmanın kuryesinin kapıyı çalması ve tavuk şiş sizin miydi diye sorması çok saçma bir durum ama genel olarak memnun kaldık. Otel temizdi. Geceleri otelin çevresi çok tenha, metrobüse 10 dakikada yürüyerek varabiliyorsunuz. Bütçesi olmayan arkadaşlara tavsiye ederim.

Her şeyden önce kendinizi güvende hissedeceğiniz bir yer. Neden mi ? Hotelden çıktıktan hemen sonra arkamızdan temizlik görevlisi olan hanımefendi odada unuttuğum cüzdanı bi koşu heyecan içinde gelip verdi. 1 saniye bile kötü düşüncesi olmadığını yüzünden ve tavrından anladım. Alnının teriyle işini yapıyor. Arkasından resepsiyondaki çalışan hanımefendiye bir miktar parayı ona vermesi için ısrarla uzattığımda kendisi sadece şunları söyledi; "bu bizim görevimiz, bunun için buradayız". bu sözden sonra nasıl bir yerde kaldığımı daha iyi anladım. Duygusal olarak baktığınızda 10/10 luk yer. Buradan tekrar teşekkür ederim. Ayrıca tam fiyat performans hoteli.
otel çok temiz ve güzeldi fakat semt olarak çok sesliydi ve tuvaletten sürekli tesisat sesi geliyordu o çok rahatsız etti onun dışında gayet fiyat performanstı

Odalar vs. temizdi
iletişim çok iyi teşekkür ederiz bence sadece fiyat biraz yuksek onun dışında gayet iyi
very clean , nice room , quiet , I do recommend this hotel it's cozy ,nice , comfortable.

description: This is a cozy private room with ensuite bathroom, located in the quiet part of Sultanahmet area. You can easily reach the main square within 5-6 mins on foot, and have the chance to visit all the major attractions of the Old City. There are many places around where you can have breakfast. Also, we have a 24/7 front desk agent to assist you with anything you might need.

reviews.text:
Safe and very convenient for the single traveller - my first time to Istanbul, my priorities were the historic sites of the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace - on the map I could see they were nearby (the blue mosque is in the background of a photo taken from the terrace) - but on arrival I was rapt to discover I was right below that area - its a leisurely ten minute walk on a safe, busy street to get to the square.
From the square there is a tram stop, but I used the hop on hop off bus to get round and both the red and blue lines stop at the square. Also located there is the Istanbul Archeological Museum, a small bazaar, the mosaic museum, the carpet museum - and with the Grand Bazaar approximately 15 minutes away I spent the majority of the first two days less than 15 minuts walk away from the hotel.
The hotel itself is small, four floors and a total of 20 rooms, plus a top floor cafe with a terrace facing the mosque and a small balcony facing the Bosphorus Straight - the front desk was always manned and the staff were friendly and helpful - when I checked in I was told to be careful of strangers in the street offering hospitality (come check out this bar etc), it was nothing to do with the area, more just something that happens in Istanbul, it did happen and being forwarned I always had somewhere else to be etc, I appreciated the advice.
The rooms are clean, a good size with a small fridge, and the hotel is set back from the busy main street so its quiet and the neighouring buildings are small restaurants and a minimarket - really useful stuff.
I wouldn't hesitate to use Deniz Houses again - Istanbul is amazing, it was nice to have somewhere so convenient to everything I wanted to see, I felt safe and really enjoyed my stay.

The location of the hotel is perfect. Quiet and peaceful neighbourhood as well as very close to important tourist spots such as Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque (about 10 mins walk). Check-in time is quite flexible and there is always someone at the reception desk, which facilitates any queries one may have. The staff is very friendly and helpful. The room was cleaned, well organised and the amenities offered were as expected. For the price, this is a great spot to be in. We definitely recommend it for future visits. Thank you Alihan!
Great location in old city, good value and helpful staff. Room was clean and comfortable. I recommend it to others.

Great location, easy to find. Beds comfy. Just the sound from the trains and taxi’s honking is a bit annoying, but i tried to drown it.
Cleanliness good, space was good and quaint. Stayed in room 16 with sea view and balcony. It was a nice touch. I especially liked the information pictures on each staircase.
This place really tries to help you with whatever you do! So make sure you book here because the hospitality is outstanding

Alihan was a very helpful and friendly host. The place is a good location for the walk to famous sites-the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Topkapi Palace. All within 15 minutes of walking distance. A bit of a challenge for my knee in the stairs walk-up to the room. Excellent little spot on the rooftop for breakfast. Very pleasant and relaxing. I enjoyed having breakfast three times on the rooftop. A lot of walking did me very good. Alihan and the hotel staff were very kind and helpful.

description: Experience the charm of Istanbul from our bright, stylish penthouse in the heart of the Galata Beyoğlu district. Perfectly situated, this one-bedroom retreat boasts a spacious terrace offering breathtaking panoramic views of the Bosphorus. With three cozy beds, it’s ideal for couples, families, or small groups looking to create unforgettable memories in this vibrant city. Equipped with Wi-Fi and AC this is your home away from home. There is an espresso and filter coffee machine in our apartment

reviews.text:
Wow, the other reviews said it, but the amazing penthouse view cannot be understated. After the crowded density of Istanbul, especially the tourist areas, having this spot to look out over it all was such a welcome breath of fresh air, literally. The terrace is uniquely located so it has one of the best views in the whole Galata area, and it truly enhanced our trip experience to start and end our days looking out over the city.
The apartment itself is clean, attractive, airy, and spacious. Both the bed and living room daybed were very comfortable, and everything worked well. Check-in and communication were fast, responsive, and kind. Adam even sent help for us to bring our luggage up the many flights of stairs to the penthouse. Tourist attractions were within easy walking or transit distance, but the building is on a chill side street that felt much more peaceful and secluded.
A gem in old Istanbul, highly recommend!

Loved staying here at this apartment -- well worth the 6 flights of stairs! It was a peaceful oasis in the middle of the chaos that is Istanbul. We especially liked the terrace and the views! The furnishings are stylish; we liked having a washer and dryer; kitchen has the basics, but as others have noted, you need to buy drinking water and haul it up the stairs. We found the extra towels and blankets under the mattress of the bed in the bedroom. Adam was very communicative and helpful. We were there in October when the temperature was moderate, I don't know how hot or cold it gets in other seasons.

This place is really amazing as far as location and layout. The view is really what makes it so incredible. Keep in mind there are 6 flights of stairs to get to the apartment but it's perhaps the best view of the city, so it was very worth it to us. Adam and another man were really really kind and helped us up the stairs with our heavy bags. Water pressure, hot water, and wifi were all great. The tap is not drinkable so Adam brought us a couple small bottles, but you'll need large jugs.
The downside to this place is no one actually lives there, so the amenities are super bare. Nothing is of good quality and it's lacking some things that would make it a 5-star stay––nicer quality towels and more of them, blankets, extra pillows, pods for the Nespresso machine (it's worthless otherwise), a filter for drinking water so you don't have to keep going to the store for jugs, a knife to cut food. Make it feel like a home and it won't feel like the place is an afterthought.

Fantastic stay at Begum's place . The roof deck is absolutely worth climbing the stairs to the top of the building. Great communication and perfect location for exploring Istanbul. Quite peaceful despite the very busy Galata Tower area just a block away. Nice sotres and restaurants in proximity. The Tophane train station is right down the hill and gives access to the markets in the AyaSophia neighborhood. Definitely recommend taking the ferry at Karakoy over to the Asian side to the Moda area - fantastic views and just one Dollar!

Altı kat merdivenden sonra harika bir manzara karşılıyor sizi terasta, kesinlikle nefes nefese kaldığınıza değer. Evin içi güzel ve ferah, banyo, yataklar, koltuklar ve teras temizdi. Sadece yatak odasında klima ile aynı anda ışık veya prizi kullanamıyorsunuz, elektrik tesisatında ufak bir sorun var. Onun dışında tüm o hengame ve karmaşanın ortasında mahrem bir alan sunuyor size. İstanbul'u rahatça gezip, konaklayabileceğiniz en güzel manzaralı evlerden biri. Klimayı çalıştıramasak da kapı ve camları açarak oldukça ferahladık, boğazın serinliği içerideydi.

description: Newly built and stylish studio apartment located only one minute from Osmanbey Metro, constructed with earthquake-reinforced infrastructure for safety and comfort. Fully furnished with brand-new items, including a smart TV, AC, washing machine, compact kitchen, and natural gas heating. Modern bathroom, elevator access, and perfect central location near Nişantaşı and Bomonti.

reviews.text: The place was truly amazing.Everything was just like in the photos, even better. It was perfectly clean, and the location was very convenient and easy to reach. The host was very kind and helpful in every way. I would definitely love to come back.

Clean, warm, modern apartment near metro station. Simple grocery store as well as plenty of cafes nearby. clear instructions from host on how to find and checkin. The host kindly organised a transfer to airport for me the morning i had early checkout.
Great spot, stylish and comfortable. Perfect location and smooth communication with the host. Would totally stay again!
This is the perfect studio for 1 person. Comfortable bed. Exceptionally clean and new throughout. Very close to Nişantaşı. I would stay again.
Good commucation and response time and great price and location.

description:
Berkmuller in the Heart of Kadıköy;

We are in Caferağa Neighborhood, right in Kadıköy Bazaar, a few steps away from shopping and entertainment.

You can watch the sunset on Moda 1 Coast and easily reach places such as Dorock XL, RocknRolla and Ağaç Ev.

In our rooms, towels, shampoo, shower gel, hair dryer and slippers are available with hotel comfort.

Paid parking is available nearby, there is an İspark on the beach and an İspark parking lot in front of the building.

Note: Ispark is Istanbul's most affordable parking lot.
