reviews.text: as described, the owner is responsive and easy to communicate with. Good for price in the kadikoy, near to central area.

I had no wifi for the 3 days at this hotel. There was a friendly Assistant who did her best to resolve the issues I had. She was very responsive and kind. The bedsheets had a smell to them unfortunately. The room wasn’t the cleanest either. At night it was very loud full of laughter and shouting till 2am!!

Duş tıkanıktı, duştaki su klozetin olduğu kısma taştı çünkü duşa kabinde delik vardı. sıcak su uzun süre bekleyince akıyor, o da ya çok sıcak ya da çok soğuk. yatakta inşaat tozları,kıllar vardı. verilen süreden daha geç giriş yapmama rağmen giriş yaparken yaklaşık 45 dakika ayakta bekletildim bir açıklama yapılmadan. Girişte resepsiyon olmadığı için iletişim kopukluğu fazla oluyor ve anahtar alımı ev bırakmada bekletildim. Konum olarak güzeldi fakat bu da dışarıdan ses getiriyor.

Yer çok merkeziydi. 2-3 dakikda duraklara ve iskeleye ulaşabildik. Çarşıya ve kafelere yine 3-4 dk mesafedeydi. Odayı düzenli bulduk fotoğraflardaki gibiydi. Biraz küçüklüğünden dolayı hareket etmekte zorlandık ama minik bir detaydı. Ev sahibi eksik gördüğümüz su ısıtıcıyı hemen getirdi. Banyo temizdi, havlular vardı. Tuvalet kağıdı vardı. Temiz ve tozsuz bir odaydı. Kliması ve buzdolabı çalışıyordu. Küçüklüğünden dolayı kıyafet dolabını zor kullandık ve çarşaflar çok temiz gelmedi.
Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Ufak tefek saydığım şeyler dışında hiç bir sorun yaşamadık, hızlı iletişim kurduk, kolay girip çıktık, ev sahibi ilgiliydi. Teşekkür ederiz.

Konum olarak kadıköy çarşıya oldukça yakın ve sakin bir konumdaydı. Ev fotoğraflarda gözüktüğü gibiydi ve açıkcası fiyatının karşılığını verdiğini söyleyebilirim, Çünkü oldukça uygun bir yere göre gayet güzeldi. Oda küçüktü ama ferahtı yani odanın küçük olduğunu çok hissetmiyorsunuz. Dinlenmek ve kafa dağıtmak için güzel bir yer. Tavsiye ederim. Memnun kaldım.

description: The moment you step out of the door of this place, you will find everything you want to discover.Blue Mosque 1 mınute Hagıa Sophia 1 mınute Topkapı palace 1 mınute by walk on the street a lots of restaurants and bar amd market open untıl 4 am

reviews.text: My wife and I had a great stay at Gul Sultan Hotel. From our arrival to our departure, Mr. Hamit was very welcoming and accomodating. He answered all my questions prompltly before we arrived and he arranged our transportation upon request. Our room was Clean, Cozy, and Comfortable. The bedding was super clean. Bathroom and shower are spotless. Location is conveniantly located. We reccomend staying here. Mr. Hamit and team at Gul Sultan were awesome.

A lovely simple hotel at a great location - 5 mins walk to Hagia Sofia and the Blue Mosque. Many restaurants nearby. The hotel is facing an Irish Pub so it does get noisy til the wee hours on Friday and Saturday nights but we managed to sleep (our room window faces the pub).
The area is super touristy and can get very busy.
The room is very clean and just like the pics. Breakfast is not served. Hamit and team are quick to respond to requests and are friendly.
I'd recommend anyone who wants quick access to the two mosques as well as Topkapi Palace to stay here.
Great to be in the area so can get there early!
We loved this hotel, affordable in a fantastic location, spotless, comfortable and very clean!
It’s a really good place to stay, very clean and close to major sightseeing areas. Definitely worth the money
The location is unbeatable, everything is very clean, the service is magnificent, perfect in general, TOTALLY RECOMMENDED

description: Located in the heart of Istanbul, at the intersection of Taksim and Şişli, my hotel combines modern design and comfort. I offer my guests the opportunity to discover the hidden beauties of the city and provide carefully thought-out comfort in every detail. Staying here will make you feel special and at home while experiencing Istanbul's vibrant atmosphere.

reviews.text: kaan bey ve çalışan arkadaş çok kibardı, sifon bozuktu sıkıntı yaşadık yardım ettiler sağolsunlar ama tekrar sıkıntı çıkardı bence bi tesisatçının bakması lazım, duştaki gider tıkalı gibiydi ve yatak çok gıcırdıyodu bir de ses yalıtımı problemi var yan odadakilerin sesini çok fazla duyduk bunlar dışında güzeldi balkonda sabah kahvesi içmek keyifliydi ve küçük olmasına rağmen ferah hissettiren bi odaydı fiyat performans bi konaklama yeri
Konum, temizlik, iletişim gayet iyiydi. Sadece oda biraz küçüktü. Onun dışında hiç bir sorun yaşamadım. Tercih edilebilir.

Otelin konumu, Şişli’de çok merkezi bir yerde. Etrafındaki kafeler, alışveriş merkezleri ve toplu taşıma seçenekleri çok yakın. Otel gayet modern ve odalar oldukça rahat. Ayrıca çalışanlar da oldukça ilgili ve yardımsever. Hem tatil hem iş seyahati için mükemmel bir tercih.
Konumu cok merkezi. Metroya ve otobus duraklarina yakin. Balkon kullanisli. Ev sahibinin iletisimi de gayet iyiydi.
bolgeye gore oldukca sessiz bir konumda, ulasim kolay, ev sahibi çözümler konusunda hızlı ve dost canlısı. çok teşekkür ederiz

description:
Nestled in the historic heart of Balat, the Mihrab Room offers a peaceful retreat just steps away from Istanbul’s vibrant cultural mosaic.
Framed by exposed brick niches and softened by handcrafted details, this space captures spirit of an old city house — serene, shaded, and beautifully cool even on the warmest days.
You’re only a 3-minute walk from the tram line, yet you’ll feel worlds away in this hidden gem that blends Ottoman character with modern comfort. BREAKFAST IS 12 EUROS PER PERSON

reviews.text: In general I had a pleasant stay in Mehmet's apartment. The house was clean enough, although there was a lot of dust in the bedroom. There was an AC for heat on the upper floor where the kitchen was but downstairs there was no heater so it was kinda cold. We also had a problem with the water temperature in the shower. The water was at it's best medium hot and sometimes it immediately became iced cold. The thing that annoyed me the most was that there were empty products to use inside the apartment. Empty hand soap inside the bathroom, a jar with like half a spoon of coffee, only one teabag.. This was disappointing for us. Lastly, Mehmet was responding quick in my messages and he gave us very good instructions to come from the airport and do our check in. Overall, for two nights this apartment was a decent choice for it's money.

We had a very nice stay at Mehmet's place. Mehmet is a very proactive and responsive host and helped us out with any questions and requests. The place looks like the pictures, it was clean and was located in a peaceful street in Balat. The apartment was clean and provided all things needed for a comfortable stay. Would recommend!
The property was located in a pleasant area with easy access to stores. Mehemet is a nice person who is constantly accessible. The property was clean and comfortable, just as the photographs suggest.

Bu konaklama deneyimi beklentilerimizin çok ötesindeydi. Ev tertemiz, son derece düzenli ve fotoğraflarda göründüğünden bile daha güzeldi. İçeri adım attığımız anda her şeyin ne kadar özenle hazırlandığı hissediliyor. Konfor açısından hiçbir eksik yoktu; yataklar çok rahattı ve evde ihtiyacımız olabilecek her şey düşünülmüştü.
Ev sahibi ise inanılmaz ilgili ve nazikti. Tüm sorularımıza hızlıca dönüş yaptı ve konaklamamız boyunca kendimizi gerçekten güvende ve rahat hissetmemizi sağladı. Bölge de oldukça sakin, huzurlu ve ulaşım açısından avantajlıydı.
Kısacası, tekrar gelmek isteyeceğimiz ve gönül rahatlığıyla herkese önereceğimiz bir yer. Bu kadar keyifli bir deneyim yaşattığınız için çok teşekkür ederiz.

Konum olarak mükemmeldi, heryere çok rahat ulaşabiliyorsunuz, restaurantlar, kafeler, güzel mekanlar mevcut. Mehmet Aydın bey oldukça ilgiliydi, evin genel temizliği iyi ancak toz konusunda aynı şeyi söyleyemem. Dairenin tek dezavantajı ters dubleks olması, yatak odasında kaldırım hizasına bakan küçük bir havalandırma pervazı mevcut, i̇çindeki vantilatör odaya esinti ve dışardan zaman zaman kötü kokuların gelmesine neden oluyor. Dezavantajlarını göze alanlar ve Balat' ı yaşamak isteyenler için ideal.

description: Apartment has 3 bedrooms with double beds, living room with sofa beds and 2 fully bathroom, located next to the Galata tower and metro station Sisane.

reviews.text:
The apartment is located just a few streets from Galata but the street is very quiet especially at night. The sound isolation from the neighbors is poor though. We had a very loud kid living downstairs which was unfortunate. An extra bonus is a conservatory choir rehearsing in an inner yard during the day (which is really quite nice).
The place is fairly beaten down and worn out, especially the bathrooms.
On the plus side it had all the necessary amenities including an iron + board, vacuum, hair dryer, coffee machine, etc. All the 3 beds were nice and comfy.
The hostess’s communication was great.
Overall a fair price for a 3BR appt with 2 bathrooms.

Special thanks to Zeburi for his responsiveness and helpful advice throughout our stay. He was always available and resolved any issues promptly. The apartment is conveniently located just 5 minutes from Galata Tower, with plenty of cafes, restaurants, and bars nearby. It was comfortable for our group of five, though it may feel a bit tight for eight adults. The front door does not fully block outside noise, and the small elevator means some guests use the stairs, which can occasionally be noisy .

Omg
Location is great. Quiet area but close to Galata and Istıklal. Maybe need to update pictures of bathroom and leaving room since there was some changes.

Casa corrispondente alla descrizione, compresa di tutto, spaziosa per un gruppo di 4-6 persone, pulita e vicina alla metro verde. Unica pecca, manca un pó di manutenzione: la seduta degli sgabelli era un pó sporca, per il resto OK
Great location and had everything we needed

description: Welcome to central apartment, a 2-min walk to Osmanbey Metro (1 stop to Taksim). Secure with alarms and cameras, it offers a king bed, sofa bed, 2 ACs, and 2 Smart TVs. The private kitchen has a dishwasher, and the bathroom features a shower. Enjoy the convenience of a in-room washing machine. Experience comfort in the heart of the city! Fast Wifi.

reviews.text:
I had comfortable stay at Mert's place.
The apartment is in a great location, few minutes from the Osmanbay metro station. It's on the side street but with lot of traffic, so expect some street noise during day.
The place looks like in the photos, although not that bright. It has two spacious rooms and big bathroom. It is well equipped and clean. The kitchen is on the small side.
Mert is really great host, he is very responsive and acts immediately when needed.

Mert was a wonderful host and was always available immediately. The apartment is very clean and in an EXCELLENT location. The metro is a 3 minute walk away, restaurants and cafes just a few steps away and grocery stores and pharmacies are just a few minutes walk away. The bathroom and bedroom were exceptionally clean and tidy, with ample bedding and towels provided. There is an in-unit washer and a dishwasher, which are huge pluses. The building also features an elevator which is rare for this area and made it super convenient to take up all my luggage. I stayed here during the summer and the AC units in the living room and bedroom kept the whole apartment brisk and cool!

Mert was a great host, he was responsive, a minor change occurred that we were unable to unlock the door. He responded and fixed the problem immediately. He checked on us a few time.
We were two adults with two young children. The apartment was comfortable for a family. It’s a duplex. The building has an elevator. It has AC, washing machine and dishwasher. It had necessary essentials such as washing powder, toilet papers, salt and etc. it is basically as it appears in the photos.
We arrived on a hot day of Istanbul , the apartment was hot, It took a while for the ACs to cool down the apartment. We left the ACs on and by the time we got back it was ok. I suppose that day was one of the hottest days of Istanbul and normally the weather is not as hot.
The location is great if you like to experience dynamic and vibrant Istanbul, there is a supermarket next door, two cafes opposite for breakfast, few minutes walk to Osmanbey metro and many restaurants and shops in the area.

My stay was excellent. The place was clean, tidy, and exactly as shown in the photos. The location is convenient with easy access to transportation. The host was attentive and welcoming. I would definitely choose it again.

Mert was extremely responsive even though we had a number of issues when moving into the Airbnb. We were staying for a month while we waited to move into our new flat. He was very friendly which made all of the issues that much more doable. Our bathroom drain was badly clogged in sink, we had a hot water issue for a couple days, and water had been leaking from the wall after each time one of us showered, all within the first couple days of getting there. We actually almost left, but Mert was determined to fix our issues, which he did. So we did end up staying because he helped us.
Overall, it was a cozy stay, but I do not recommend this Airbnb for longterm stays. Its kitchen is too cramped and TV/devices are too outdated and have a hard time functioning. Heat works magnificently though, and the rooms are spacious. We are grateful for our time here, and Mert's communications, regardless.

description:
This stylish place to stay is perfect for group trips.
Located on a quiet street surrounded by cafes,restaurants and antiques in the middle of Istanbul, our apartment is within walking distance of public transportation and easy to reach the historical peninsula.
The fully equipped kitchen, lush balcony, wi-fi, brand new furniture will provide the comfort you will feel at home.

(Although it appears in the photos, unfortunately our TV is out of service.)

reviews.text: Nice place on a quiet street in a trendy area with lots to do nearby. The hosts were responsive and friendly, and proactive with checkin/checkout instructions. Both bedrooms are pretty quiet at night but the smaller one in back is definitely quieter. I'm a fairly light sleeper, though, and the front bedroom was fine for me noise-wise. AC works great, and the bathroom is super nice. Washing machine also works well, and detergent and drying racks are available in the unit. Unfortunately we weren't really able to use the porch because the upstairs neighbor's cat likes to come down and try to get inside the unit, which was too bad because the porch area is quite nice. The Wifi was also very spotty, particularly in the front bedroom. Hopefully the hosts can improve the internet connection for those who want to work remotely from the unit. Overall though this place is an amazing value for the area. We had a great experience and would stay here again.

Great stay at Belgian and Yunus apartment who were great hosts and always responded quickly to any messages. They provided detailed instructions and photos for a smooth and easy check in. Everything was just as described. Great location in the bustling district of Cihangir and the waterfront, ferries and all the main sights were walking distance (once you get used to the hills!). A great stay despite the wet weather and a perfect base for a stay in Istanbul

reviews.text: Fantastic apartment, incredible location. Everything was walkable, including a metro station was 5 mins away. Clean, comfortable, and pretty. Really appreciated being able to drop my suitcase before check-in time, and the big bottle of water. Bed was comfortable. Windows let in lots of sunlight during the day, and blinds closed it all out at night. The A/C worked great. I didn’t find the noise from the street below to impede sleep at all. TV has Netflix, etc. Espresso machine was a nice touch. Everything was sufficient and smooth! Would definitely stay again.

Incredible location right in the middle of the hustle of a great city. Loads of options for food and drinks in the area, we especially enjoyed the ice cream from just next door.
Check in and out was a breeze, communication was clear and easy and the flat is exactly as pictured and has a good supply of things you need like washing detergent and oil for cooking, often these things are missed by hosts so great that everything has been thought about.
Building has a lift, bed is comfortable, all spotless, nothing not to like.
The only thing I would mention is that it is a very buzzy neighbourhood so noise from the street is constant. We liked how vibrant this was but might not be for everyone. We loved this stay though and would highly recommend this place.

We stayed 5 nights in this great little apartment. It is fantastic location-restaurants & cafes downstairs. As it is very busy in this location this comes with crowd noise at night. It didn’t really worry us except a few nights some clarinet player was busking late which became very annoying especially when we had a very early start one morning!
The apartment is very clean and bed is comfortable. Water pressure in shower ok. All in all we loved our stay here.

One of the best Airbnbs I've ever stayed at, super happy with it! Clear check-in instructions with pictures made the Airbnb easy to find. Prime location within walking distance to so many things! Loved how clean the Airbnb was, it was so nice to come back after a long day of exploring to relax in the beautiful kitchen and living room! I can't recommend this place enough. 10/10!

One of the best places ever! The house itself is beautiful and exactly like the picture. Very clean and has a lot of great amenities. The location of the house is in a very lively street and the neighborhood has a lot of restaurants and stores and supermarket. Very short walk to metro station and many attractions like Galata Tower, Galaport Mall and Istiklal Street. The hosts are wonderful, very helpful and very responsive as well. 100% recommend this place.

reviews.text: This was a great place to stay. Nice and central location, walking distance to a lot of tourist bits. The apartment was very clean. Kitchen was very well equipped. Nice shower. I had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Istanbul. The location was perfect — close to everything and very convenient for exploring the city. The apartment was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. Check-in and check-out were smooth and hassle-free.
Overall, everything went very well and I would definitely stay here again. Highly recommend!

This was a magical space for my husband and I. The space was special and the ceiws from both the bedroom and the living room were spectacular. The neighborhood was absolutely charming. We spent so much time locally, eating, shopping and interacting with the locals. It was easy to get around on the metro that is right down the street.
The 5 floors is a walk up, but Fernando's family helped us with luggage on arrival. We were grateful and felt the place was so worth the stairs.
Truly a memory we will bever forget.
Fernando was a great and kind host.
Do not miss the opportunity to experience this place, location and veiw.
A true delight.

We have stayed in many beautiful Airbnbs around the world, but this one was the most memorable. The view is absolutely stunning. It is very quiet and peaceful. The only sounds are birdsong, calls to prayer from the nearby mosques, and the occasional hooting of a cruise ship on the Bosphorus. The bed is super comfortable. We slept so well. The apartment is attractively furnished and well equipped. Powder for the washing machine is provided. Water pressure is good and there is loads of hot water. It is perfectly located. Everywhere was walkable and the ferries are only 5 mins away. There is a little family run convenience store open till 1am every day of the week and an excellent cafe/restaurant just two minutes away. The immediate area is also full of artisanal shops and food stores. The host was very helpful and responsive. We didn’t want to leave, and hope the apartment is available when we return to Istanbul.

I stayed in this flat for 3 nights and had a great experience. The place was exceptionally clean, and the view from the flat was absolutely stunning.. definitely one of the highlights of the stay.
Communication with Fernando was smooth and very easy throughout. He was responsive and helpful, which made everything more convenient.
I also really appreciated the thoughtful touches in the apartment. There was drinking water provided, along with enough soap, shampoo, and shower gel.. small details that made a big difference and made me feel comfortable and well taken care of.
Overall, I highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul.

description:
Welcome to a Historical Home

This house is more than a stay—it’s a hidden doorway linked to the old Pammakaristos Monastery across the street, now Fethiye Mosque. Legend says the priest once lived here, watching over prayers and secrets. Beneath, the stone cellar held silent prayers; its low door made all bow in respect. These walls still echo ancient whispers of faith. May you feel this spirit, honor it, and always find your way back to this sacred place's story.

reviews.text:
The house has potential, but our stay was disappointing due to its condition and how our complaints were handled.
We stayed as a family of four. The downstairs bathroom door could not close at all - a serious privacy issue. The garden was in poor condition, with overgrown grass, rubbish, cat feces, and dirty chairs. Some floors were not properly cleaned.
We reported these issues about 30 minutes after check-in. The host first agreed to arrange cleaning and repairs, but later said some issues weren't real, that we were exaggerating, and that we should clean some areas ourselves.
We contacted Airbnb Support, but the host still didn't fix the issues during our stay. Communication became unnecessarily confrontational.
We never wanted to cancel - we just wanted the basic issues addressed so our family could stay comfortably. That didn't happen, and it significantly affected our experience.
Beyond that, it's also worth noting that the fridge was very small for a family of four.

An absolute gem in the heart of Istanbul! Staying here felt like living in a piece of history—the restoration work on this 800-year-old home is truly remarkable, successfully preserving its original historic charm while maintaining a beautifully kept and wonderfully spacious interior.
The house was spotlessly clean and equipped with everything you could possibly need, from fresh bedding and towels to a fully stocked kitchen. Having a private back garden with outdoor furniture right in the city was such a rare and unique find.
Our host greeted us warmly upon arrival and was incredibly accommodating when our ETA changed. Located right in Balat, the position couldn't be better—it’s a vibrant, lovely neighborhood filled with unique local sellers, charming cafes, fantastic restaurants, and rich history around every corner (including the historical link to the old Pammakaristos Monastery right across the street).
We couldn't have asked for a better experience!

This house was incredible... the view of the Fethiye Mosque was amazing; we were disappointed that it's under restoration, so we couldn't go inside. Toskan was very responsive to all of my messages, and was so helpful and eager to please. We were grateful that he let us check in early, as we arrived exhausted at 6:30AM. I'd highly recommend this place if you're looking for a comfortable and roomy home, and being able to walk to the Balat district was also a plus.

Toskan was an excellent host, extremely accommodating, responded so quickly. He helped us find the home at arrival and helped with some items we had accidentally left behind. The home is located in a non-touristic neighborhood, immersing you in the local culture. The view from two of the bedroom windows is of a beautiful mosque, where you will hear the call to prayer early morning. It was a truly unique experience. The Hagia Sophia is about 30-45 minutes away via public transportation and walking around the neighborhood gave us a good sense of the true Istanbul, which we appreciated. Overall a great experience.

Ardit Toskan's house, to me, seems the very reason airbnb exists. Planted across from an old Byzantine mosque in the middle of an completely non-touristic neighborhood, with antique elements in every room, and the call to prayer ringing in through the many windows, this house not only made a full immersion into Turkish culture possible, it also made us feel right at home there. We were gathering with family who rarely travel and felt nervous - Ardit arranged everything to make it easier for them - arranged a large transfer cab that carried 6 people for pick up at the airport and arranged the payments himself so we would not get swindled by the drivers, told us about local restaurants where we were showered in freebies, etc. His place is in the old muslim quarter, so no one speaks english, the narrow cobbled alleys are jam-packed with life, the call to prayer wakes you up in the morning and heralds you to bed. If you want authentic, big-hearted, real Istanbul - look no further!

The place is very near to all historical places and for Istanbul - it is a top location! Very close are so much restaurants, bars, markets and nice content.
Our host was very polite and she was waiting for us when we were coming. She was very helpful and ready to react immediately, when there is a need.

very friendly and responsive. always responded quickly and very helpful. there were some small ants but as long as you don't leave food out it was fine. it was nice to arrive to bottled water and coffee and tea supplied.

description: We are within walking distance to Taksim Square and public transportation. There are places to shop near our facility. Free Wi-Fi, cleaning facilities, kettle, tea, coffee and water

reviews.text: Close to Taksim Square and Istiklal. Good communication from host. Not the nicest area but plenty of other hotels around.

Esin is just a great host and very helpful,regarding the place it’s kinda cosy,has got some concerns regarding the neighborhood specially by night,still it has nothing to do with the place itself,it’s lovely

Ça ne correspond pas a la chambre quand voit sur les photos

Fiyat performans

description:
A comfortable and modern apartment in the heart of Beyoğlu, just a short walk to Istiklal Street!
Thanks to its central location, you can easily access restaurants, cafes, bars, and major attractions.
The apartment is carefully designed and fully equipped for a comfortable stay.
A perfect choice for exploring Istanbul!

reviews.text:
In short: felt comfortable, it was clean and would gladly return. The host and home are lovely.
-Location is good, nearby convenience stores/restaurants. There is a great view from a nearby bridge. Easy to order taxi. Taksim square is 5-10 min walk depending on route.
-Host responds quickly, very kind, helpful and welcoming.
-Air con is only in living room, it runs cold and cools home well. We used a fan for the bedroom.
-Bed is firm and bedding is simple (fitted sheet and thin cotton coverlet).
-Water pressure is good and heats nicely.
-Washer machine works well, air dry with a rack.
-Kitchen has all basic needs for cooking.
-The curtains are not blackout but getting good rest was easy. Mostly quiet area.
-36 stairs total to climb to second floor. Host kindly helped with luggage.
-One set of keys but if someone is home, an outsider can be buzzed in.
-WiFi and personal cell data was patchy at times but overall good.
-Smart tv, cozy couch, big apartment size.

We had a great stay at this apartment in Istanbul. The location is perfect — only about 5 minutes walking from Taksim Square, which made it very easy to move around the city.
The apartment is big, clean, and very comfortable, especially for 2 couples. It has a beautiful street view, a nice living room with LED lights at night that creates a very cozy atmosphere, and everything was well prepared for our stay. The apartment is on the second floor and there is no elevator, but it is still easy to reach.
The host was extremely kind and helpful during the whole stay. He kept asking if we needed anything and made sure we were comfortable all the time. Highly recommended for anyone visiting Istanbul!

We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was clean, spacious, comfortable, and exactly as described. The hosts were incredibly friendly, welcoming, and helpful throughout our stay. They made us feel at home and were always available whenever we needed anything. We truly enjoyed our time here and would definitely stay again. Highly recommended!

Konaklamamızdan çok memnun kaldık. Evin konumu gerçekten mükemmel, her yere kolay ulaşım sağlanabiliyor. Ev sahibi son derece güvenilir, ilgili ve anlayışlıydı; her konuda yardımcı oldu. Ev, fotoğraflarda göründüğü gibi düzenli ve zevkli bir şekilde dekore edilmiş. Ayrıca oldukça rahat ve güvenli bir ortam sunuyor. Gönül rahatlığıyla herkese tavsiye ederiz.

Bu ev sadece bir konaklama yeri değil, resmen deneyim! İlk adım attığımız anda tertemiz ve özenle hazırlanmış olduğunu hissettik. Evde ihtiyacımız olan her şey düşünülmüş, en küçük detaylar bile atlanmamış.
Konumu harika; gün boyu dışarıda vakit geçirip sadece uyumak için bile gelsanız fazlasıyla keyif alıyorsunuz. Sessiz, huzurlu ve çok konforlu bir ortam.
Ev sahibi ise ayrı bir konu: iletişimi hızlı, ilgili ve gerçekten misafirperver. Kendimizi yabancı gibi değil, adeta evimizde hissettik.
Hiç düşünmeden tekrar tercih ederim. Kesinlikle tavsiye ediyorum!”

description:
Located in one of Istanbul's most historic neighborhoods, our apartments, which offer sea views from their balconies, are just an 8-minute walk from the Hagia Sophia and Topkapi Palace and a 5-minute walk from the Blue Mosque. Offering easy access to the tram line, this exclusive accommodation option combines the unique atmosphere of the past with modern comfort.
We are happy to welcome you to our new, modern apartment:) (:

reviews.text: We had a wonderful stay! The apartment was beautiful, very comfortable and exactly as described. The location was great, and Dilek was extremely kind and welcoming. Thank you for everything!
Great location , responsive host, clean and tidy

I had a really lovely stay here! The place looks exactly like the pictures, and the view is absolutely beautiful. There are so many things nearby, which made the location really convenient and easy to enjoy.
Dilek was friendly from the beginning, made sure I had everything I needed, and was always quick to respond whenever I had a question. I truly enjoyed my time here and would happily stay again.

Dilek’s place was great. Extremely clean, quiet, beautiful view, and very well located near the big sites in Sultanahmet. You’re across the street from a beauty mosque and tram is not far if you need that.

This apartment was perfect for our first visit to Istanbul. Right in the heart of Sultanahmet within easy reach of the main sights.
We had the most beautiful view from the balcony and enjoyed watching the sunsets.
Apartment itself was well equipped and comfortable and the A/C was really good.
Wouldn't hesitate to come back/recommend to others

description:
🌟 Welcome to this modern and stylish 1 Bedroom Apartment located in Maslak Sarıyer, within the prestigious Maslak 1453 Complex.

The apartment offers a spacious living area, a fully equipped kitchen, and access to on-site facilities including a gym, sauna, and steam room.

🧹Daily complimentary housekeeping service is included for your comfort.
(For +28 Nights Long Stays: Housekeeping service is included twice weekly.)

✨ We look forward to hosting you and wish you a pleasant stay!

reviews.text: This was my second stay at this hotel, and once again it was a great experience. The place is clean, comfortable, and the staff are always kind and helpful. Special thanks to (Nalan) from housekeeping for her excellent work and attention to detail — she kept the room spotless and made my stay even more comfortable. I truly appreciate her effort. Thank you to the whole team. I will definitely come back and stay here again
Everything was beautiful, comfortable, quiet, and very clean apartments, and excellent service from the staff.
I had a lovely stay with Genius Living. The team was kind, helpful, and always polite. They made me feel welcome and were quick to help whenever I needed anything. Thank you for a great experience!
Excellent host and apartment. Loved it! would highly recommend and book again

Great place , restarunts , shopes , big supermarkets available , nice Gym but no pool.
Defenitly recommended.

description: Located in a central location, this clean and comfortable home offers easy access to everything.

reviews.text: Great stay at this rental apartment! The location was excellent — very close to the metro station and malls, which made everything convenient. The apartment was clean, tidy, and comfortable. The host “Nazim” was extremely friendly, helpful, and responsive throughout the stay. Highly recommended!
Words arent enough. Exactly what you expect to be + awesome communication/fast solutions from the host regarding my requests. HIGHLY RECOMMENDED
guzel bi tercih oldu temiz ve rahat bir yer öneririm
Çok temiz ve ferahtı kendi evimde gibi hissettim ev sahibi çok samimiyeti çok yardımcı oldu

description:
Set in the dynamic neighborhood of Moda on Istanbul’s Asian side, this luxurious two-floor apartment is a sumptuous yet calming space that offers everything one could need, whether in Istanbul for business or pleasure.
The apartment's patio is located on the downstairs of the apartment, at the rear of the building.

reviews.text:
Really enjoyed our stay, right on one of my favorite streets in the area with lots of lively cafes, shops, and markets nearby. Yet the back patio area was so peaceful and quiet.
Amenities were great, spacious apartment (felt bigger than in pictures), very comfortable beds as well.
Check in & out process super easy, hosts were always available and responsive, consistently asking if we needed anything else!

This was the best Airbnb I’ve ever stayed in. Everything was just perfect from start to finish. The place had everything we could possibly need, and you can tell a lot of thought went into making it comfortable and easy to stay in.
What I loved most was how quiet and relaxing it was even while being in the heart of the ciry. It felt peaceful the moment we walked in, and it is the kind of place you look forward to coming back to after being out all day. Everything was clean, comfortable, well equipped, and exactly as it should be.
I honestly can’t think of a single complaint. There’s nothing I would want to change. Absolutely perfect, and I would stay here again without hesitation.

The place is perfectly located in the heart of Kadikoy. It's newly renovated, chic, spacious, and comfortable. The 2.5 bathrooms make life easy for group stays. The building is also very modern and convenient overall, which is not always what you get in Kadikoy. I'd definitely book again!
Small caveat that doesn't take any stars away from my review: the kitchen equipment is very nice but a bit minimal, and some basics (such as shampoo or soap) were not provided for us. I'm sure if we had asked for it the host would've provided; but we already bought some at the store. The WiFi was not great if you plan to work. But I had the same issue at another place; I wonder if it's a common problem.
We had an excellent stay!

The location is great and it's quiet - that's the best I can say. The apartment is tired and badly needs renovation. There's a strong smell of damp and sewage that the incense sticks placed around the rooms did nothing to fix; I wasn't sure it was even safe to breathe. The "terrace" is just a dark, gloomy backyard - hardly a perk unless you need a spot to smoke. One shower head is broken, the toilet has black mould under the seat hinge, and the bed is hard and squeaky.
~460 символов.

Very nice, brand new airbnb in a street full of the coolest spots of the Asian side of Istanbul.
Even though it’s on a busy street, once you’re in the apartment it’s very calm.
The place was very clean and the host was very friendly and professional.
The only small downside of this place was that it didn’t let so much daylight in, which was not a bad thing on hot summer days.
I can only recommend this place!

description:
• Enjoy a stylish stay in the heart of central Moda, Kadikoy. This beautifully designed modern 1-bedroom apartment offers the perfect mix of comfort and location. Surrounded by cafés, restaurants, and local boutiques, it’s just a short walk to the seaside and public transportation, making it easy to explore the city.

• Perfect for couples or solo travelers, this cozy home offers a calm and convenient base to enjoy Moda’s lively local atmosphere.

reviews.text: Amazing location, wonder big space, the extra big couch is so nice and so comfortable. Only downside is the water heater is in the bedroom almost above the bed and it can leak. Aside from that the place is great and extremely comfortable great value.

Genel olarak güzel bir konaklama deneyimiydi. Evin konumu gerçekten çok iyiydi ve ev temizdi. Söylemem gereken tek şey yatak odasında bulunan kombinin ses yapıyor olması. Ayrıca sıcak suyla ilgili kısa süreli bir sorun yaşadık ancak Eren Bey konuyla hemen ilgilenip çok hızlı bir şekilde çözdü.
Yaşadığımız olumsuzluklar büyük ölçüde ev sahibinin kontrolü dışında gelişen durumlardı. Bunun dışında Eren Bey iletişimi çok güçlü, her konuda hızlı aksiyon alan ve yardımcı olmaya çalışan bir ev sahibiydi. Genel olarak memnun kaldığımız bir konaklama oldu, teşekkür ederiz.

So far was the best airbnb experience ever.
The hosts were always quick to respond and kind.
The apartamemt is bigger than it looks on the pictures, extremely clean and well taken care of. It is well-equipped for long-term stays.
There are lots of supermarkets in the area(one of them being two houses away), so the shopping was easy.
Ferry and subway station 5 minutes away. Getting around was so easy, we could spontaneously go anywhere without any worries of how to get back on time.
The area itself is quite touristy yet still quiet.
Would like to say another thank you to the hosts. We had a few emergencies during the stay, and they came to our rescue quickly, made sure to sort everything out no matter the time of the day.
All in all, 10/10 experience, would love to be back again next time we are in İstanbul.

Ev gerçekten çok güzeldi. Konumu oldukça merkezi ve ulaşım açısından çok rahattı. Ev temiz, düzenli ve konforluydu; fotoğraflarda göründüğünden bile daha güzel olduğunu söyleyebilirim. Konaklamamız boyunca hiçbir sorun yaşamadık. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye edebileceğim bir yer, tekrar geldiğimde kesinlikle yeniden tercih ederim. ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

Konaklamayı eşim ve 9 yasindaki oglumla Temmuz 2026 da yaptık. Ev sahibi Samet Bey ilgili ve misafirperver bir ev sahibi. Sorularimiza nazik ve cok hizli cevap aldik. Evin konumu tam merkezdeydi. İskeleye yuruyerek 10 dk uzaklikta. Eve girdigimizde camasirliga ihtiyacimiz oldugunu soyledigimizde cok kisa surede satin alip teslim etti. Musteri memnuniyetinin tam gostergesiydi. Tesekkur ederiz. Ev ve muhit ile alakalı tecrubelere geldigimizde; bina girişindeki internet kafenin bir girişinin apartmana cikiyor olmasi ve akşamları kapi onunun erkek kalabaligi oluşturması aileyi huzursuz eden bir ortam yarattı. Evdeki son gecemizde sabaha karsi baslayan yagmur yatak odasina yerlestirilmis kombinin hava borusuna vurunca sesten uyuyamayip salona gecmek zorunda kaldık. Bu zor bur geceydi. Bizden onceki misafir evde sigara ictigi icin eve girdigimizde uzun sure havalandirmak durumunda kaldik. Eve dondugumuzde ise koku maalesef cikmamisti. Tv de anten girisi bulunmuyordu. Arti ve eksileriyle..

description: Enjoy a cozy stay in this stylish 1+1 apartment featuring warm brick wall details, modern decor, and a small private balcony. The apartment offers a comfortable bedroom, a relaxing living area, a functional kitchen, and a modern bathroom. Perfect for short or longer stays, it provides a peaceful and comfortable space while keeping you close to the city’s best spots.

reviews.text:
Selim was responsive and very friendly, he gave amazing local food recommendations!!
The place could use some refurbishment as it seemed older than the photos and there was a noticeable smell in the toilet/ near the kitchen sink. It’s also quite steep flight of stairs for those with large luggage but thankfully Selim lives close by and helped us with our bags.
That said, the location is convenient with shops and public transport nearby and walkable to many attractions.

This apartment is the perfect place to stay in Istanbul. It is very walkable to popular areas such as Istaklal Street, Taksim, Galata Tower, Şişhane, etc. while the neighborhood is a very safe option for solo travelers. It is truly just as cute as the pictures and has all the amenities you’ll need, even for a longer-term stay. Selim is a very friendly, responsive host who will attend to any issue or concern promptly. The best option for a trip to Istanbul!

The place is located in a quiet area but nearby many restaurants, shops and attractions. The host was very helpful and responsive. The place is very cute, however needs some small renovation to uplift the space
Great deal for its affordable price :) Everything needs a bit of an update. The location is great. The communication with Selim - splendid. Overall a pleasant experience.

Evin konumu mükemmel evin içi temiz ve düzenliydi. Ev sahibi çok yardımsever her konuda yardımcı oldu hızlı cevaplar ve tavsiyelerde bulundu. Herkese tavsiye ediyorum mutlaka bu dairede kalmanızı öneriyorum.

description:
“Disinfection before each check-in”
Private 1+1 flat in Balat-the colorful fragment of Istanbul(10 minute bus ride to Taksim and Eminonu)comforts your Istanbul exploring with bathroom, kitchen, living room and bedroom . Explore Istanbul from a certainly the richest in history, the most fascinating and characteristic district, where included in the UNESCO World Heritage List. Almost all public transportation possibilities just in 4 minutes walking distance and 10-15 minutes by bus from your flat.

reviews.text: Tuğba & Aytaç’s apartment is lovely, clean and comfortable, and exactly as described. It is situated just a few minutes' walk away from bus stops, shops, and cafes. I stayed for a few months and had no concerns throughout my stay. Tuğba & Aytaç are thoughtful and trustworthy hosts and communicate promptly and proactively. I felt well prepared upon arrival with their advice, and they were glad to answer questions that came up afterward, as well. As for amenities, the wifi is strong, the water is hot, the bed is comfortable, and the kitchen is equipped. If you are looking for a peaceful location in a beautiful Istanbul neighborhood with wonderful hosts, this is it. :)

Good place for staying in Balat. The owners were very nice and always kept in touch with us.
Clean apartments, change of towels and bed linen once a week. There were no problems with water.
We liked Balat: colored small houses, cheap cafes with delicious food and only five minutes to walk from apartments to the bus station. But also small sidewalks so you had to walk on the roadway.
Disadvantages for us:
Wi-Fi droped out regullarly, sometimes it was critically.
The soundproofing is bad, we could hear the neighbors upstairs and street noise.

This is a nice enough, no frills Airbnb, and our host was helpful in getting us from the airport.
Keep in mind: the apartment is very tiny, and the towels are thin and not soft, so if you have a microfiber towel or a nice towel you like to use, bring that with you.
Pros: great location, charming and walkable historic neighborhood, very quiet, and the radiators kept the apartment cozy warm in January. Our host was very kind to walk us through the adjoining streets when we arrived at night, exhausted and hungry after 24 hours of flights, so we could buy hot food and water. The apartment was very clean except that my husband detected an odor of mold in the bathroom when we arrived. In fairness, I could not smell this odor. We bought some bleach and cleaned the bathroom, after which the smell did not return.

The highlight of our 1 month stay in Istanbul is this tiny and comfy space me and my cousin called home away from home.
The hosts are superb. Tuğba and Aytaç and Suleiman are very attentive, hospitable and easy to communicate with as we did asked a lot of inquiries/advice and made many requests before and during our stay. We also requested airport transfers and home PCR test service from them.
The location is the main reason we chose this place and we weren't dissapointed. Nearby bakeries, restaurants, cafes, butchers, fresh produce stalls, and grocery shops. There's a pharmacy just behind this building. Easy access to public transport with bus stops and T5 tramway (use moovit apps). Perfect location for us!
The unit itself (unit #5) is on the 3rd level. It is indeed a small open layout with kitchen, living and dining(our workspace) I guess about 250 square feet. But just perfect for the 2 of us because it has large window that we would open the curtain so it made the space bigger and open the window for the cool breeze. It has all the stuffs we need: fully equipped kitchen (we did bought our own pots to bring back home as we are heavy cooker), refrigerator and washing machine. The double bed is comfy. The bedding and towels were changed and house is cleaned weekly for free as we stayed for over 2weeks.
The surrounding of this building is so local and rustic. We would just peep out our heads from the window when simit sellers on cart and produce sellers on van called on their customers or during the echo of the call of prayers, watching neighbors hanging out their clothes or talking to each other...we found these so fascinating. Saying these the place is not noisy at all...it is actually a quiet and safe street.
Thanks for the memories....We would love to come back to this place the next time we plan our turkey trip!

Staying in the main part of Istanbul can get pricey so this Airbnb is definitely a good alternative if you are trying to save money. Although it is about an hour walk from the tourist area, we enjoyed staying here for a month and spent most of our days grocery shopping and cooking. The apartment was very comfortable and we were very grateful to have it cleaned every week. The WiFi worked well for both of us to work and attend online classes. Staying here will definitely give you the opportunity to immerse yourself in the culture and eat a lot of really good food from nearby restaurants.

description: Our flat offers you a peaceful space with its magnificent tree and green area in the garden, and is close to all transportation vehicles. It is located in the heart of Istanbul's Kadıköy district, within walking distance of the historical and popular neighborhood's entertainment, dining, and cultural events. You can rent our flat for short or long periods. Collect unforgettable memories in this flat and in the enchanting atmosphere of Istanbul!

reviews.text:
We spent there 2,5 months. The flat was very nice and very clean, location is very good and quiet. There is everything you need for a comfortable stay!
However due to the fact that the flat is on the first floor it was quite dark even in the morning.
The bathroom had some issues and some of them were fixed but it took time.
Personal communication was nice, but we had some problems during texting, it might be the language barrier though. E.g, when the host wanted us to pay the full price in once but we`re supposed to pay monthly according to Airbnb rules. He wanted it because as he said he hadn’t seen that method of payment before. We told him, we`re going to follow Airbnb rules, and he said “it will put us in a difficult situation, but if you have to pay this way, no problem” and “I guess I won't use Airbnb for long stays from now on :)” so we felt really uncomfortable. And he texted that water and gas bills were higher than usual. That all was confusing and we didn't feel welcomed.

The apartment I'm staying in left a remarkable impression on me. It was cozy, clean, and quiet, ensuring my stay was incredibly comfortable. It came equipped with all the essentials for a pleasant stay, and even without air conditioning, it remained pleasantly cool.
The convenient location, with nearby shops, cafes, and easy access to the pier and transportation, made getting around the city a easier. I also appreciated having a balcony and a garden where I could enjoy pleasant evenings.
The owner of the apartment, Volkan Bey, demonstrated true hospitality and was exceptionally helpful throughout my stay. He was always readily available and efficiently addressed any issues that arose. I'm hopeful that in the future, I'll have the chance to return to this lovely place once more. Thank you for a wonderful stay!!!

Volkan was very quick and efficient throughout the stay, a real pleasure to work with.
Flat very clean, well equipped, comfortable, ideal location for getting around, the neighbourhood is quiet and safe.
I was able to work two weeks from Volkan appartement, very good internet access.
I hope to return in the near future!

I am absolutely delighted with my stay!
The perfect place in Istanbul.
The place is genuinely charming, offering a serene and cozy atmosphere that instantly made me feel at home.
The veranda is a slice of paradise, perfect for unwinding and soaking in the tranquility. Inside, the house is thoughtfully arranged, boasting ample storage space that adds to the overall comfort.
Every nook radiates a cozy vibe, complemented by the calm surroundings. Its location is incredibly convenient, putting me in close proximity to everything I needed. This is, without a doubt, the ideal spot for anyone looking to escape the hustle and bustle.
The hosts are exceptionally kind and always available, ensuring my stay was nothing short of perfect.
Highly recommend to anyone seeking a home away from home experience!

We spent 2 really good weeks in this house. It was just like on the photos. It's a quiet place in Kadıköy which is very appreciable. We felt like we were home. Also Volkan have been a very reactive host. We really recommend this place!

description: The flat is just next to Galata Tower which is one of the most famous historical landmarks of Istanbul. It is in the intersection of local and other touristical areas also 3 minutes away from metro and bus stations where you can also hail a cap. There are many boutique cafes around where you can have coffee - breakfast ( One was just opened under the building opposite the supermarket) The rooftop with breathtaking view is accessible for you to take your breakfast or a grab a drink at nights.

reviews.text:
The place is good
The location is exactly near to galata tower and very nice roads for walking and shopping
But of course very crowded at all times
The host helped me to find a parking lot payable but nice to have a place to park the car especially if you come late night
The terrance on the roof has a great view but not big and clean enough to sit and enjoy the view
Other than that our stay was good
The place value is mainly the location in the middle of the main streets rather than the flat itself

Had a fantastic stay in this apartment! This is a beautiful Airbnb that has charm with its brick walls and decorations. The rooms were large and the beds were comfortable (loved having a desk in one of the rooms), and it was great that the living room had lots of seating as well as an air conditioner. The bedrooms themselves didn't have AC (something to keep in mind if being cold at night is important to you), but the one closest to the living room could receive cooling from that AC unit if the door was left open, and as for the other bedroom, airing the room out by leaving the window open was adequate to manage the heat. As for the kitchen, it is somewhat small and pretty dark, so not quite ideal for cooking (something to keep in mind if you plan on cooking everyday), but decent enough with sufficient equipment to enjoy small meals in the kitchen. The bathroom is also quite small, but if you are travelling solo or with one other person, then sharing the bathroom is manageable. The wifi worked great which was perfect for remote work, and the apartment was relatively quiet in terms of neighbors, and if you close the windows, then you can eliminate most of the street noise. The location was fantastic as it is right next to the Galata Tower (1 min walk away) so you have a view of it when exiting the apartment, and if you ever get lost, just look for Galata Tower towering above the buildings and navigate your way home that way. There are also many restaurants, cafes, and grocery stores near the Airbnb, so it is easy to find something to eat and there are many places to enjoy the local ambience. It's a safe neighborhood with lots of people around, but it is quiet at night. Do keep in mind that there is no elevator in the building and you have to walk up multiple stairs to the unit. It was also a 30-40 minute walk to the main attractions of Hagia Sophia and other historical sites in the area, but honestly the walk didn't feel long and it was quite enjoyable seeing the city along the way. And it's much faster than being stuck in traffic in a taxi. Now the absolute best part of staying at this Airbnb was having access to an amazing rooftop where you have an incredible panoramic view of the entire city as well as Galata Tower. I could spot the Hagia Sophia, the Blue Mosque, and other sites from that rooftop as we dined at sunset. Chiko was also very kind and hospitable, and when we had an issue, he was very communicative and helpful! I highly recommend staying here and look forward to staying here again in the future!

We spent 6 nights in Maha & Chiko apartment. It's indeed a cosy place, very up to the expectations we have had from the photos. The location is really good, by the corner of a pedestrian street, a few dozens of meters from the Galata tower, 5 min walking distance from Istiklal. All our questions/minor issues were answered/addressed very quickly, we were also allowed to come earlier than the standard check-in hour and leave later than the check-out. One misconception we had from the photos was that the terasse is the part of the apartment - in fact, that's on the roof of the 5-storey building and accessible via stairway (there's no elevator in the building), and of course shared with all the other apartements. But it's almost always empty, so we could enjoy drinks and sunset views there on a few occasions.

Located right at what I imagine is the busiest spot in Galata right by the tower, you’re staying right in the heart of things here. There’s no lack of cafes and food places near by and a small supermarket pretty much downstairs for essentials.
There was plenty enough room in the apartment and although the kitchen isn’t really suited to any serious cooking we didn’t feel the need to anyway with so many food options close by.
There is some noise from music from lively cafe down on the street but it’s always quiet by midnight so not something I saw as a problem.
Oh yes, and the view from the rooftop is awesome!
The host is friendly and helpful, and I would recommend this place for anyone wanting to stay in the heart of Istanbul!

A great place! Two bedrooms plus a social living room, wi-fi and AC. The rooftop was amazing! It was so convenient to be right in the middle of all the great shops and restaurants near Galata Tower. Train stations were pretty close too. The hosts communicated via WhatsApp and met up with us, helping us get all set up. They also made it so easy to check out early in the morning. Only thing to be aware of is there are several flights of stairs without strong railings… one person in our group has mobility challenges and that was a bit tough for her.

description: Cool Apartment with nice Terrace, Hagia Sophia & The Blue Mosque view. Located in the center of old town. 2 minutes walking distance to all the historic buildings. Nicely decorated, one bedroom apartment.

reviews.text: The flat was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped. Reyhan and Günner’s communication was excellent throughout, even accommodating a late arrival from the airport without any issues. While we didn’t meet the hosts in person, they were incredibly responsive and easy to reach. The flat itself had everything we needed and more—there were enough utensils to prepare a delicious Turkish breakfast every morning (and there were many great restaurants nearby to have a cheap lunch or delicious dinner at), and the kitchen was stocked with equipment like a toasty machine and a Turkish coffee maker, most of which we didn’t even get the chance to use! The location was ideal, as we were able to explore the Sultanahmet area entirely on foot. The Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Hammam and many other key attractions were just a very short walk away, making it incredibly convenient. Although the weather was rainy for most of our trip, we enjoyed the shared rooftop terrace (on the fourth floor).

We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Istanbul! The location couldn’t be better—just a short walk to all the major attractions in Sultanahmet, including the Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, and Topkapi Palace. The neighborhood is safe, vibrant, and full of great restaurants, cafes, and shops.
The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and well-equipped with everything we needed for our stay. The beds were cozy, the air conditioning worked perfectly, and there was plenty of hot water. It was also very quiet at night, which we really appreciated after long days of exploring.
Our host was extremely responsive and helpful, offering great local tips and making check-in a breeze. We would absolutely stay here again and highly recommend it to anyone visiting Istanbul!

Perfect location to tour Old Istanbul, steps away from Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque. The apartment was pristine clean. Comfortable bed with good air conditioning. Great shower! The only drawback was the steep, narrow, spiral steps to get up to the apartment, not mentioned in the write up. 35 steps to the 1st floor apartment. And 3 more flights up to the rooftop terrace, which was beautiful. Overall, our host was pleasant and responsive, check in was easy, the apartment was very nice, and I would highly recommend it, if the steps don't bother you.

Amazing place & location! So many main attractions (Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Basilica Cistern, etc.) are within a 5-10min walk. The rooftop view is incredible and we would absolutely stay here again if we are to return to Istanbul. AC worked great which was very necessary considering how hot it was in August.
A few noteworthy items:
1. The place uses a physical key and no dropbox. The host stayed in close communication with us to provide directions and met us promptly outside upon arrival.
2. The stairway to the apartment is quite steep & narrow, which can make getting large luggage up mildly challenging. The host actually helped me carry my bag up which I was not expecting but was thankful for.
3. Being located between two mosques means you’ll likely hear the Call to Prayer, which is a beautiful and integral part of the local culture.
Reyhan’s place is lovely, affordable, and perfectly located for seeing the many of the best parts of Istanbul!

Abundance of everything: Scenery, history, space - rooms, ceilings, windows, bathroom and closets are much larger than you expect. More than enough paper products, fresh white towels, different weights of blankets, soaps, coffee, teas, even huge welcome bottles of water and delicious Turkish delights. One of the most efficiently laid out spaces we’ve seen—thoughtful even to the point of a small towel over the kitchen faucet to remind us Americans not to drink the tap water. The rooftop is quiet and awe inspiring. Watching the sunset in sheer silence above all the touristy stuff can’t be beat. Guner is very, very helpful. 5-10 minute walk to everything—from crazy to peaceful (don’t miss the Little Hagia Sofia). The comfortable, direct Hava-IST 11 airport shuttle bus pickup is right below the living room window (if you’re coming in from the airport it’s stop D). 315 lira per person one way ($7.50 US). There are 28 spiral marble steps up to the apartment, more flights up to roof.

description: One bedroom and saloon apartment is cosy and warm athmosphere to stay still in the city and have privacy at the same time. One double bed in bedroom with bed base, closet and drawers. Saloon is spacious and warm athmosphere. Also there is a couch can be a double bed and couch base. In kitchen there is dishwasher, owen, washing machine. Small greeny balcony. 8 minutes to Nişantaşı, 10-15 minutes to Şişli Subway, 20 minutes to Beşiktaş by walking. 7/24 market & restaurants are there.

reviews.text:
this is the best airbnb experience of my life
the apartment is incredibly comfortable. quiet with 100 percent light-blocking curtains and a comfortable mattress. sleep with good quality sleep
the kitchen is well equipped. there is all the necessary utensils, stove, dishwasher, oven, large refrigerator. convenient to cook
there is a washing machine, powder and dryer
shower without unpleasant surprises. the cabin does not leak and it is easy to adjust the water
in the living room it is pleasant to spend time, very light and comfortable. you can set up your own workplace. there are several extension cords for the computer
there is an elevator and good heating of the apartment. the location is also very convenient. within walking distance of the metro, a large shopping center, shops and cafes
The hostess is incredibly responsive and pleasant to deal with. Her instructions on how to find accommodation were very helpful.
Thanks for the comfortable location! I absolutely recommend this accommodation.

Excellent location, apartment, and host…can’t have a better AirBnB experience. Lots of useful kitchenware, very clean and comfortable, windows allowed ample cooling in June, closed them at night to block sound and it was cool to sleep (fan if needed). Aysegul was always responsive and friendly, a perfect host. I will stay again when I’m in Sisli.

Very comfy and cosy apartment in a good location and a very very helpful host. I would book it again if I'll need. All as on the photos and even better, has everything needed to come and live. Good internet suitable for online work.

Ayşegül çok iyi bir ev sahibi. Gönül rahatlığıyla gelip misafiri olabilirsiniz. Herşey fotoğraflarda gözüktüğü gibi gerçekten çok temizdi. Bütün sorularımıza ve isteklerimize olabildiğince hızlı ve çözüm odaklı cevap verdi. Evin benim icin tek olumsuz tarafi mecidiyeköymetro istasyonuna gidebilmek icin bi yokuşu yürümeyi göze almak zorundasiniz ama cok uzun bi yokus degil, nefes acmaniza yariyor. Bunun disinda hersey iyiydi güzel bir tatil oldu bizim icin.

Ayşegül is a very friendly and welcoming host. She provided very detailed instructions on finding the place and check-in. The apartment is comfortable and welcoming, with a well equipped kitchen. The location has good access to the metro, and Nişantasi and Beşiktaş are not so far.

description:

reviews.text:
Communication is excellent - nothing to improve.
Checkin-in - very very easy, full support from Fulya despite late check-in (delayed flight).
Very improtant for us, the apartment was very clean.
Everything what we used is in working order and convenient.
Aircon is super useful during hot days of early September.
Location: great! Quiet place in the busy not touristy area with lots of shops, restaurants, cafes.
Wrt other reviews: yes, the apartment is old and would benefit from renovation. This had no importance for us as we highly valued all benefits that we received.
I would stay here again. Thank you, Fulya!

I appreciate fast communication, waiting for me after got stuck in traffic, lots of space in the apartment, quietness, parking spot. I have to mention that kitchen and bathroom looks a little dated, but will do the job. In fact, if the appliances were new and everything fully restored, the price would be 3x times higher so I think for now this arrangement is best. I would stay again and I think this location is best for families or 4 to 6 people couples or friends visiting this great city. Recommend +++++

We liked the area and the flat in general, it's a good location. The communication was very quick and checkin smooth. The place is a bit rundown which I don't mind, as long as it is clean and decent. But the biggest disappointment was the kitchen, which needs a LOT of cleaning and updates.

The place was beautiful and we felt like at home. Sufficient beds to sleep for the 5 of us, plenty of dishes and towels. Sitting area was spacious and overall place is large. We had a lots of fun! We fed many kitties from the neighborhood. Many walkable great restaurants; walking distance to a local market and down to the sea. 10 min walk to metro. Very convenient. The house needs repairs but it did not affect our stay. Thank you for hosting us!

Fulya was very hospitable and accommodating to all of mine and my families needs, if ever we had an enquiry about the flat or local area or things to do in Istanbul in general she provided quick, thoughtful and helpful feedback . There was 5 of us in total and there was plenty of room for all. The flat had a lovely vibe and atmosphere. Set in a very pleasant neighbourhood with ample amenities around, from convenience stores to Mcdonalds, two mins walk away from each other. There lots of great transport links such as cabs and buses and metro station. The area has great eateries and restaurants and the port/sea is only a 10 min walk away. Overall very happy with our stay here

reviews.text:
Perfect Stay in a sultanahmet!
We had an amazing time at this apartment! Emrah was absolutely perfect – friendly, responsive, and made everything so easy for us. The apartment itself was clean, comfortable, and ideally located – close to everything we needed: shops, tramway, and main attractions.
One thing to mention is that the TV wasn’t working, but honestly, that turned out to be a good thing – the kids weren’t glued to a screen and also we spent more time outside.
Overall, we had a wonderful stay and would definitely come back again!

Great stay - we would recommend it!
We had a nice stay in the apartment. It was very clean and well suited for 5 people. The location was great only 1-2 min away from Sultanahmet. It was still very quiet in our room. There were enough towels. The air conditioning worked well. Emrah was always available and immediately there for our questions. He was really nice and helpful. The owners were all very friendly. We would definitely rent it again! Thanks again 👍🏻👍🏻

Emrah's place was cleaned, comfortable, and in a convenient & safe location. During the day the street was lively filled with tourist, busses, businesses, but at night it was silent, no dogs barking or any noise which made it easy to rest and the beds were comfortable. Thank you Emrah for your hospitality & quick response, you kept us informed to make the most of our short stay.

Emrah was a great host. He let us check-in as early as 5 a.m and met us at the place to give us the keys and answer all the questions. He took us to the shop to purchase a local SIM card and show the location of the market and other shops. The location of the place was great! Literally behind the Blue Mosque.

Photos don't do this place justice! adorable studio that comfortably hosted 5 of us. Right next to Arasta Bazaar and on top of a beautiful souvenir place where we bought a ton of stuff. Emrah stayed up until 3am to help us check in and helped arrange our taxi to airport. Thank you for hosting us Emrah! We hope to come back!

description: In the center of Ataşehir, On4 Rooms & Suits has a unique appearance and magnificent location decorated with special architectural work and offers reliable and hygienic accommodation. Consisting of 14 apartments in total, On4 rooms & suites have all the tools and equipment to meet your needs in all your accommodation plans and meeting organizations.

One of the best places i stayed at in istanbul, very stylish,clean,alot of space, simply amazing.

description: This professionally managed apartment has been newly renovated (summer 2019). It's one of the five apartments we manage. It is located on a quiet street in the historic Galata region, 300 meters from Galata Tower. It is steps from historic landmarks such as Kamondo Stairs, Salt Galata and British Seamen's Hospital. 600m to the Karakoy tram station.

reviews.text:
This Airbnb is in a great location. The apartment itself is just ok, the bed is comfortable and the shower is pretty nice, but most things in the apartment are broken or just have a lot of wear and tear. The internet is okay-ish, it's DSL with about 25 down and 5 up, can be tough for video calls and similar.
The host was very nice and helpful, and for a month long stay they provided weekly cleanings. Overall you are paying mostly for the location, which is understandable.

We stayed here for almost two months in total and absolutely loved it. The photos are accurate, so the place was how we excepted, maybe even nicer.
Excellent location within walking distance of anything you need and also everything you want to see in Istanbul.
Wifi is fast and can handle two people working from home no problem, which was vital for us.
The property is managed by Hatice who is extremely responsive and helpful.
We loved our stay here.

A cozy apartment, perfect for a couple.
We were looking for a place that we could live and work from online for a month: with two work desks and basic amenities, such as a properly equipped kitchen, a laundry machine, really good wifi, proper heating / air conditioning - we found all of that in the apartment. Also, the apartment has a lot of various storage spaces, which was great for a longer stay. There are a lot of windows in every room, so the natural light is amazing. Also, there is an artsy feel to this place - wooden floors, some art on the walls, interesting books on the shelf, other cozy little details.
Great area to stay, just steps away from Galata's main attractions (oldtown) and a walking distance to all kinds of transport: funicular, tramway, docks are all easy to access by foot. Galata itself is a lovely district, with cafes, artsy boutiques, patisseries, etc. The only thing to consider when picking this area is that Galata is a hill, and the apartment is in about the middle of that hill.
We are grateful for the flexibility and hospitality of the managers of this place, we felt welcomed and taken care of. The weekly cleaning service was more than we've expected and was a very pleasant surprise.

Excellent place to stay for a couple. Just like the pictures. Mustafa was waiting for us for check in. Be mindful that the area is a hill so you have to do a little climbing and also the apartment doesn’t have elevator. I would definitely stay here again and advice others to do the same. Lots of restaurants around and Galata Tower, Tram and Metro really near by walking distance.

the apartment is neat and clean, fully equiped kitchen and warm, accurate as in picture.
location is walking distance from the galata tower. Make us feel like at home.

description: Experience the magic of Istanbul from its most iconic neighborhood. Our hotel, located in the absolute center of Old city Sultanahmet, offers a blend of traditional hospitality and modern comfort. Whether you are here for a short visit or a long stay, our goal is to make you feel right at home while you explore the history right at your doorstep.

reviews.text:
room much smaller than in pictures, not suitable for 2 medium suitcases and 2 adults, it had a wall sconce falling out of the wall and a dank smell in the bathroom. we expressed our dissatisfaction and were offered a second room which was a small improvement. the bathroom floor flooded with each shower as the quality of construction was poor.
on a positive note, housekeeping cleaned and refreshed towels daily, there is a small elevator and 24x7 staff who were helpful and empathetic. For the price, I feel there are better options in the same neighborhood as it a tourist mecca.

Eser, Ersin and Katlin welcomed us the best way possible. The hotel is situated in the old part of Istanbul. We could park our car for free in front of the hotel, we had very good breakfast, I could leave my luggage after check out. The room was as on the pictures, with good bed and very nice shower + sea view. We also received local tips where to go, along with excellent communication through messages. Thank you!
Great location for the price. I came by car, so the free parking spot infront of the hotel was very useful. Recommend, if you want to stay in that area.

Had a fantastic weekend at this hotel!! I was very impressed with the hotel and its management. The staff was very kind and helpful. The rooms were nice and had a great sea view. Breakfast was wonderful!! Definitely get the breakfast here! The staff helped us with our taxi driver who tried to scam us, gave us directions to where things are in the area, and even helped me order a pizza because I don’t understand Turkish. Super super great staff here. They even had coffee and tea available whenever. I enjoyed sitting downstairs one evening drinking tea and talking to others who were staying at the hotel. We will be back to Istanbul in the future and I will absolutely come back here!!
The room was small but very clean, the administrator was extra helpful and friendly. We enjoyed our staying here. Breakfasts was tasty also it was a pleasure to have a cup of tea in the evening

description:
Enjoy a wooden duplex villa with a pool by the river in Agva.
With a fireplace, pool, barbecue, garden and a pier right by the river just for you and your loved ones. Our villa is completely isolated from the outside with two-meter fences.

reviews.text:
Our stay was good and the host was nice
But the downsides were:
we had troubles heating the house as the AC wasn’t working upstairs and the gas radiators weren’t working, there was electronic heaters in both rooms, but we found it necessary to keep refilling the logs of the chimney throughout the night.
as we went there in February we haven’t used the jacuzzi neither the pool. But I have noticed that the sittings chairs outside were broken.
The bedsheets had yellow stains and were dusty.
There wasn’t a grill grid available and when we contacted the host he said that we should come and pick it up from the center. We found it easier to check for an alternative in the nearby markets.
The kitchen utensils were sufficient for 4 but there wasn’t a pan with good condition.
There wasn’t kitchen paper towels.
The good sides:
The view was spectacular and its was a great escape from the city.
The place was spacious and it can be enough for large group.
The bathroom and toilet were clean

3 yetişkin ve 3 çocuk olarak, Perşembe ve Cuma olarak, 2 gün için evi kiraladık. Evin oda boyutlari, bahce vs fotograflarda goruldugu gibiydi. Genel olarak kullanimi rahat, 6 kisilik ailemiz rahatca sığdık. Ancak;
-ilk gittiğimiz gün tuvalet arızalıydı, vardığımızda zaten kullanılmaz durumdaydı. 6 kişi tuvaleti 1 gün kullanamadık. Bir gün sonra akşam üzeri ancak vidanjör çağırdılar. Bölgede kanalizasyon yok, atık çukurunun boşaltılması gerekiyor. Konuşmamızdan anladığıma göre, aslında biz giriş yapmadan önce tuvaletin çalışmadığını biliyorlardı fakat biz gelmeden-şikayet etmeden vidanjör çağırmadılar. 3 çocuk 3 yetişkin tuvaleti kullanamadık.
-kahvaltı dahil, yanda ki otelde verilir deniliyor ilanda. Otel araç ile 10dk mesafede. Yürüme mesafesinde değil. Yanda hiç değil. Bu yanlış bilgilendirme. Kahvaltı için saat 9:30 da gittik, restaurant duman altında, soba yeni yakılmış. Oturma imkanı yok ve aşırı derece soğuktu. Kahvaltı son derece vasat. Ürünler 3.sınıf benzin istasyonu ürünleri. Biz ikinci gün kendi kahvaltılığımızı alıp evde kahvaltı yapmak zorunda kaldık.
-Wifi var deniyor. Bağlanmıyor dediğimizde, şifreyi doğru yazın deyip durdular. Modemin yazılımını kontrol edince gördük ki aslında internet yok. Ama çıkmamıza yakın sabah aniden wifi geldi, tahmin ediyorum internet için yükleme yapıldı. Yada sorun her neyse çözüldü. Biz kaldığımız 2 gün boyunca bu hizmeti de alamadık.
-ev temizliği zayıftı. Salonun camları temizlenebilirdi, salondaki koltuk kirliydi, tuvaletteki fırcayı elinize kesinlikle almak istemezsiniz. Mutfakta kedi kılları vardı. Yatak takımları temizdi.
Özetle, evin boyutu, manzarası çok keyifli ancak işletme başarısız.
Özellikle hafta içi müşterilerine yeterince önem verilmiyor diye düşündüm.
Ben genelde şikayet etmem ancak art niyet ve vurdumduymazlık olduğunu hissettim.

Unfortunately, the villa we rented for Ramadan was far below our expectations. It bore no resemblance to the photos in the advertisements and was generally quite dirty.
The kitchen sink was clogged and the water wasn't running. The stove kept going on and off, making cooking almost impossible; we had to constantly turn it off and on again.
No firewood was provided for heating, which made the stay even more difficult.
In short, this experience was a disappointment for us and we definitely do not recommend it.

Evin konumu ve manzarası çok güzel ancak ev biraz bakımsız kalmış gibi. Ev sahibi ilgiliydi. Mutfak lambası çalışmıyordu ampulü değiştirdik yine de çalışmadı. Elektronik plastik çaycı vardı, çaydanlığı tercih ederdik. Şömine için çıra, tahta parçası, balta yoktu fakat yardım istediğimizde sadece tahta parçası bırakıldı. Alt kattaki yatak çok rahat değildi ve aşırı gıcırdıyordu. Banyo lavabosu da akıtıyordu. Salondaki halı kirliydi. Yakınlarda market yok gelirken tedarikli gelinmeli.

Evin konumu, doğallığı ve genel yapısı gerçekten çok güzel. Havuzu tertemizdi, odalar oldukça kullanışlı ve konforluydu. Doğayla baş başa, sakin bir tatil yapmak isteyenler için birebir. Biz iki gece konakladık ve genel olarak memnun kaldık.
Yine de gelmeyi düşünenler için birkaç küçük not: Tuvalet kapısı zor kapanıyor, kolay açılıyor ve içinde kilit yok. Bu durum özellikle kalabalık gelen misafirler için rahatsız edici olabilir. Evde televizyon var ama uydu kanalları yok ve YouTube, Netflix gibi uygulamalara da erişim sağlanamıyor. Ayrıca çevrede oldukça fazla kedi var. Biz kedi sevdiğimiz için sorun yaşamadık ama kediyle arası iyi olmayanlar için bu durum göz önünde bulundurulmalı. Gece doğadan gelen çeşitli hayvan sesleri duyulabiliyor, bu tür seslere hassas olanlar dikkat etmeli.
Bence bu kadar güzel bir yer bu fiyatı kesinlikle hak ediyor. Sadece evin içi biraz boş ve özensiz duruyor, küçük dokunuşlarla çok daha sıcak ve davetkâr bir hale getirilebilir. Yine de keyif vericiydi.

description: This is a cozy private room with ensuite bathroom, located in the quiet part of Sultanahmet area. You can easily reach the main square within 5-6 mins on foot, and have the chance to visit all the major attractions of the Old City.
