There are many places around where you can have dining including breakfast. Also, we have a 24/7 front desk agent to assist you with anything you might need.

reviews.text: Very nice and clean place situated in old Sultanahmet area very close to the main historical places. Sultanahmet, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar and all main museums are in the walking distance from this place. The room was exactly as it shown on the photos, clean and modern, beds were comfortable and cozy. The breakfast was made of traditional Turkish food and we got it on the roof terrace with amazing views on Sultanahmet mosque and the Sea of Marmara. Sunsets were also priceless over there. The staff was extremely friendly, we felt very welcome at the hosts place. All our questions were answered and all our requests like downloading our photos from camera card to our external hard drive disk were solved. We enjoyed our staying at this place and will definitely recommend it to all others. Next time our visiting Istanbul we will definitely consider to stay at this place!

Helpful & friendly staff. Listing was absolutely accurate. Safe neighborhood. The location is next to the Blue Mosque, 5 min walking distance. Excellent heating in rooms (in January). Very, very clean - bravo! Free mini bar with drinking water :)

Safe taxi service right outside the hotel. Print map, most of taxi drivers do not know the location. Hotel has a magnificent view from each room. Very good breakfast on the top floor overlooking the sea and the Blue Mosque.

Pros:
Responsive virtual host, Zeynap communicated well and was polite
Good location
Budget friendly
Cons:
No lift
Low ceilings in some rooms inc the shower (stayed in two different rooms during a split stay)
Noise - mainly from one particular member of staff during night shifts, who also tried to enter my room unannounced (not sure why)
Overall, felt safe as a solo female traveller, the place was a decent price and served its purpose. Would book again if I was on a tight budget

We had a wonderful first time visit to Istanbul with Deniz Houses Hotel! The hotel and apartments are in a series of next-door buildings, tucked into a quiet corner right below the Blue Mosque, and are within easy walking distance to the major Sultanahmet sites and metro stop. There were many cafes and restaurants nearby, and the whole area had a nice, safe, community feel to it - the atmosphere felt true to the old city district. We were given a lovely apartment-style room with living room, bedroom, and bathroom. The whole place had a beautiful, historic building feeling to it, with dark woods and rich carpets. The apartment was clean and spacious, the bathroom was great, the AC offered needed respite from the summer heat, and the fridge included free waters, teas, and coffees. The sea view from our balcony was lovely, and the view from the rooftop breakfast (hearty, diverse, and tasty options!) was even better - the Blue Mosque, towering right above! The staff provided maps and very helpful recommendations for touring, and also were able to help us arrange airport transfer. When we first arrived, the staff helped take our bags and then kindly gave us an overview of our location, some of the nearby sites and their history, and a few places further afield that we might want to check out. The wifi was a touch slow in the evening (when everyone else was logging on too!), but the staff were again very helpful in resetting and getting us back online. We had a marvelous stay and we're excited to come back some day!

Neighborhood in close proximity to all of the best sights in Istanbul, with a great view from the room. The room itself was very comfortable, very well kept and clean. The included breakfast on the rooftop was delicious and also was enjoyed with a great view. Definitely highly recommend this location, it is a great value with very welcoming hosts. The only thing is that this is more of a hotel than an airbnb apartment, but it is still definitely worth it.

description: The apartment is located inside a beautiful villa complex. 7/24 security and technical support is available. There is an outdoor swimming pool for guests. You will also find many spots for recreational activities inside the complex. You will enjoy your stay with your family at this peaceful location just outside the city of Istanbul.

reviews.text: Rezervasyondan çıkış yaptığımız ana kadar her istediğimizde çok iyi bir ilgi ve alakayla karşılaştık. Özellikle Onur Bey her konuda bizim aklımıza gelmeyen zamanlarda bile yardımcı olmak için elinden geleni yaptı, ilgisinden çok memnun kaldık. Genel olarak tavsiye edebileceğim bir yer. Fiyat performans olarak oldukça uygun. Açıklamalar ve fotoğraflarda hafif oynamalar olsa da kendilerine ulaşınca bu açığı rahatlıkla kapatıyorlar. Tekrar tercih edeceğimize eminim :)

Bir yere not verebilmek için illa kalıp konaklamak gerekmez . Müşteriye verilen değer belirler ve değer belirler bunu odaların temizliği değil kalplerin temizliği belirler bunu . Yerin konumu değil benim için müşterimin calisanlarin hele de yöneticilerin kalbindeki konumudur bu yüzden bana göstermiş olduğunuz anlayıştan dolayı sizlere 5 üzerinden 10 veriyorum . Allah yolunuzu açık eylesin bol kazançlar bol müşteriler dilerim en iyilerine layıksınız

Lighthouse da sorumlu Halil bey çok ilgili ve yardımsever birisi eksiklerimizi elinden geldiğince tamamladı. Bize karşı hep dost canlısı oldu. Teşekkürler Halil abi :) Kaldığım eve gelicek olursak
Resimler deki gibi büyük ve kullanışlı değildi. Eşyalar eskiydi, ama manzara olarak doğru ve güzel bi manzarası vardı. Konum olarak Şile merkeze ve sosyal alanlara çok yakın ben genel anlamda memnun kaldım Ayrıca havuzuda gayet temizdi. Çalışanlar ilgili sorunları hemen gideriyorlar.

Başta Cihan abi olmak üzere herkes çok ilgili ve çözüm odaklıydı. Her talebimize özel ilgi ve alaka ile dönüş sağladılar. Havuzu yeterli, konaklaması çok keyifliydi. Kafe restoran bölümünde de her türlü destek oldular. Konum olarak da şile merkeze çok yakın olduğundan toplu taşıma ya da araçla ulaşımda hiçbir sorun yaşamadık.

3 günlüğüne kaçamak yapmak istemiştik, beklentimizi karşıladı özellikle havuzu çok güzel ve temizdi. Cemil bey’e de teşekkürler sorunlarımıza hemen çözüm sağladı. Bir sonra ki planımız aylık giriş yapmak olacaktır. 🌸🌸

description: Cityloft 36, located in the center of Ataşehir with its 36 comfortable and friendly rooms, is adjacent to transportation channels such as Metro and E5, and very close to Palladium, Emaar and Acıbadem University. It is also only 15 minutes from the Bostancı pier. Cityloft 36, where you will fully experience the comfort of home with its 2+1 apartment feature, also has a market and café. Your boutique hotel, which has home comfort with its fully equipped kitchen, room design and satellite TV service, creates an ideal environment for both business and vacation

reviews.text: Good place to stay if you want quite and comfortable apartment. Friendly staff and easy check-in makes experience even better. Only thing I wish I had in apartment was more kitchen accessors. There was only one old and not goodlooking pan to cook a meal (No pots). Overall, I would give 8/10 to this apartment.
The photos are very misleading. The entire place smelled of cigarette smoke. We left the place very soon after arrival.
The place was good and comfortable. There were stains on the bed, covered by the sheets, nevertheless stains. Overall the stay was comfortable.

Fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibiydi. Temizlik dışında gayet iyiydi. Temizlikle ilgili konularda resepsiyondan Baver'e verdiğim geri bildirim sonrası odamızdaki temizlik problemi giderildi. Havlularda ve yerlerde temizlenmediğine ya da temizlik sonrası kontrol edilmediğine dair emareler vardı. Perdelerin bir kısmının raylardan çıkmış olması, giyinme dolaplarından birinin menteşelerinden birinin çıkmış olması yönetimin kontrol zaafiyeti izlenimi oluşturdu. Televizyon yayınının karasal olması, camlarda sineklik olmaması ve odanın ilaçlanamıyor olması tekrar gözden geçirilmeli bence. Çok küçük dokunuşlarla çok daha kaliteli bir hizmet verilebilir.
Enjoyed my stay, the beds were super comfortable and the place super clean.

description: Our property located in the historic area of Istanbul city, just 200 meeters from main tram station Beyazıt - Grand Bazaar. Blue Mosque, Topkapi Palace and St. Sophia Museum in 10 minutes walking. Very quite during nights.

reviews.text: Our stay was extremely comfortable. Suleman and other guys were helpful and they made us feel at home. The appartment was clean. The house keeping services could be compared to any good hotel. I beleive we got good value for every penny we spent.

This room is very bad, nothing clean, shower broken. Nothing for cooking. The view is not the best i swear. Guy is here only for getting money. Taxi can t pick u up front of this place. It s not safe the night.
Pics from airbnb look like amazing room but the feeling is like cheapest hotel .

Really nice apartment, exactly like in the pictures. Good location 5 min walk to grand bazar, 15 min walk to Blue mosque. Friendly staff they help in everything that we need. Cleaning services every morning. So I will recommend this place for a friend's

Excellent stay!! The location was perfect for seeing the sights AND the Grand Bazaar, and the host was extremely courteous and accommodating. But the best part was the bed, one of the best beds I ever slept in. If we ever return to Istanbul, we come directly here!!

The place was amazing, everything was a walking distance. The food around the suite was amazing. Very clean and tidy. The host was very helpful and easy to communicate with. All in all it was an amazing experience and i would definitely come back here again!

description:
We are happy to host you in our luxury residence with excellent comfort and transportation facilities, free high-speed internet, city view, outdoor pool, 24/7 security and communication with the host at any time of the day.

It has all the items that should be in a home. You will feel like at home.

A rental contract in accordance with Turkish law will be made at check-in. (AIRBNB)

In addition, since it is a mobile air conditioner, the water behind the air conditioner must be constantly checked and drained.

reviews.text: The host, Mehmet, responds instantly and helps me with anything I need. The location of the house is very nice and quiet. The house was very clean and tidy.. The air conditioner is strong and works well. Swimming in the outdoor pool was very enjoyable. Having 24/7 security allowed me to stay peacefully. There are many markets, cafes and restaurants around 3 minutes from the house. The wifi connection at Mehmet's home is fast enough for those who want to watch movies or have a meeting during the day. I had a very enjoyable time with my family. I will stay again when I come to Istanbul. I recommend it 100%. Thank you Mr. Mehmet

O anfitrião : Mehmet foi um bom anfitrião. Flexível e compreensivo com o check-in tardio. A comunicação com ele é muito rápida e fácil. Ajudou com todas as informações necessárias para chegarmos do aeroporto em sua casa.
O Lugar: fica 1 hora e 30 da área turística de Istambul. Não é central e Não há metrô perto. Há metrobus a uma distância de 20 minutos andando.
O corredor do ap cheira muito mal. Tem muitos gatos. moradores deixam restos de alimento na porta para eles. Não é culpa de Mehmet. Mas incomoda o mal cheiro.
A cozinha está equipada. A máquina de lavar funcionando ok. O chuveiro é sem suporte mas tem excelente pressão e água quente. Internet ótima. Espaço é como nas fotos.
Uma observação: esse lugar tem 2 comentários idênticos de duas pessoas diferentes. Isso me deixou desconfiada sobre a veracidade dos outros comentários que li ( Burcu e Mevlüt )
Mas tive uma estadia segura e sem problema durante 15 dias. Recomendo para estadias + curtas.

Evi çok beğendik. İstanbula geldiğimde yeniden konaklayacağım. Ev tertemizdi yatak ve kanepe çok rahattı. Wİ-Fİ fazla hızlıydı doyasıya film izledik. Kendi yemeğimizi pişirmemiz için tüm ekipmanlar vardı. Soğuk kış günlerinde ev sıcacıktı. Evin çervesinde çok sayıda market, cafe ve restoran vardı. Metrobüse 10 dk yürüme mesafesinde huzur dolu bir ev. Ayrıca ilgi ve alakasından dolayı Mehmet Beye çok teşekkür ederiz.
Excellent apartment, excellent and responsive host. I helped in everything, suggested how to get from the airport. I recommend it
Mehmet was very nice , he always reply very quickly . Restaurants and cafes are 3 min walk from the apartment . 24 hours Security which made us feel very safe .

description: Enjoy easy access to popular shops and restaurants from this charming place to stay.

reviews.text: We booked a hotel room via airbnb that was shown as being suitable for two people, with pictures that showed an additional single bed in a small separate bedroom off the larger hotel room with a double bed. When we arrived we were shown to a regular hotel room with only a double bed. When asked, reception showed us a different room that was larger but ostensibly with broken air conditioning that was running loudly the entire night and apparently could not be turned off. Either way, we returned to the original room, which was fine, and ok value for what we had paid, but it was not in line with what we had booked and the photos we had taken. Hot water stopped working for a full day apparently due to road works impacting the area. Otherwise, good location, clean rooms, friendly reception and lots of amazing restaurants in the area.

Yusuf was a great host — very friendly and welcoming. The place was clean and exactly as described. Although the area turned out to be more of a party destination than I expected, the room itself was surprisingly quiet and peaceful, which made for a comfortable stay. Would definitely recommend!

Yusuf’s place is amazing!! The rooms are exactly like the pictures, so big and so comfy!! Such good value for money! The beds were comfy and the bathroom was so big and stocked with everything needed! His place is in a great location right near a big shopping mall with lots of restaurants! I will be back!

Had a great stay at Hotel Fresia. The staff is extremely helpful and communicative and it’s right in the middle of all the restaurants and in a very happening are of Istanbul. Contrary to some of the reviews online, the rooms were actually very clean and quiet and it seemed like a good hotel to stay at. So if you’re planning for a cheap and simple stay at a good hotel then I’d recommend you book this one :)
Lovely clean hotel. Great decor, view from terrace is amazing. Great location in the heart of taksim square. Great hosts. Lots of shops and restaurants at your doorstep!

description:
The apart is located in a calm street right in the historic centre of Istanbul, close to many attractions: from museums to monuments to delicious food and the Istanbul nightlife. Only 50 meters away from The Taksim Square, making it easier to access public transport, pharmacies, hospitals, restaurants and shops.

Our instagram: @daphneperataksim

reviews.text:
We enjoyed our stay in Kahraman and Christine's place.
The place was clean and cozy and very close to Taksim square, Istiklal street, and major bus and metro lines. Christine was helpful and responsive, and she even lent us a scale so we can weigh our luggage before our flight. For the price, it was a great place.
A few things to consider:
1) The place is smaller than what it looks like in the pictures.
2) The street is very steep and if one has several luggages it is a bit of a hassle to get them there on foot.
3) The walls are super thin and one can hear a lot of noise from the street (including the early morning prayers).
Thanks for your hospitality and we may come back again in the future!

We had a very comfortable and pleasant stay. The room was clean and exactly as described. There is one bedroom with a comfortable bed and a living room with a window.
The kitchen was well equipped with everything needed for cooking. The Wi-Fi was excellent and worked very well throughout our stay.
The location is great — just about a 2-minute walk from Taksim Square, with everything you need nearby, including markets, restaurants, and McDonald’s.
The only thing that could be improved is the refrigerator, which seems to need some maintenance.
Overall, it was a convenient, comfortable, and hassle-free stay. We would be happy to stay here again.

Everything was exactly like the photos — perfectly the same! The place is super cozy and comfortable ✨ For anyone planning to visit Istanbul, please stay here! If I ever come back, I’ll definitely stay here again 💖
Even though it’s on a little hill, it’s just a short walk so no problem at all ! The room and bed are really comfy, the TV’s a smart TV, and the neighborhood is nice and quiet 🌙 — unlike hotels near Taksim that get noisy at night 😅
There’s also a small convenience store just about 50 meters down the street , perfect for daily needs with friendly prices 💸
stayed here with my baby , and she was super happy and comfortable the whole time 💞 The room felt really safe and cozy for us!
And Christine, the host, was super helpful and kind 🫶 She always responded quickly and made sure everything went smoothly — really appreciated that! 💕
Totally recommend this place! ⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️

I traveled to Istanbul for medical treatment and stayed at the Jasmin apartment at Daphne Pera.
The apartment is super clean, well laid out, and perfectly located, just a few minutes from Taxim Square. With modern furniture throughout the apartment is well maintained. The main bedroom is lovely and comfortable. The kitchenette is modern with everything you would need for a short stay.
The host, Kahraman, is very helpful and accommodating. Communication with him was quick with any and all advice and information provided quickly.
His assistant, Christine, is soft-spoken, polite, and extremely helpful also. She checked on us regularly and looked after us throughout our stay.
I hope to stay here on my return visit and would highly recommend Daphne Pera.

I had a really great stay at this place. The apartment was exactly as shown in the photos—clean, comfortable, and very well maintained.
Communication with the host was extremely smooth and clear from start to finish, which made everything easy and stress-free. I felt completely at ease throughout my stay.
The location is also a huge plus—it's perfectly situated near Taksim, making it very convenient to get around and explore the area.
Overall, I highly recommend this place. Nothing to complain about! 🙏🙏

description: 2 Bedroom Apartment in a Great Location

reviews.text: We enjoyed our stay at Mehmet’s place big time! Great location near to the Galata tower with easy access to public transport and walkable routes, but be ready to climb steep streets and stairs and hear the noises from the touristic surroundings. The flat is cozy and clean and has everything you need for a week or two long stay, though the photos show it less worn. Mehmet is a welcoming and very responsive host, and we appreciate such a hospitable approach. Say our hi to the cats living nearby and enjoy your time in beautiful Istanbul!

Mehmet is a great host, very helpful and friendly, he even walked me to the local supermarket. The flat is in an amazing location, right in the heart of Galata, close to the tram and funicular. There are loads of cafes, bars, restaurants and shops close by. I walked around after dark on my own and felt quite safe in the neighbourhood. The flat is shabbier than the pictures, but is well- sized with all you need for a comfortable stay. The beds are very comfortable and there’s plentiful hot water for showers.

The location of Memhet’s apartment is pretty near perfect. It’s only a ten minute walk to the Galata Bridge and it’s many waterside restaurants, ferry terminals and just round the corner from the bustling Galata Tower area but in a quiet side street and a 30 minute walk or a quick tram journey to the Sultanahmet area with many of the main sites. You can get the funicular at Tunel back up the hill and from there it’s a ten minute stroll downhill back to the apartment.
Mehmet was friendly and very helpful. He organised transfers from and back to the airport for us which was really worth doing. He provided us with the card you need to top up and use on all the different forms of transport (which is fantastic value) and gave us recommendations on restaurants. There are also a good selection of guide books in the apartment.
The apartment was a good size with comfy beds and a decently equipped kitchen.
Mehmet definitely deserves the title of Superhost

This listing is as described, and the location is great! You will be steps away from the Galata tower, close to many restaurants, markets and public transportation. Despite the central location, the street is quiet in the evenings and very safe. The apartment is well equipped and the internet works very well. Mehmet, the host, is very helpful, he helped me to arrange transportation to and from the accommodation. I stayed at this apartment for nearly a month and I highly recommend!

The apartment is as golf as you can see in the photos, stylish and cute, perfect for 4 or 5 people. The host is really kind and helpful, he was in touch all the time to make our stay perfect. The location is the best if you are looking to see Istanbul in a few days, there are also a lot of bars and restaurants close to the place, as well as small divine shops to buy cheap gifts and souvenirs. We loved it! I definitely recommend this apartment and this city, I will come back for sure!

description: The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place. Next to marmara park . 1 minute to metrobüs

reviews.text: The host was super kind and helpful. He was very flexible regarding the checking in and checking out. He even offered us sweets and filled the fridge with water and chocolate. The place was clean and tidy. Due to the heavy rain few days before our checking in, there were a leakage in one of the bedrooms (some drops from the roof in the corner of the room). Since there were no enough time to fix that, the host offered another flat, however we decided to stay. The leak stopped when it get shinny. Overlll, it was a good stay, and if the mulled/leak is fixed I would say its a great apartment to stay at. Also, the host is super friendly and kind, also he offered us pizzas to be delivered to the flat, but unfortunately we were already out. Thank you for your kindness and wish you the best.

Great family stay in the apartment. It was our home away from home. Apartment is clean, very warm and quiet. Kitchen is equipped very well. I would recommend it. Metrobus and Shopping Centre is very close.
The apartment was nice and clean and the location was very nice with a lot of shops and restaurants near by. I recommend staying here.

This was a memorable stay for all our family members who flew in from various parts of the world. The stay was excellent, really felt like our home. The host was always available if we needed anything (any time of the day or night). We also had the opportunity to spend some quality time with the host, which was truly memorable. Location of this apartment is perfectly close to the mall, restaurant and vendors, at the sometime it is away from the city madness. It is just perfect! The best Airbnb experience we had so far!!!
⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
The only problem is the AC it’s not much cold

description:
Feel Istanbul in this perfect location.

This stylish, well-decorated, spotlessly clean, large, and unique suite has a high-quality bathroom and elevator in a great location in the Beyoğlu/Taksim district. The magnificent view of Istanbul can be seen from its private balcony.

For more, please look at my other two listings in the same building.

reviews.text:
Our stay at Bilge’s apartment was fantastic. Perfectly situated for us to be able to explore all that Istanbul has to offer, close to Istiklal but with none of the noise. We especially enjoyed exploring the Cihangir and Tomtom areas.
Bilge was really communicative, so helpful and gave us loads of great tips! She also supported with a self check in after our flight was delayed.
The apartment was a true reflection of the photos - clean, spacious and decorated nicely. The view over to the Blue Mosque in the evening was gorgeous.
Our trip was made complete by the gorgeous Porsuk - Bilge’s cat living in the bookshop downstairs. We enjoyed being greeted by her in the mornings and coming home to a friendly face!

We had a great time at Bilge's place. The location couldn't be more perfect. The host has sent us super-comprehensive instructions about how to get to the place, including helpful tips about transport and prices. The check-in was easy. The apartment looks really cool inside and it's nice to be in. We lacked nothing. The bookshop downstairs is cool and there's a cute cat who chews books! There is a school across the road and the students started their day earlier than us on weekdays, so there was some noise, but it didn't bother us much.
Huge thanks to Bilge for the whole experience! Would love to stay here again.

We had a wonderful stay at Bilge’s apartment. She was an excellent host and we appreciated her proactive tips about transit. The apartment was very clean and cute and the view was excellent. It was exactly as it appears in the photos & listing. Porsuk the cat was one of the best parts. Also cannot more highly recommend the location. We hope we will be back!

The apartment is located right in the heart of Istanbul, next to the main street Istiklal. Finding it was easy as Bilge offered clear instructions on how to get there based on our arrival at the Istanbul coach station. We arrived early after an overnight bus trip, but Bilge showed how great of a host she is by allowing us to check in earlier, which we greatly appreciated!
The building is beautiful, with a cozy bookstore in the lobby that you pass through as you walk in and out. An added bonus was the really sweet cat living in the bookstore that welcomed us every time and enjoyed being petted!
The flat also met our needs perfectly and had all amenities listed! There is a large desk for two that allows working, the internet was fast, the bed was very comfortable, and the bathroom had all the necessary products. There is a small balcony overlooking the sea with big sliding doors that isolate the noise from outside.
I recommend this apartment for two people and we would gladly return!

We enjoyed our time at this centrally located suite, which had everything we needed for the stay. The place was clean and looked as described. Location is just a few minutes from Istiklal and a 10-15 minute walk to Taksim square, so it is quite busy at any time. Some street noise is present but not too disturbing. We really loved having the little bookshop with the cutest cat on the ground floor. Overall would recommend for a stay near Istiklal.

description: Totally new renovated in the heart of old-town Istanbul!

reviews.text: Fantastic Airbnb and amazing host, I loved my stay here, and was sorry to leave. The location is perfectly situated in Istanbul’s historical hub, Sultanahmet, right in the heart of the city’s most prominent attractions, and Surrounded by great restaurants and shopping. The room itself, is the top floor, Batuhan helped me to carry my bags, it’s small but clean and comfortable, great bathroom, stocked with water, coffee tea and a small fridge, everything worked perfectly,it also has a lovely private terrace from which you can see the Hagia Sofia. There is also another larger terrace that is available to guests.Batuhan is an amazing host, always available to help and offer advice,he organised transfer to and from the airport and gave great tips on the local area, and even took time to show me around, he’s really easy going and friendly and nothing is a problem, I was so grateful to him for making my stay so memorable. I’ll definitely be back 😊you’re lucky if you get to stay here ! 🙏

Incredible lodging in the heart of Istanbul, with superb location(walking distance to wonderful historic sites like Hagia Sofia, Blue Mosque, Grand Bazaar, sea wall etc) and good restaurant and bars. The room was exceptionally clean, modern, with great views of Sultanahmet neighborhood and everything we needed for a comfortable 3 night stay. The bed was very comfortable and spacious, even for two adults; having coffee & relaxing on the private balcony and common terrace made us feel like true locals! Batuhan is an incredible host who is not only knowledgeable of all things Istanbul but goes above and beyond by helping answer any questions about the city’s history and current events and provides great recommendations, orchestrates airport shuttle etc. He is very responsive, kind and customer service oriented and we truly appreciated his insight and had a trip of a lifetime all thanks to him! This place is truly a gem and you can’t beat the price for such an incredible location. We are already planning our next trip to Istanbul to stay at Teos!

I stayed a month and a half and I highly recommend Batuhan,s boutique hotel.
Owner Batuhan is very friendly, helpful, greatly attentive and responds immediately if you have any questions.
The room I had with balcony, is very nicely decorated, with a comfortable bed, great bathroom and step-in shower.
The rooms are cleaned very well every day, with fresh towels and supplies, thanks to the very sweet, attentive and caring housekeeper “Gule”.
Staying with Batuhan and Gule, feels like coming home.
The AirBnb is within walking distance to all the famous attractions in Sultanahmet.
There are many cozy and tasty restaurants nearby, as well lots of pretty shops.
For all other nice sights in the further neighborhoods, you can easily take the tram, a 10-minute walk from Batuhan's rooms.
I had a wonderful stay, Thank you again for your kindness and care towards me 🫶

This a great location about a block from the Hagia Sophia. Easily walkable to the top sites in Istanbul with many restaurants close at hand. We stayed in the top floor room, three flights up with no elevator but worth the climb. It is not a large room but it is comfortable with a new bathroom. It also has a terrace that looks on the Hagia Sophia dome and minarets. It is the perfect place for morning coffee. Just outside the door is another terrace, open to all guests that is the perfect spot for a glass of wine at the end of the day. It looks over a 6th century roman bath to the Sea of Marmara with glittering Asian Istanbul in the distance. Beautiful.
We have stayed at quite a few airbands and Batuhan is the best host we have ever had. He is friendly and gregarious; wiling to to do what ever he can to make your stay enjoyable. I don't have enough space to list all the ways he cared for us. He said he loves his job and it shows.

A well maintained, clean and quaint place. My unit was on the top floor with its private balcony as well as access to a roof top patio overlooking the city and view of water. The place is within walking distance of many historical site in Sultanahmet’s neighborhood. Well worth the price. The host was communicative and very responsive. It rained during my two day visit and thankful they had a couple of umbrellas available to use, which I greatly appreciated.

description: Enjoy a simple and comfortable stay in this centrally located quiet place. Close to the Turkish German University, Medipol and Beykoz Universities. 50 meters to the bus stop. It is within walking distance to places such as the market, the beach, and the hospital. Free parking is available. It is close to Medistate Hospital.

reviews.text: Although the house appeared quite old outside, it has beautiful interior and breathtaking view from the windows. The apartment was spacious, equipped with all the necessary amenities and had good internet connection. The host was truly kind and friendly, always available and ready to offer assistance or provide helpful advice. However, there were a few downsides to my stay. Hot water only flowed from the showerhead, while the kitchen sink and bathroom sink provided only cold water. The kitchen lacked sufficient lighting, with only one working bulb. The staircase leading up to the apartment was extremely steep and challenging, especially when carrying heavy suitcases. Although the house is located near a bus stop, the buses operated with a frequency of only once every half hour. Walking to the seaside (Beykoz) is quite inconvenient, as it required traversing a busy road. It's better to have a car or take a taxi.

Ev girişi ev sahibiyle aynı kapıdan tek kapı bu büyük bir problem, en önemlisi herhangi bir güvenlik durumu söz konusu değil mahalle arasında eski bi yapı daha sonra içeri girer girmez dik bir merdiven karşılıyor önceki halıflexi kullanım dolaysıyla sanırım merdivenler sapsarı yapıştırıcı ve kötü koku var yatak konforsuz çarşaflar eski ve tiftiklenmiş yastıklar kâğıt gibi incecik klima eski gürültülü ve soğutmuyor bu yüzden iptal ettim ve kalmadım

Ev fotoğraflarda görüldüğü gibiydi. Ev sahibi her konuda gayet hızlı yardımcı oldu. Konumu itibari ile biraz yokuş mevcut ancak çok yakınından geçen otobüs hatları vardı. Muhteşem bir boğaz manzarasına sahip. Eski bir İstanbul semtinde sakin bir mahalle ortamında konaklamak isterseniz doğru bir seçim olacaktır.

Öznur hanım’ın evinden çok memnun kaldık. Boğaz manzarası fotolardakinden bile iyi. Evde gereksiz hiçbir eşya yok ama ihtiyaç olabilecek hemen her şey mevcut. Öznur hanım çok iyi bir ev sahibi, rica ettiğimiz birkaç konu vardı, hepsinde de çok yardımcı oldu. Eve çıkış merdivenleri biraz dar, fakat yaşlı değilseniz veya bir özrünüz yoksa zorlanmazsınız. Banyoda sıcak su sıkıntısı yok, fakat musluğu sonuna kadar açınca su ılık akıyor, fakat bizim için bir sorun olmadı. Genel olarak, fiyat performans açısından çok iyi bir seçim yapacağınızı düşünüyorum burada kalarak. Biz tekrar gelebilmek için sabırsızlanıyoruz.
Öznur harika bir ev sahibi ve evin konumu duraklara ve ihtiyacınız olan her yere yakın. Deniz manzarası harika. Kesinlikle paranıza değer.

description:
In the center of Istanbul, in 4. Levent. It is in a valuable location where you can mingle with life as soon as you step in and find a solution to all your needs.
The whole group will enjoy easy access to everything from this centrally located place.
Every minute is peaceful with controlled entrances and exits, a private security team and a state-of-the-art safety system.
Indoor parking,
Fiber fast internet,
Metro station is a 4-minute walk away.

reviews.text: Ev merkezi bir konumda, temiz ve düzenliydi. Ev, ilandaki fotoğraflarla birebir uyumluydu. Check-in süreci net ve sorunsuz ilerledi. Önder Bey mesajlara hızlıca yanıt verdi, ilgili ve çözüm odaklıydı. Sessiz ve konforlu bir konaklama deneyimi yaşadık. Gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim.

I had a great stay at this apartment! The place was clean, comfortable, and exactly as described. The location is excellent — quiet, safe, and close to everything I needed. There are two ways to access the property: one through a hill and another via a flat route, frrom. The reviews this can be consfusing as some say flat and some mention the steep hill.

Önder bey was our host for 13 days. I and my husband loved everything during this trip.
The place is very nice, convenient, clean and bright.
The security, free inside parking area, a lot of stores, cafes and street food made our stay very easy and comfortable.
As we are the family of coffee lovers, Önder bey bought a brand new coffeemaker for us.
Also, he is a very nice, caring host who always is willing to help. We really appreciate what he did for us and are very thankful 🙂.
I honestly recommend this place ))

A good place to spend a few days in Istanbul. The property was exactly as described and the neighbourhood is very authentic. It is very easy to get to the city centre and main sights using the public transport directly near the house (either a bus or a metro). Ônder was very friendly and helpful in communicating.

I had a generally good stay at Alya Residence in Istanbul. The host was responsive and helpful. However, the location was not ideal as it was very local and crowded. Please please avoid the travelling from the other side route (opposite to train station) as you will find yourself in a lot of up and down hills. The nearby mosque was loud and often disturbed me, especially in the mornings. It is not on the good side of Levent and the walk to the train station took about 10-15 minutes. Unfortunately, not enough facilities were provided for a month-long stay. Basic necessities like toilet paper, rubbish bags, dish soap, and dishwasher tablets were not adequately stocked.
Additionally, the pillows on the bed were not comfortable and mattresses could have been of better quality. Despite these issues, the host was helpful throughout my stay. Overall, it was an OKAY experience.

description: From this centrally located place, you can easily access everything as a whole group. Close to the beach. I live in the house, so the house is not rented out alone.

reviews.text: Zeynep Hanım muhteşem bir ev sahibi. Sizinle rezervasyonun ilk gününden son gününe kadar başarılı bir iletişimi var. Karşılaması, sohbeti ve samimiyeti ile verdiği güven ve aitlik hissi evinizi asla aratmıyor. Oda fazlasıyla geniş, temiz ve rahat. Maltepe sahile ve marmaraya çok yakın. Cadde güvenilir, site de aynı şekilde. Kendisine teşekkür ediyorum.

Zeynep is very nice host, kind and friendly. Her place is in the perfect location near to good restaurants, shops and seaside. The house is clean and comfortable I feld like home.
Highly recommended.
Zeynep is an amazing person and a great host. Shes very easygoing and made me feel comfortable during my stay. The location is also perfect and you can access publicly transportation in no time
Zeynep hanım anlayışlı ve canayakın bi ev sahibi, ev sessiz ve düzenli, konumu güzel. Tavsiye ediyorum.
Konaklama için teşekkürler ancak uyuduğum yatağın çarşafı ve yastığı kirliydi. Buna takıntılı biri olarak uyuyamadım düzgün. Ancak ev sahibi iletişim konusunda başarılıydı.

description: From this central location, you can easily access everything as a group. You can enjoy the view of the coast at Tersane Istanbul, which is 100 meters away, and enjoy activities such as shopping, eating, drinking, entertainment and concerts at Tersane Mall.

reviews.text:
I highly recommend this Airbnb—it is even better than the photos. The most important part of my stay was Esra and her mom; they are incredibly warm and welcoming, and I truly felt at home. Esra also helped me with my luggage, which I truly appreciated. I also recommend asking about their menu. I had meatballs for Christmas dinner, and they were amazing—very delicious and homemade.
The best part was how much Kadriye cared about me; she even went with me to make sure I took the correct bus to the airport. Esra’s mom felt like my own mom during my stay. The home is also very well located, close to a beautiful mall and several bus stations, which made getting around very easy

Big thank you to Esra and her Mum for a lovely few days.
If you love the old school Airbnb style of staying in someone’s home then this is for you. I felt so welcome and Esra was super helpful with anything I needed.
It was a treat to stay in a local neighbourhood of Istanbul away from the tourist crowds, but everything was still easily accessible.
Oda son derece konforlu bütün ihtiyaçlar karşılanıyor, İstanbul Avrupa yakası için merkezi konumda, fiyat performans bizi tatmin etti

Would highly recommend this place if you are a woman visiting Istanbul alone. Esra and her mum are amazing hosts. I am very honoured that I got to spend time with them and their cats. Extremely helpful and kind people.

Es war eine sehr schöne Erfahrung, bei Esra und ihrer Mutter Kadriye zu Gast zu sein! Die Unterkunft ist gemütlich und sauber, die Lage sehr angenehm: ruhig und abseits der Touristenströme, aber trotzdem durch öffentliche Verkehrsmittel (Bus oder Fähre) gut angebunden. Was aber unseren Aufenthalt so besonders schön gemacht hat, war die Gastfreundschaft von Mutter und Tochter. Esra hat uns mit vielen Tipps und Informationen geholfen, Istanbul zu entdecken und und auch die Kostproben der leckeren Küche ihrer Mutter haben wir sehr geschätzt. Für Katzenfreunde wie uns ein weiterer Pluspunkt: die süßen und sehr zutraulichen Katzen! Wir hatten eine sehr schöne Zeit und bedanken uns, dass wir uns wie zuhause fühlen durften!

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place.

reviews.text:
I had a great experience staying at this Airbnb in Istanbul. The place was very clean, comfortable, and exactly like the photos. The location was perfect — close to everything but still quiet and peaceful. The host was super friendly, helpful, and always quick to respond. They made check-in very easy and gave great local tips.
The apartment had everything I needed, and I really appreciated how cozy and well-decorated it was. I felt safe and at home the entire stay. I would definitely come back and highly recommend this place to anyone visiting Istanbul!

A very nice place for a large family stay (sleeps 7 people). Ihsan is a very nice host, always very responsive. Check-in and check-out went very easy. The apartment is exactly as on the photos, clean and spacious with two full bathrooms. The neighborhood is very quiet, has small shops and restaurants around, also a relatively large supermarket is just 3 min away. The closest tram stop, Fener, is 12 min walking distance but there is also bus connection on the neighbor street to the metro lines. We recommend this apartment for the family stays.

Ihsan is a very responsive host. He was very helpful to me with fixable check-in and provided me with info about the area and my general questions about visiting Istanbul. His place looks just like the pictures! Clean, spacious, and comfy.
The place is new, with clean furniture. The kitchen equipment is nice and there is enough tableware to get the job done. The beds are comfy enough.
Each room has a separate AC, which is very nice. Overall, We were happy with the place and thank Ihsan for allowing us to stay there. I really recommend it if you'd like to visit Istanbul and stay in the Fatih area.

We had a fantastic stay! The apartment was very clean, well-equipped, and exactly as described in the listing. The location was perfect, and the host was incredibly welcoming and responded quickly to messages. We truly felt at home and comfortable throughout our stay. Highly recommended, and we would love to come back!

Bright and pretty big apartment in the family neighborhood where only locals live. At the beginning it felt a bit dangerous to walk in this neighborhood but eventually kinda comfortable and even cozy. The kitchen is fully equipped with the devices but I must admit that it has not enough basic accessories and dishes. The A/C worked well, the beds are fine. One downside - we had an impression, that some linen weren't fresh. The water drains in the showers could be cleaned up a bit. A lot of small shops and markets within the 10 minutes walk as well as cafes and restaurants. The bus stop (to get to the Galata bridge) is about 15 min of walk and then 10 minutes of drive. I also want to mention, that Ihsan reacted very fast to our questions and helped to resolve the issues quickly.

description: My suites are in Sultanahmet, the most beautiful and most historical area of Istanbul. There are 5 or 10 minutes walking distance to historical places. Topkapi Palace, Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia, Grand Bazaar, Hippodrome, shops, markets, tram stations, boat and bus stops.

reviews.text: The place was as shown in the pictures and very well maintained. It is a short walk from the Cemberlitas tram stop and a walk from the main sites of Hagia Sophia and Blue Mosque, however the walk to the tram stop is uphill. I stayed here for a week and had no problems whatsoever. It would be worth mentioning it is a part of an aparthotel, which would make it easier to find. There is a cleaning lady who cleans every day free of charge which is really helpful. There is a shared kitchen which I only ended up using once but was well stocked. Cavit is responsive and helpful. I requested for a slightly late check out which could not be accommodated for but that is understandable. Overall, no issues and a very enjoyable stay!

The host was actually very responsive and helpful, the place looks exactly like the pictures. and we ended up staying here because it was the only place available for our dates. However, the property is really not worth the price and the amenities provided. this place listed a kitchen, but it turned out to be a shared kitchen with no mention of this in the description at all. remind you, using the washing machine requires an extra fee. The room itself is very small, and even though there is a sofa bed, the space is way too cramped to justify charging a full extra guest fee. the worse thing is for the fourth guest who was charged full price, they only provided a thin piece of cloth instead of a proper blanket or bedcover. Basic amenities were also lacking as drinking water was only given at check-in and never refilled daily. I do not recommend this place, especially for a family vacation. For this price, you are much better off looking for a hotel nearby. Think twice before bookin

The accommodation is very conveniently located near the tourist attractions. The balcony suite was clean, with all the necessary amenities. The view from the balcony was a bonus. The kitchen was useful and it also had an adjacent laundry area which was convenient although it was located in the basement. Overall it was good value, and a nice stay with great hosts. The only criticism is that the area outside the hotel had some bushes which I thought could have been cleared but perhaps this is a municipal issue and not the hotel's problem.

The photos do not match the state of the rooms. Room needs maintenance - broken door handle in bathroom, peeling wall paper, exposed electrical lines and worst of all- mold all over the shower. The elevator was very useful, the room had a great view of the water, the location was close to all attractions and the host was responsive to other needs. Did not use any amenities offered, so cannot comment.

Thank you for a wonderful stay at the hotel!
We booked a room and the receptionist offered us a transfer from the airport. It was a great decision. When we arrived, we had to wait a bit for the car, but the transfer back arrived on time. Both times they were large cars with at least 6 seats for the two of us! :)
The hotel is located in an excellent place; many attractions can be reached on foot in 10 minutes.
The room was as in the photo, everything was as in the description. The room was clean, the bed was comfortable, and the balcony on the 3rd floor had a view of the sea. The hotel was quiet and calm. Administrator Tukan and Cavit helped resolve all our issues with late check-out. Thank you for the warm welcome!

description:
H&L Suites, with its 11 rooms will be glad to host you in our clean and fresh rooms with facilities incluing a kitchenette in each room and an elevator.
H&L Suites welcomes you to one of the best located Apart in Istanbul and one of the few with an elevator. H&L Suites is located in the heart of the old town because it is in walking distance to main tourist attractions such as Grand Bazaar and Blue Mosque, Hagia Sophia Museum, Topkapi Palace Museum, Basilica Cistern.

reviews.text:
Hello,
A very beautiful design apartment is situated in the historical center of Istanbul.
It is well equipped and has a kitchen, a sofa and a bed.
You are 15 minutes walking from Sultanahmet, a supermarket is in 2 minutes walking, a lot of cafes and restaurants are near.
The cleaning service is every day.
The host and the staff are very friendly and helpful.
The building has elevator and this is a big advantage for Istanbul.
I recommend you to stay in the apartment.

Staying at H&L Suites was a great experience for us, from the beginning of the reservation Mr. Taner was always ready to assist us to make our stay memorable. The flat is more than an apart with the comfort of luxury hotel including daily cleanning service, 24 hours check in - check out service, elevator and self control air conditioner. The location of the apartment is close to all historical sights and the flat itself was very spacious and clean. We will definetely come back and recommend to anyone looking for an apart.
The place was just as described, clean, modern, spacious, and close to many stores and restaurants. Taner was very responsive and attentive.

We enjoyed our stay here. Cabs and drivers had a hard time with the address for some reason. When we arrived, we found that we were moved to a different room that was similar to the listing but a little different. The elevator did not go all the way up to that floor so we had to take it to the fifth floor and take the stairs the rest of the way. The apartment overall was otherwise very comfortable and the hosts were helpful. My suitcase broke and I needed a screwdriver to fix it, and the host was able to provide it. An iron was available on request.

Awesome place. Very clean and they come everyday to replace towels, empty garbage and make the bed. It’s also extremely well situated and walking distance from Hagia Sophia and the Blue Mosque. Lots of shop and restaurants around. There’s a grocery store right across the street, a drugstore 2 minutes away. I mean it’s perfect and I strongly recommend.?

description:
My flat is in a famous street of Galata, 7 minutes walking distance from Galata Tower. It is planned to provide pleasure and accommodation to my guests.

-Our apartment is in a very quiet street, the best place to relax and very central!

-Our flat is a 5 minute walk from Istiklal street.

It is 5-10 minutes away from metro, tram, bus and ferry stops.

It is a newly renovated flat. Round trip from Istiklal Caddesi, Old City, Karakoy, Eminonu.

reviews.text:
The apartment is super clean and well decorated. It includes all the amenities as described : dishwasher, electric kettle, coffee makers, pots and glasses, mugs and etc. Gülsen also leaved bottles of water in fridge that was really thoughtful of him. The communication was easy and he was always available to answer my questions. The apartment is walkable to the famous Istiklal street, Galata tower, a ferry station. and good bakeries and restaurants. Also it’s really easy to get a taxi just in front of the apartment if you need. If you are sensitive to street noises bare in mind that one of the bedrooms has some street noise, however Gülsen mentioned that to me beforehand. But still there are three quite bedrooms that can easily 5 people use.
Overall we really enjoyed our stay in the apartment and I recommend the apartment if you’re looking for a clean, accessible, and stylish place to stay in Istanbul.

We (7 adults and 1 toddler) stayed in this apartment for 5 nights.
The description and photos here are precise and 100% match the reality. Check-in time was flexible due to our change of flight schedule. The host and assistant are quite friendly and responsive. Amneties are complete from dishwasher to bed sheets and towels, there was everything for a lengthy accomodation. All 4 bed rooms and beds were clean and comfortable and the staircase to the apartment did not bother us as mentioned in some comments.
The location is good, around 10 minutes walk to Istiklal street or Galata tower and even less to the metro/bus station.
There is still potential for improving some details in the apartment (as there is for every Airbnb) But in general me and my family we were totally satisfied and comfortable during our stay and i recommend it to large groups of travelers.
I forgot to leave one set of the keys inside when we left and Gülşen was very kind and forgiving towards this issue

Had a comfortable stay at Gulşen’s apartment. The location is really great and within walking distance from Istiklal street and Taksim square.
The furniture, beds and other amenities are in good shape and well maintained with a reasonably well equipped kitchen (a microwave would however be a good addition).
The apartment is in a very old building so it’s natural to expect a lack of some amenities like elevator, but that has been mentioned in the description so cannot complain.
It would be a 5* stay if not for one factor which is that there is only 1 full bathroom and not 2. There’s an extremely small shower area - barely enough for larger people. This made it a bit difficult for a big group of people to use the toilets. The description does mention it’s 1 bathroom and 1 shower but in the heading it says 2 bathrooms. I just wish there was a bit more clarity on that front.
Otherwise really enjoyed our stay and Gulsen was a great responsive host!

Great location! Walk a bit and you reach Istiklal street, go left, it is Taksim sq., or go right, it is Galata Tower. Everything you need is there, from shopping spots to currency exchange and grocery shops. It is very accessible and taxis can come right up to the front door of the building.
The flat itself is on the first floor so there is a short climb to the flat door. Gülşen assistant helped us with our luggage and bags and carried them upstairs. As described, there are two bathrooms one of which is a shower only and the other has the toilet. With a larger group, it needs some managing but again nothing that caused us huge inconvenience. One of the bedrooms faces the street in front of the building and could get a bit noisy so if you are sensitive to that, pick the other 3 rooms.
Gülşen and his team are very responsive and provided whatever we needed. There was an issue with the small shower which was dealt with quickly. Gülşen gracefully refunded for one night.
Thanks Gülşen!

This house is right in the heart of everything. Location is absolutely perfect if you want to explore the city. We could easily walk to Galata tower, Taksim square and Istiklal street from here.
1. The house is after a flight of spiral stairs but Gulsen’s assistant met us at the gate of the house & helped us with all the luggage.
2. The house has 1 shower and 1 shower + WC but we were able to manage.
3. Kitchen is equipped with all the basic things one may need.
4. Gulsen is a very responsive host and was made the stay very very comfortable.
Would definitely stay here if in Istanbul the next time.
P.S. we were just mad lucky to see a wedding procession leaving the building next door from the house which added that little moment unexpected joy

description:
Experience a unique stay in this 120 year old historic roman apartment..

It has been given a contemporary interior design, making it a very relaxing and comfortable home.

The apartment is located in a friendly cheerful neighborhood. And has nice cafes and supermarkets nearby.

The apartment is a 5 minutes walking distance from the Galata tower, Galataport, Sishane metro station, Tophane tram station and the beautiful Cihangir neighborhood.

reviews.text:
The apartment was nice and clean inside, with nice furniture.
There is no street parking available which should be noted in the listing. you must pay to park your car in a nearby garage.
Hot water did not work during our stay but the Host communicated well and said that normally the hot water works.
it was very noisy at night with motorcycle’s roaring up and down the street.
checkin/checkout was easy

The apartment was as described, comfortable, clean and quiet. Great location, easily walkable to many main attractions, restaurants, shops and public transportation. Suheyla is one of the best hosts I've had, she was very responsive, communicative, helpful with recommendations and friendly. I could not recommend her place more.

Daire görsellerdekiyle aynıydı, hatta daha sıcak ve konforluydu! Suheyla hanım çok kibar ve yardımsever birisi. Giriş-çıkış konusunda herhangi bir problem yaşamadık, kendisi çok yardımcı oldu. Ev gayet temiz ve rahattı. Dekorasyon tartışılamaz bile!😍 Konumu, ev sahibi, daire, kısacası herşey çok çok güzeldi.

Suheyla is the best host ever. She was very attentive and friendly. The apartment is located in a quiet location, but it is very close to the Galataport and the Istanbul Modern Art Museum. Other tourist spots like the Galata Tower, Istiklal Avenue, Taksim Square, and Cihangir district are also within walking distance. The apartments are very nice and cozy! You can fill the spirit of the ancient city by touching bricks and looking at photos on the wall.

If you are debating whether or not to book it, I would say BOOK IT ! The apartment looks exactly like the photos. The location is very good and Suheyla was an amazing host. She greeted me and is very responsive. It’s very important that you book somewhere where the host is friendly and responsive.
Thank you Suheyla 🌹

description:
Unique Space near the Golden Horn!

☞ Walk Score 60 (Walk to cafes, dining, shopping etc.)
☞ 1000 Mbps wifi + workspace
☞ AC + radiant heating
☞ Kettle
☞ 32” HD TV
☞ Outdoor dining area
☞ Free street parking
☞ Upright piano

7 mins → Taksim
5 Mins → Eminonu
30 mins → Istanbul Airport ✈

reviews.text: Chris provides thorough, accurate instructions that are very helpful. The views are beautiful, the area is quiet. It can appear a bit intimidating as you come into the neighborhood but people are just living & minding their business. It's a short 10 min/down-hilly walk to the water & metro/buses. He runs a tight ship, everything was clean, the sheets were super white, crisp & pressed like a hotel--the space is beautiful, I was very impressed. You may have to walk up a couple flights of stairs depending on your room.

My stay at this house was absolutely wonderful The place was clean and tidy, exactly as pictured and described The host was helpful and responsive, ensuring a comfortable stay from start to finish The location is excellent and close to amenities, making getting around easy I confidently recommend this place and would be happy to stay here again in the future.

I am definitely going to stay here again when I come back to Istanbul. It’s easy to get there using public transport or taxi. It’s very clean and for the price I was really impressed. The room, linen and bedding smelled so good and fresh. The bed and pillows were so comfortable which was a blessing especially because I travelled more than 13 hours to get to Istanbul. The best part of the room was the gorgeous view especially when you open the windows and let in the fresh breeze. I can never thank Chris enough for the warm welcome, great hospitality, amazing chats and patience with me as a first time visitor to Istanbul.

The room looks like the photos. It was very clean & you felt comfortable immediately.
From the room you have a beautiful view of the sea. The area is also very quiet and the bus (only about 3 minutes away) takes you everywhere in Istanbul.
Chris was a very nice & helpful host who was always available and always responded very quickly to our questions.
We would book this accommodation again at any time, it was a nice experience & enjoyed our time there.
We had a great time. The room was comfortable and clean. The location is close to public transportation and it’s easy to walk. We loved the place and will highly recommended. Chris is a great host

description: Your family will be close to everything when you stay at this centrally-located place. Our complete building has just been renovated in December 2022. These flats are clean and bright, suitable for large families or friend groups. If you book these flats you would be staying only 5 minutes away by walking from Taksim Square which is the heart of Istanbul. These flats would be booked privately for you where you will feel at home! We are sure that you will love the flat and the city!

reviews.text:
Nursena and Onur were fantastic hosts. Their communication was great before and during our stay. We were two families with two apartments. One of the apartments did not match the photos as it was on the 4th floor with a loft style roof and no windows in one of the bedrooms. Nursena and Onur were very accommodating and changed the apartment for us as soon as they could.
The apartments were all very clean with new, modern furniture and all the kitchen appliances you might need to cook a meal. The decor in the bathroom is also very nice.
The location is great, a 5-10 minute walk to Taksim square with lots of good restaurants and shisha bars close by.
The only things I would note is that there are mosques very close by so the call to prayer may wake you up quite early, and that there is no lift in the building.
All in all, a 5 star stay for us.

I booked two flats, one on the 3rd and the other on the 4th floor for my stay in Istanbul. The apartments were clean and well organized, and lots of amenities were provided such as towels, kitchenware, etc. The neighborhood was quiet with a few grocery stores that were open till midnight. It was within 5-10 min walking distance from Taksim Square. The host was responsive and provided me with check-in instructions and driving direction.

Staying at Nursena’s s place was an absolute delight! From the moment we booked, Nursena made everything easy and stress-free. Communication was prompt and helpful, ensuring we had all the details we needed before our arrival.
The property itself was beyond our expectations—clean, cozy, and exactly as described.

Nice clean room with all the modern amenities and location was also very close to taskin square and isiltikal street, and above all nursena as host was really very responsive and helpful.
Thanks Nursena for such a wonderful stay.

We were two families which spent 10 nights at two flats (one at second floor and another one at the first floor). Both flats were super clean and tidy.
The place is located closely to Taksim square and metro.
The negative side of the place is that there is no room as living room for gathering with couches and sofas. The washing machine and dryer are located at fifth floor.

description:
The perfect place for tourists to enjoy the full Istanbul Experience!
Luxurious stay just beside Taksim square, in a fancy building including all the building facilities from gym, pool, sauna & much more! You can have a buffet breakfast under the building for just 9$/person.
The building is like a Hotel, very well designed, with a beautiful reception area & 24/7 Security.
Our flat is just a short walk from local shops, restaurants, and public transportation.

reviews.text: The home was clean, spacious, beautiful and well kept. Everything you need to feel at home is here. The hosts were gracious, attentive, helpful, and quick to reply. They provided us with local information such as best hospitals, rental car providers, food delivery service apps, and help with operating a smart TV that was on Turkish language settings. The downstairs security and desk person are friendly and helpful as well they scheduled us a taxi back to the airport early in the morning at a good price and called us in the morning to let us know our taxi had arrived.The translation apps help to communicate with security but they are so approachable and helpful. If you are a tourist looking for a rental place with the comfort and amenities of home this is a good choice. The bed is big and comfortable, the couch is spacious and perfect for TV and movie watching. The kitchen has enough to prepare meals daily and then washing machine is convenient for laundry needs.

This was my first time staying at an Air Bnb and probably my last, thats only my opinion based on my personal experience. I’ve always stayed in hotels but this time we needed the extra space so thought I’ll give Air Bnb a try. For me the size of the place, accessibility, location and security was definitely worth the value. I prefer hotels because of the little things like having my room cleaned daily etc. I had a few little issues that the hosts quickly resolved which I appreciated.
Overall, if you need the extra space and don’t mind that its not a 5 star hotel or at that standard then this is the place. The place looks exactly like the photos. We walked to Taskim square/ Istikal street daily it took us 9/10mins.

Totally in Istanbul I have spend around 3 months in my life and lived with approximately 6-7 hotels and 10-12 hosts. This one option is 9/10 for us and our circumstances and aims: not too far from main attractions - 10-15 minutes walk to taksim square; has elevator for our stroller and luggage; apartment has all necessities for long-stay: fully equipped kitchen, laundry, huge TV with Disney, Netflix and so on; security at the condo lobby; we never used but there are sauna, swimming pool and steam (separately for men and women); variety of cafe and shops in the nearest neighbourhood. The atmosphere is very nice, fresh and well-designed. Good value for money, strongly recommended.

This place is an excellent choice. The accommodation is spacious, well-appointed, and very clean, with modern furnishings. It provided all the essentials one might need. However, it could benefit from additional kitchen equipment such as a toaster and larger knives. The security guards at the reception are very helpful in arranging taxis and providing assistance with navigating the roads. This adds a sense of security and reassurance to the overall experience.
One notable drawback was difficulty sleeping at night due to a constant sound emanating from the bedroom ventilation, resembling water from a faucet or running through a pipe. The staff responded promptly, but unfortunately, the issue proved challenging to resolve. We encountered some issues with the hot water in the shower. Occasionally, there was hot water, but at other times, it was unavailable. Despite this, our overall experience was positive. We would consider returning if the problematic noise is addressed.

Wassim + his staff at Indigo are of the highest quality & professionalism! His background as an architect created a flat that was beyond impressive and the beautiful photos posted! Our stay there was also beyond our expectations. The flat was was beautifully finished in a modern sophisticated and clean design. It felt like we were in a brand new apartment with the best and most modern, luxurious appliances, finishes and treatments. It was spotless and clean when we arrived. The place is conveniently located near the main boulevard with access to buses, the metro and main bus stop from airport at Taxim Square. Super popular stroll down Estikal Blvd loads of shopping + places to eat as well as a gorgeous new Mosque! Note: there is a bit of an uphill walk to get up to the Main Street but taxis are plenty + the front desk can even call you one and negóciate the fare in advance! The place was quiet and so peaceful… the bed was simply amazing as was the large couch. Free Wifi, TV, Netflix

description: Located in very central and trendy Galata neighborhood, accessible by all kinds of transportation, this apartment offers stunning Bosphorus views, a spacious atmosphere and a comfortable stay. The apartment is located 3 mins to famous Galata Tower of Istanbul. All the furnitures are brand new and suitable pieces with its exceptional decoration. It is located in a cental place yet in a quiet corner. Karaköy tram, Karaköy ferry and Şişhane metro stations are 5-10 mins to the apartment by walk

reviews.text: Perfect. The apartment is like the photos, everything was clean. Great location! The host is very helpful and responsive. Check-in/out went smoothly. There is paid parking nearby. I would recommend!

Had a great stay here! The place is charming, and the view is as pictured. There's plenty of space. We were 3 and there room for more of us. Place was clean, and the location was perfect—shopping, restaurants, and cafés right at the doorstep. Host was unobtrusive, easy to contact, and went the extra mile.
A few things to be aware of. Apartment is on 5th floor with no elevator. Not a problem for us but could be if you have mobility issues, big suitcases, kids, or strollers. Plus, not all rooms have air conditioners. Just the living room and 1 bedroom.
Some trouble checking in. Conflicting addresses and erroneous maps links were confusing. My friend arrived while I was still flying in, and he had trouble finding the place based on the provided instructions. I'm sure the host would have been happy to help, but as I was the account holder and was on a plane, we couldn't contact him. Just make sure you have the correct address before you arrive.

Great host! Very responsive and fast communication. Clear directions on how to get into the home. If you don’t mind walking up a lot of stairs to get into this apartment then you should definitely book this place. Awesome view of the city and water, great location for walking around with lots to do in a short walking distance. I would definitely recommend staying here and would stay again. Worth it!

The apartment is absolutely beautiful and spacious. It’s clean and the beds are comfortable and the view is stunning to look at. The location is also great and there’s cute shops around. Note that there is no elevator and the apt is on the last floor but it’s worth it and would definitely stay there again the next time I go to Istanbul. Thank you very much for your hospitality.

The place was great! The location and view were fantastic, the beds were comfortable, and the place had all the necessary amenities. Be aware that it's on the 5th floor with narrow stairs, and the building is generally old, so the bathroom has a slight smell and is a bit outdated. However, we were all very happy with our stay. They have a smart TV, and the kitchen is fully functional!

description: Welcome to our Studio Apartment in Istanbul, a charming modern apartment recently renovated in 2012 and designed for our guests with modern facilities, nestled in the heart of the old city, Sultanahmet.

reviews.text:
Most of the things mentioned in the listing were either missing or completely different from what was described. He claimed it's a spacious bathroom with robe paths and slippers, but in reality, it's a small bathroom with none of those amenities in sight. The kitchen was supposed to be an American-style kitchen with a plethora of items, but it's far from the truth. It only has a small cooker, a tiny fridge, and a few glasses - none of the additional items as promised, like cleaning foaming and a kitchen luffah.
the bed; it's a disaster, incredibly uncomfortable, and it eas dirty. He has a lack of communication, I'm sending it to him at 9 a.m., he responded at 11pm. the place is not safe, and there is no parking there. really, I don't know how the people in the comments said it's an incredible place! the location is good for visiting the mosques which is one time visiting! I stayed there for only 3 nights, then i booked another hotel and left immediately. bad experience.

We had a fantastic time in Saban's hotel which was exactly as described, clean and perfect location. Our booking was extremely last minute and Saban was really helpful. The room was cleaned every day and the kitchen had everything you would need for a short stay. We would definitely stay here again.

Saban was a great host--he was easily accessible by phone and email, even for our trivial questions. The place is represented accurately in photos and description. The street had some noise, which at night during our stay (at the end of Ramadan) included children playing, people setting off firecrackers, and what seemed like hordes of sea gulls immediately outside our open windows. This could be a good opportunity for ear plugs for light sleepers. Main attractions are walkable, but it's worth climbing the steep streets to the tram if you're going beyond the Hippodrome. We thoroughly enjoyed our stay. We would do it all over again without second thought.

We really enjoyed our stay in the Cumba Suite. The place has an old world charm but with all the modern conveniences. The bed was very comfortable and the kitchen had everything that we needed. Its a good location. Its just a 1 minute walk to a street with bakeries, shops, restaurants. Everything was within walking distance which was great. The daily cleaning service was nice. Saban was a lovely host, very fast to reply to our communications. He gave us recommendations and helped us to arrange a last minute airport transport. We would definitely visit again for a longer stay.

Amazing apartment in Istanbul that really gives the other hotels and hostels a run for their money. The surrounding neighborhood did not actually feel unsafe to us--it just is more residential and less touristy than other areas of Sultanhamet. Very comfortable bed, continuous hot water, and nice kitchen to make breakfast in. As others have mentioned, the space is cleaned each day. We were very satisfied with our stay!

description:
The apartment's location is in the heart of the city - 10 min walking away from Taksim Square, which is start point of the popular Istiklal Street.
Metro station, bus stops, shops and restaurants are in a few minutes walking away from the apartment.

It has a private bathroom,central heating - air-conditioner; equipped with kitchen and its needful amenities, tv, hair dryer, safe box, wifi.

reviews.text: The Hotel was such a good choice because it is located in a central place. It’s very close to the istiklal street and it’s also very easy to go to other tourist places like the blue mosque which is also not too far away. There are stores, markets, restaurants and money change places all around. The hotel was also very clean and we felt very safe there like it’s our home. The reception is always available and there is always a person sitting there in case you have a problem or question. We will definitely come back and we will recommend this to other people who want to come to Istanbul too.
Comfortable and clean accommodation
This was our second time staying here. It is a nice place at a very good location. Check-in is very easy and they were kind enough to store our luggage for a few hours after check-out.
Harika bir deneyimdi temiz hijyenik ve konum olarak her yere yakındı kesinlikle tavsiye ederim
Konum oldukça merkeziydi. Caddeye çıkan sokaktaydı hemen. İçeri girince temizlik kokusu geldi. Gayet güzel bir konaklamaydı.

description: This Skymoon Hotel room, which is 10 minutes' drive from Istanbul Airport, one double and one portable bed inc. 7/24 reception and room service. This is 25 m2 in size and includes; Air conditioning, electric kettle, minibar, safe box, welcome drink, free water, free tea and coffee pocket, hot water are available.

reviews.text: My flight arrived late at night and i had to wait in the airport for the bus (H6)which stops you in front of the hotel. the host was responsive on airbnb and contacted me to check up if i need anything i arrived late for a layover, the host was nice and waiting in the lobby he took our luggage and was soo nice the room is so cute and clean and tidy the shower was great air conditionner working perfectly, towels clean, there is an elevator.also the two ladies in the morning were nice also! I ´ll certainly come back if i had another layover in istanbul the closest you can be to the airport thank you Gokay :)

This was a fair place to lay our heads for our layover. The room that was listed on the site was not what we were checked into.
Turns out the guests before us were still in the room when we arrived, so they put us in another room. If I didn’t check back at the pictures and say something to the front desk, they wouldn’t have said anything, but they were very honest and said we can still move rooms once the guest left and they cleaned the room.
We were able to eat dinner in the hotel in the meantime, which was very convenient for us. Once we were done, the staff moved us in the room that was on the site. The staff were great, and very nice. They made our stay very comfortable.The host really didn’t check in, but it all worked out. I would probably stay here again, because it’s so close to the airport and the price was really good!

I don’t recommend this place. We booked a 2-bed room. The room is on the third floor and the smell is really bad. The staff of the hotel is not very helpful either. We complain about the smell and he said “I’ll call you in 15-20 min”. After half an hour we didn’t get any calls so we find him again and he said “so it’s the same problem?” And then he’s like “we don’t have any other rooms available” while there was room available on booking sites. We didn’t argue anymore. It’s close to the airport and cheap. That’s the good side. But don’t expect any service and prepare that your room might smell like sewage. And the coke there cost 2 euro.

I checked into a room with my girlfriend and it was ok until we went to take a shower and noticed the door was missing so the place semi-flooded (no fault of ours). Besides that the first time toilet was used it didn’t flush afterwards (total sanitary concern and hazard!). Peeling paint on interior wall of room, damaged and loose door frame with lock latch.
Was able to switch rooms but then to a smaller one (less spacious that what prepaid for), and that one had problems of its own. Slanted uneven flooring which was hard to balance, cracked tile(s) in the shower (luckily this one had a shower door!), plus the mini fridge didn’t cool items enough…drinks weee SLIGHTY cooler than room temperature.
I expressed all these concerns respectfully to host (who seems to be the hotel manager) and he was very unapologetic or accommodating. I will not be staying at this facility again. I have photos of everything mentioned as proof for my honest review.

The hotel was an excellent value. I booked last minute and they were very accommodating and even met me outside on arrival. Hotel smelled of smoke but the hotel and the room was clean and looked as the pictures described.

description: A comfortable single room in the heart of Kadıköy, with a shared bathroom that is regularly cleaned and maintained. Enjoy 500+ Mbps WiFi, coworking spaces, a shared kitchen, lounges and social areas throughout Nest. Meet fellow travelers and digital nomads, join optional dinners or events, or explore Kadıköy at your own pace. Cafés, bars and transport are all within walking distance.

reviews.text:
Reliable internet connection, comfortable space for remote workers and great location near public transport and interesting local life.
The bathroom could use some renovation or minimal care e.g one of the two available showers has a broken door, so the place ends up having 1 available shower for all 7 rooms.
I personally would appreciate some additional touches in the room, like a small light or hangers.
Overall the host and cleaning staff were acommodating.

I stay at Marsel House every time I visit Istanbul now. The host is super helpful and always available if I need anything. The apartments are always clean, comfortable, and somehow even nicer each time I come back.
The location couldn’t be better, close to the metro, airport shuttle, and Kadıköy ferry. Plus, the area is full of great cafés, restaurants, markets, and nightlife.
Highly recommended, it’s my go-to place in Istanbul.
