The room is located in a very good area of Istanbul !
Good value for money. Good wifi and enough for a solo traveler.
The bathroom could have been cleaned more regularly though

Harika bir konaklama deneyimiydi. Ev temiz, düzenli ve ihtiyacımız olan her şey mevcuttu. Konumu gerçekten mükemmeldi; toplu taşımaya, restoranlara ve gezilecek yerlere çok yakındı. Ev sahibi de iletişim konusunda yardımcı ve hızlıydı. İstanbul'u ziyaret edecek herkese gönül rahatlığıyla tavsiye ederim. Teşekkürler!

Located about 10 minutes from all means of public transport (bus, metro, ferry, train), the place is busy in the evening but you won't hear it in your apartment. The internet isn't very fast, it wasn't easy to browse maps while I was planning my trips, but it's good enough for a call or office work. Workspace is nice. The place is decent for the price but floor in my room wasn't the cleanest. Staff is very friendly and nice to all guests.

description: This brand new eclectic 1+1 is very centrally located within a luxury commercial compound w/ indoor & outdoor pool + hot tub, basketball court, gym, jacuzzi & sauna. A short walk away from restaurants, cafes, shops, the subway & metrobus, the apartment comes w/ a stove, oven, dishwasher, nespresso machine, kettle, iron & vacuum. There is NO washer/dryer, which makes it cheaper!

reviews.text: The place was really clean and comfortable,the host was super responsive and friendly,communication was easy,had a great stay there,highly recommended!

Alara was very very welcoming and incredibly helpful- she was proactively making sure everything was perfect and When needed she responds within a second with options and solutions to help - honestly an amazing host and place was super clean has everything i needed. Building in main street and a coffee shop attached to the building supermarket as well and you can walk to a nice outlet mall. Super happy i choose this place as host made everything perfect.

I would like to thank Alara so much. She is an amazing host who went above and beyond to make our stay comfortable. She is a very responsive person who makes sure that all our needs are met! We are coming again to stay at your place Alara. Thank you for everything
Alara is such a great host, she is always very responsive. The place is lovely, very clean and close to everywhere. It was nice to stay in her place again.

Clean apartment that was up to expectations, the location didn’t have too many entertainment around, but easy to take a taxi or public transportation to visit places. Alara was super friendly and always answered and gave good directions already before the trip. Thank you!

description:
The heart of the city is in Kadıköy, in its most central place.

Private suite room in designer Airbnb home.

The 2nd floor is quite bright and spacious.

Private bathroom and kitchen.

Self entry system.

45 minutes by bus from the airport

Possibility to reach all parts of the city,

Walking distance to Metro - Metrobus - Ferry - Marmaray - Buses.

20 minutes away from historical and touristic areas by ferry ( Taksim, Sultanahmet, Eminönü, Sirkeci)

Historical places, Shops, cafes

reviews.text: The apartment was generally clean, comfortable, and pleasant. Its location is right in the heart of Kadıköy, very central. The check-in time at 6 PM is a bit late in general; it might be tiring for guests with morning flights who have to wait. However, Mr. Hakan kindly allowed us to check in one hour earlier. There was some noise in the mornings due to construction across the street. Overall, it offers great value for money. Thank you to Mr. Hakan for everything

Had a great time at this apartment! It was so nice I extended my time here . it is centrally and convienently located. Ferry terminal , busses and train are easily accessible from here but it is walkable to most places in Kadikoy. the apartment was very neat and clean and it is so nice to go back after a day out in the heat to AC and just chill. there are endless restaurants, cafes, bars and an outdoor market in the area.
The host was very pleasant and responsive if I had any questions .
Thank you Mr. Hakan !
I Highly recommend!

Everything was according to the photos and description.
Perfect and flawless.
It was clean and everything was ready for a 7-night stay.
Mr. Hakan was always responsive and patiently guided.
Considering that I know Istanbul almost completely, I can say that from this location you can access anywhere in Istanbul by metro and metrobus, which is only 5 to 10 minutes away from Mr Hakan home.

Host was responsive and helpful. I enjoyed my stay. The apartment is as described. I did not have any issues. Location is great. I did not have any sound/noise problems even though it was really central.

Konum harika, odanın boyutu iki kişi için gayet yeterli. Genel olarak yorumlardaki gürültü problemine katılmakla beraber benzer konumda daha az gürültülü bir yerin olmasını beklemek de gerçekçi gelmiyor. Bu nedenle ben sorun etmedim. Yalnızca kalan kişilerin temizlikte sıkıntı olmadığını, fakat binanın ve odanın eskiliğinden dolayı o “tertemiz” görüntüyle kalamayacaklarını bilmeleri iyi olabilir. Yatak eğer yapılı olan 2 kişi kalacaksanız küçük gelebilir, bize yetti. Her şeyi değerlendirince fiyat-performans denecek bir oda, konumu da her şeyi daha iyi yapıyor. Hakan beye de teşekkür ederim ☺️

description:
Mini studio apartment on the ground floor of a quiet garden, 2 minutes' walk from the Büyükada ferry terminal, next to all intra-island transportation vehicles.
There is a table and chair in front of the door entrance, as well as a common garden where you can sit and spend time peacefully.

evin lokasyonu merkezi bir yerde iskeleye gayet yakın.ev fotoğraflarda gösterildiği gibi gayet temizdi. ev sahibi shakti hanım gayet ilgili ve nazik birisi.. her konuda yardımcı oldu. büyükadada kesinlikle tavsiye edeceğim, memnun kalacağınız bir yer.

Very friendly and responsive host with lots of local recommendations. The apartment was clean and tidy, and in a very convenient location minutes from the port. Thank you !

Büyükada için en doğru tercihi yapmışız o kadar memnun kaldık ki🩷Evin konumu temizliği,ev sahibinin ilgisi çok çok güzel 3 gün geçerdik.Ev inanımaz tatlı sıcacık hissettiriyor evin tertemiz olması bizim için çok önemliydi kesinlikle istanbuldan kaçıp kafa dinlemeye gideceğimiz yer🥺 eve girdiğimizde bizi atıştıralıkla karşılamıştı ev sahibi ,çok güzel bir tatil geçirdik gözünüz kapalıı bu tatlı evde kalabilirsiniz aslaa pişman olmazsınız.
Tekrar her şey için teşekkürler🩷

description:
{ More Quality of Living }
Enjoy a stylish experience at centrally-located spacious flat.
taking our time to perfectly furnish this place to offer a unique memorable holiday to you, your family & friends
Living at this place will offer a cosmopolitan experience like no other!

We proudly hosted more than 1000 guests in the last 4 years in multiple central locations in Istanbul, therefore we are aware of your needs and expectations to make it a unique, unforgettable, and comfortable experience!

reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay at this apartment in Istanbul. The place felt very homey, clean, and comfortable—just like staying in our own home. The location is perfect, only about a 5-minute walk to Istiklal Street and Taksim, which made everything very convenient.
Ekaterina and Meriam was extremely helpful and responsive to all our needs. They even checked in on us to make sure everything was okay. Definitely worth the price. Highly recommended!

Good apartment, clean and tidy, just like the photos. Host very nice and responsive, always checked to see if we needed anything and Give us recommendations. Perfect for us family of 4, we felt just at home. Close to Taksim square, shopping, restaurants. Apartment located in a local residential so peaceful. Bus stop is just 5minutes away and can take you anywhere. Metro station is around 15-20 minutes. Super easy to get around if you use both buses and metros.

We booked 2 flats for 1 day at the same building.
We were very satisfied with everything.
New flat. Great location. very stylish bohemian atmosphere.
very comfortable Matress & Pillows.
Clean big kitchen, good quality items

The apartment was great, very clean, comfortable, and away from the noise. I loved the decor, and they knew we'd be resting in the room, so they played harmony music. I felt positive in that room. Nael is good host. He hosting,helping and caring so much from check in until check out. He always communicate for making sure everything is good. And i’m forget my Watch there, I always text and he didn’t felt bother. It’s not enough for 1 night, hope I can book more than 1 night next time. Very very recomended 👏👏✅
Amazing place to stay in an even better location! The host and property manager were amazing to deal with and made the stay easy and comfortable. Will definitely book again!

description:
This is Historical Rum building named “Rum_Otto” in the heart of Taksim. We carefully renovated the building with little touch Ottoman design to keep history alive and little modern design to make your stay comfy. Everything inside “first class” materialized you easily understand during your stay. The house in quite street but location is central, easy to get cafe, restaurant, bar, shopping and transportations.

Historical Building renovated with Hard Steel Construction upon "earthquake code"

reviews.text:
This was my first time on AirBnB and this place is the reason i chose to stay on the European Side and it was just amazing as it is seen on the photos. Very close to Taksim Square and it is also very easy to get to the airport shuttle service or such other means of transport to discover the city. The room was pretty clean and had everything i may need, and the bed & pillows were really comfy. Even it is the loft and the roof is inclined i didn’t have any problem with that since i am not that tall. You can find almost anything in the kitchen you may need, very stylish and fancy.
The hosts got back to me very quickly and they were all kind and helpful.
I really enjoyed the place and the owners attitude is just the cherry on the top of it.
I definetely recommend anyone staying there and i’ll go back to this house again on my next visit to İstanbul 🙃

Ev tıpkı fotoğraflardaki gibi hatta beklediğimden daha ferah hissettirdi. Yatak odasındaki küvet çok tatlı. Ev temizdi ve düzenliydi. Koltuğu ve yatağı bence rahattı yumuşaktı ve örtüler de temizdi. İstiklale çok yakın fakat tek sorun gece saatlerinde yürümek hoş hissettirmiyor. Genel olarak evin çok tatlı bir havası vardı fakat ortalamanın bir tık üstü bir fiyat bence, daha uygun olsaydı daha uzun bile kalabilirdim.

I stayed at Iso’s apartment for 2 nights. He is very responsive host and have the perfect instructions for check in and etc. The location is good and has many grocery shops, restaurants and easily accessible via public transportation.
If you have lots of luggage I would recommend to leave it at the airport and take a metro to the place. The stairs could be a bit tricky.
The bath is fantastic and place is very cozy with comfortable bed and fresh linens.
Thank you!

Love this Airbnb it’s located at Taksim central and easy to travel
Very nice room with affordable price and very clean
The host super nice and helpful 10/10

The place is neat, very clean and cozy in the central area. However, stairs are narrow and not easy to climb if you got a luggage. The ceiling in the room and kitchen is quite low. The host is responsive and required instruction was provided.

description: A nice, comfortable flat in the Taksim area with one bedroom and one living room. Ten-fifteen minutes walking distance to the Taksim subway, Kabataş funicular railway, Airport Shuttle, and Taksim Square. The flat is in the historic part of Istanbul. There are markets, hospitals, and pharmacies close by.
